Dream Dictionary

Traditional dream meanings, rewritten in plain contemporary English from four public-domain dream books, with a modern reading of the feelings involved and questions for reflection.

The tone runs from ●○○○○ (very negative omen) to ●●●●● (very positive).

The four books: G. H. Miller, Ten Thousand Dreams Interpreted, or What's in a Dream (1901); F. Fontaine, The Golden Wheel Dream-Book and Fortune-Teller (1862); A. H. Noe, The Witches' Dream Book (1885); and the anonymous Interpretation of Dreams and Moles (1805).

    A

    • Abandon ●●●●●A dream of abandonment is mostly about the future: plans that are hard to build, or ties you fear losing.
    • Abbess ●●●●●An abbess in a dream is about authority: something you give in to reluctantly, unless she is kind.
    • Abbey ●●●●●An abbey in a dream concerns your hopes: in ruins, it points to plans left unfinished.
    • Abbot ●●●●●An abbot in a dream warns against flattery and hidden schemes.
    • Abdomen ●●●●●The abdomen in a dream is about expectations, effort and worries over loved ones' health.
    • Abhor ●●●●●Dreaming of loathing someone speaks of justified suspicion, but also of selfishness creeping in.
    • Abject ●●●●●Seeing yourself wretched in a dream points to bad news and friction among friends.
    • Abode ●●●●●Your dwelling in a dream concerns trust and stability: losing it means losing your footing.
    • Abortion ●●●●●This dream warns against a risky undertaking or neglecting your responsibilities.
    • Above ●●●●●Something hanging over your head is about threat or improvement, depending on whether it holds or falls.
    • Abroad ●●●●●Being abroad in a dream points to a pleasant trip and a stay in another climate.
    • Absalom ●●●●●Absalom, the rebellious son, signals painful events and warns against hurting those you love.
    • Abscess ●●●●●An abscess in a dream mixes misfortune with compassion, but can also mean healing after illness.
    • Absence ●●●●●Dreaming of absent people often foretells their return, stronger friendships and success.
    • Absinthe ●●●●●Absinthe in a dream points to carefree pleasures that squander your energy and money.
    • Abundance ●●●●●Abundance in a dream promises financial independence, but warns of scarcity and strain at home.
    • Abuse ●●●●●Abuse in a dream points to disputes, jealousy and losses through stubbornness.
    • Abyss ●●●●●An abyss in a dream points to threats to your property and quarrels, unless you manage to avoid it.
    • Academy ●●●●●An academy in a dream speaks of missed chances and knowledge poorly put to use.
    • Accepted ●●●●●Being accepted in a dream promises success in business or love, unless the dream comes from anxiety.
    • Accident ●●●●●An accident in a dream calls for caution when travelling, but can also mean an unexpected visitor.
    • Accordion ●●●●●An accordion in a dream brings cheer that lightens your burdens.
    • Accounts ●●●●●Accounts in a dream speak of debts, disputes and sometimes a stroke of luck.
    • Accuse ●●●●●Accusing or being accused in a dream speaks of quarrels and gossip, but can also be a good sign.
    • Aches ●●●●●Aches in a dream often point to lost momentum, or simply to a physical cause.
    • Acid ●●●●●Acid in a dream is a bad sign: anxiety, compromising situations and treachery.
    • Acorn ●●●●●Acorns in a dream promise strength, gain and success after effort, unless they are spoiled.
    • Acquaintance ●●●●●Meeting an acquaintance in a dream mirrors the state of your relationships: calm or stormy.
    • Acquit ●●●●●Being acquitted in a dream points to valuable property, though perhaps a lawsuit first.
    • Acrobat ●●●●●An acrobat in a dream speaks of risk, mockery and a reputation under attack.
    • Errand ●●●●●Being sent on an errand points to success in love and recovery, but losses for married people.
    • Actor and actress ●●●●●Actors in a dream speak of pleasure and lightness, but also of disillusion when the scenery falls.
    • Actress ●●●●●An actress in a dream is a good sign seen on stage, less so if you fall in love with her.
    • Adam ●●●●●Adam in a dream is a happy omen, especially if he looks pleased.
    • Adam and eve ●●●●●Adam and Eve in a dream signal an event that shakes your hopes, and betrayal.
    • Adamant ●●●●●Adamant, the legendary unbreakable stone, signals defeat in a desire you hold dear.
    • Adder ●●●●●An adder in a dream warns of a false friend, though one tradition reads it as wealth.
    • Addition ●●●●●Doing sums in a dream speaks of difficulties to overcome, and allies to help you.
    • Saying Goodbye ●●●●●Farewells in a dream point to visits and journeys, cheerful or sad depending on the goodbye.
    • Admire ●●●●●Being admired in a dream points to rising in the world without losing old friends.
    • Admonish ●●●●●Correcting a young person in a dream means your generosity will bring favor and fortune.
    • Adopted ●●●●●Adoption in a dream points to fortune from strangers, but an unhappy move.
    • Adulation ●●●●●Adulation in a dream warns against unearned honors and self-serving flattery.
    • Adultery ●●●●●Adultery in a dream mostly points to disputes and trouble, unless you resist the temptation.
    • Advancement ●●●●●Advancing in a dream points to a rapid rise and success in love.
    • Adventurer ●●●●●An adventurer in a dream warns against flatterers and schemers.
    • Adversary ●●●●●Facing an adversary in a dream shows you will stand up for yourself, though your health may waver.
    • Adversity ●●●●●Adversity in a dream points to failures, gloomy prospects and worry over someone's health.
    • Advertisement ●●●●●Advertisements in a dream speak of hard work to succeed and rivals who get ahead.
    • Advice ●●●●●Receiving advice in a dream pushes you toward integrity, but legal advice points to doubts.
    • Advocate ●●●●●Championing a cause in a dream points to loyalty, honesty and promises kept.
    • Affliction ●●●●●Affliction in a dream signals approaching disaster and a run of misfortunes.
    • Affluence ●●●●●Affluence in a dream promises lucky ventures, but fairy-tale wealth is only an illusion.
    • Affrighted ●●●●●Terror in a dream points to an accident or distressing scenes, and often comes from nerves or fever.
    • Affront ●●●●●An affront in a dream is a bad sign: it points to tears and traps set by ill- wishers.
    • Afraid ●●●●●Being afraid in a dream points to trouble at home and plans that fail.
    • Africa ●●●●●Scenes of Africa in a dream point to lonely journeys with little pleasure or profit.
    • Afternoon ●●●●●An afternoon in a dream points to lasting friendships, unless it is grey and rainy.
    • Agate ●●●●●Agate in a dream points to a slight step forward in business.
    • Age ●●●●●Age in a dream points to failures and family tension.
    • Agony ●●●●●Agony in a dream mixes worry and pleasure, with worry winning out.
    • Ague ●●●●●Ague in a dream signals physical trouble and excess, but in your sweetheart it means love.
    • Air ●●●●●Air in a dream is read by its look: clear and calm means happiness; heavy and dark means trouble.
    • Alabaster ●●●●●Alabaster in a dream promises a happy marriage and success, but breaking it points to regret and loss.
    • Alarm bell ●●●●●Hearing an alarm bell in a dream points to cause for anxiety.
    • Album ●●●●●An album in a dream points to success and true friends.
    • Ale-house ●●●●●An ale-house in a dream is a warning: enemies are watching you.
    • Stranger ●●●●●A stranger in a dream mirrors your well-being: pleasant, they mean health; unpleasant, disappointment.
    • Alley ●●●●●An alley in a dream points to dimmer prospects and nagging cares.
    • Alligator ●●●●●An alligator in a dream calls for caution, unless you kill it.
    • Alloy ●●●●●Alloy in a dream points to tangled business and sorrow that hides pleasure.
    • Almanac ●●●●●An almanac in a dream points to changeable fortunes and illusory pleasures.
    • Almonds ●●●●●Almonds in a dream point to wealth and luck in love, with a little sorrow along the way.
    • Alms ●●●●●Alms in a dream are lucky if given freely, unlucky if refused or given grudgingly.
    • Alms-house ●●●●●An alms-house in a dream points to the failure of a marriage of convenience.
    • Altar ●●●●●An altar in a dream swings between joy in love and a warning to repent.
    • Alum ●●●●●Alum in a dream points to thwarted plans and remorse.
    • Aluminium ●●●●●Aluminium in a dream points to contentment, even with little, unless it is tarnished.
    • Amateur ●●●●●An amateur actor in a dream points to hopes fulfilled, unless the play is a tragedy.
    • Ambush ●●●●●An ambush in a dream signals a hidden danger close by.
    • America ●●●●●America in a dream points to trouble ahead and calls for caution.
    • Amethyst ●●●●●An amethyst in a dream means contentment in fair dealings, but losing one threatens love.
    • Ammonia ●●●●●Ammonia in a dream points to disappointment in a friend and broken friendships.
    • Ammunition ●●●●●Ammunition in a dream points to fruitful work, as long as it doesn't run out.
    • Amorous ●●●●●Feeling amorous in a dream warns against pleasures that could lead to scandal.
    • Amputation ●●●●●An amputation in a dream points to losses, small or large depending on the limb.
    • Ancestors ●●●●●Dreaming of your forebears, grandparents and ancestors points to cares ahead.
    • Anchor ●●●●●An anchor in a dream speaks of both steadiness and departure, of joy in love and of separations.
    • Andirons ●●●●●Andirons in a dream mean friendship if they hold a fire, loss if the hearth is empty.
    • Anecdote ●●●●●Telling anecdotes in a dream points to a taste for fun over serious thought.
    • Angel ●●●●●An angel in a dream signals a change in your life, often happy, sometimes a warning.
    • Anger ●●●●●Anger in a dream points to trials and powerful enemies, unless you stay calm.
    • Angling ●●●●●Angling in a dream is lucky if the fish bite, troublesome if they don't.
    • Animal hide ●●●●●An animal hide points to profit and steady work.
    • Annoy ●●●●●Being annoyed in a dream points to enemies at work and small irritations the next day.
    • Antelope ●●●●●An antelope in a dream points to high ambitions, reachable through great energy.
    • Ants ●●●●●Ants in a dream mostly mean petty annoyances, unless they are storing food.
    • Anvil ●●●●●An anvil in a dream points to rewarding work, if you are willing to put in the effort.
    • Anxiety ●●●●●Anxiety in a dream can mean renewal after a threat, unless it is about a major matter.
    • Apes ●●●●●Apes in a dream signal deceit and hidden enemies.
    • Apparel ●●●●●Clothing in a dream mirrors how your affairs are going: clean and well-fitting means success; worn or ill-fitting means setbacks.
    • Apparition ●●●●●An apparition in a dream signals danger to you and yours, and deceit.
    • Apples ●●●●●Apples are mostly a happy dream about hopes coming to fruition, long life and success, as long as the fruit is sound.
    • Apprentice ●●●●●Being an apprentice in a dream is mostly about the struggle to earn your place among others.
    • Apricot ●●●●●Apricots carry opposite readings: health, pleasure and happy love on one side, hidden bitterness behind a rosy surface on the other.
    • April ●●●●●The month of April mostly promises pleasure and profit, with a small caveat if the weather is bad.
    • Apron ●●●●●An apron mostly points to a winding path and a few scoldings.
    • Arch ●●●●●An arch mostly foretells rising to distinction and wealth earned through steady effort.
    • Archbishop ●●●●●An archbishop is mostly about obstacles on the road to success, but also about support from people in high places.
    • Architect ●●●●●An architect mostly signals risky changes and thwarted ambitions.
    • Arm ●●●●●Arms are mostly about strength and health: strong ones promise success and wealth, weak or severed ones point to loss and separation.
    • Armed men ●●●●●Armed men are mostly a good sign of courage and victory, unless they march against you.
    • Aroma ●●●●●A sweet aroma foretells a small pleasure or a gift.
    • Arrested ●●●●●An arrest is mostly about a wish for change held back by fear of failure.
    • Arrow ●●●●●An arrow mostly foretells pleasure, festivities and good journeys, unless it is old or broken.
    • Art gallery ●●●●●An art gallery is mostly about appearances: a show of happiness that hides other attachments.
    • Ascend ●●●●●Climbing upward in a dream is a good sign if you reach the top without stumbling.
    • Asceticism ●●●●●Asceticism foretells unusual ideas that charm strangers but put off friends.
    • Ashes ●●●●●Ashes are a dark omen of misfortune, bitter changes and failed ventures.
    • Asia ●●●●●Visiting Asia foretells change, but no material gain.
    • Asp ●●●●●An asp signals scheming enemies out to damage your name, but it is harmless if it doesn't bite.
    • Asparagus ●●●●●Asparagus promises a prosperous home, but interrupted success if you eat it.
    • Ss (Donkey) ●●●●●A donkey is mostly about annoyances, quarrels and gossip, but also about patient success won through hard work.
    • Assassin ●●●●●An assassin is a warning: hidden enemies and false friends threaten your property and peace of mind.
    • Assistance ●●●●●Giving or receiving help is a happy dream of advancement and loyal friends.
    • Astral ●●●●●The astral promises success and renown, unless you see your own double.
    • Asylum ●●●●●An asylum foretells illness and bad dealings that will take a hard inner struggle to overcome.
    • Atlas ●●●●●Looking at an atlas foretells careful thought about your interests before any change or journey.
    • Atonement ●●●●●Atonement mostly foretells happy times with friends and successful courtship, unless someone else atones for your faults.
    • Attic ●●●●●An attic is mostly about hopes that won't come to pass.
    • Attorney ●●●●●An attorney mostly signals disputes, hampered business and losses; even friends' help will bring worry.
    • Auction ●●●●●Auctions carry opposite readings: bright prospects and plenty on one side, loss of property and friends on the other.
    • Augur ●●●●●Seeing augurs foretells labor and toil.
    • August ●●●●●The month of August mostly foretells bad deals and misunderstandings in love.
    • Aunt ●●●●●An aunt mostly foretells hurtful criticism, unless she is smiling.
    • Aura ●●●●●Talking about auras in a dream foretells inner unrest and a search for what drives you.
    • Author ●●●●●An author is mostly about doubts and worries over writing, with recognition in the end.
    • Automobile ●●●●●An automobile is mostly about restlessness and change, with a risk of unwise moves.
    • Autumn ●●●●●Autumn mostly foretells gains through others' efforts and a happy marriage.
    • Awake ●●●●●Dreaming you're awake foretells strange events that darken your mood, with good things ahead despite some letdowns.
    • Waking Up ●●●●●Waking in a dream foretells an end to sorrow and love returned.
    • Axe ●●●●●An axe is mostly about energy and effort rewarded, unless it is rusty or broken.

    B

    • Baby ●●●●●Babies carry opposite readings: a bright baby promises love and friendship, a crying or sick one brings worry and disappointment.
    • Baby carriage ●●●●●A baby carriage foretells a kindred friend full of pleasant surprises.
    • Bachelor ●●●●●A bachelor is mostly about caution in love, mixed motives and justice gone astray.
    • Back ●●●●●A back is mostly a bad sign of weakness, illness, envy and enemies, except the backbone, which promises health and joy.
    • Backbite ●●●●●Backbiting foretells a turn for the worse and worries at home.
    • Backgammon ●●●●●Backgammon foretells a cool welcome from others but lasting friendships, and setbacks in love if you lose.
    • Bacon ●●●●●Bacon is mostly a bad omen of loss, enemies and disappointment in love, unless it's shared cleanly and gladly.
    • Badger ●●●●●A badger foretells luck after a struggle with hardship.
    • Bagpipe ●●●●●A bagpipe isn't a bad dream, unless the music is harsh and the player is in rags.
    • Bagpipes ●●●●●Bagpipes foretell trouble, arguments and a lost lawsuit.
    • Bail ●●●●●Bail foretells unexpected trouble, accidents and unlucky alliances.
    • Bailiff ●●●●●A bailiff is about reaching beyond your means and false friends after your money.
    • Bakehouse ●●●●●A bakehouse calls for caution before any career change, as pitfalls lie everywhere.
    • Baking ●●●●●Baking carries opposite readings: worry and hardship for some, thrift and good harvests for others.
    • Balcony ●●●●●A balcony is mostly about partings and bad news from absent friends.
    • Bald ●●●●●Baldness mostly signals trickery and hardship, with one exception: bald babies promise a happy home.
    • Ball ●●●●●A ball is a very good sign when the party is lovely and lively, but turns dark if you feel ignored there.
    • Ballet ●●●●●A ballet mostly foretells infidelity, business failure and jealousy in love.
    • Balloon ●●●●●A balloon foretells dashed hopes, pie-in-the-sky schemes and business setbacks.
    • Banana ●●●●●Bananas split the old readings: a dull life and tiresome duties for some, prosperity and love for others.
    • Banishment ●●●●●Banishment is a dream of ill fate, warning of misfortune and betrayal.
    • Banjo ●●●●●A banjo mostly promises pleasant amusements.
    • Bank ●●●●●A bank dream is about money and standing: it weighs feared losses against well-earned comfort.
    • Banknotes ●●●●●Banknotes carry the same omens as money in general.
    • Bankrupt ●●●●●Dreaming of bankruptcy warns of shaky business and reckless risks.
    • Banner ●●●●●Your country's banner foretells victory or defeat depending on its state.
    • Banquet ●●●●●A banquet mostly promises generous friends and success, unless the tables are empty or the mood is off.
    • Bantam ●●●●●Bantams foretell a modest fortune but real contentment.
    • Baptism ●●●●●A baptism dream calls for restraint and speaks of inner struggles between duty and desire.
    • Bar ●●●●●A bar points to quick ambitions, sometimes pursued by dubious means.
    • Barber ●●●●●The barber foretells success through hard work, or else losses.
    • Barefoot ●●●●●Wandering barefoot foretells dashed hopes and obstacles on every side.
    • Barking dogs ●●●●●Barking dogs signal enemies ready to run you down.
    • Barley field ●●●●●A barley field promises your highest wishes fulfilled, unless it is decaying.
    • Barmaid ●●●●●This dream warns about the pull of easy pleasures at the expense of what really matters.
    • Barn ●●●●●A full barn promises plenty and a prosperous marriage; an empty one, the opposite.
    • Barometer ●●●●●A barometer foretells a profitable change in your affairs, unless it is broken.
    • Barrel ●●●●●A full barrel foretells wealth, an empty one poverty.
    • Baseball ●●●●●Baseball foretells an easygoing mood and good company, more fun than profit.
    • Basement ●●●●●A basement foretells fading opportunities and growing worries.
    • Basin ●●●●●A basin speaks of friendship and money: full, it brings wealth; empty, debts.
    • Basket ●●●●●A full basket promises success; an empty one, disappointment.
    • Bass voice ●●●●●A bass voice foretells deceit uncovered at work and quarrels in love.
    • Baste ●●●●●Basting meat or sewing warns against selfishness and overspending.
    • Bat ●●●●●The bat is one of the darkest omens: sorrow, calamity and pointless journeys.
    • Bath ●●●●●A bath dream mostly concerns reputation and temptation; only a cold, clear bath is a good sign.
    • Bathing ●●●●●Bathing depends on the water: clear brings luck, dirty brings shame and disappointment.
    • Bathroom ●●●●●A bathroom foretells spoiled pleasures but more lasting joys afterward.
    • Battle ●●●●●A battle speaks of difficulties to overcome, a change of path and hidden enemies.
    • Bay tree ●●●●●The bay tree promises pleasant, enriching leisure, a good dream for everyone.
    • Bayonet ●●●●●A bayonet signals vindictive enemies, unless you hold it yourself.
    • Beacon ●●●●●A beacon promises calm seas, firm bonds and recovery, unless it goes out in a storm.
    • Beads ●●●●●Beads foretell attention from influential people and real contentment.
    • Beam ●●●●●A beam foretells a high position in life.
    • Beans ●●●●●Beans are a bad omen: worries, illness and discord.
    • Bear ●●●●●A bear stands for fierce competition or an enemy, but defeating it frees you.
    • Beard ●●●●●A beard speaks of rivalry and vanity, but a long full beard means success.
    • Beat ●●●●●This dream foretells family quarrels or an abuse of power on your part.
    • Beating ●●●●●Beating someone in a dream oddly foretells peace for couples, but a breakup for lovers.
    • Beauty ●●●●●Beauty in any form is an excellent sign, in love and in business.
    • Beaver ●●●●●The beaver rewards patience, but killing it for its fur brings accusations.
    • Bed ●●●●●A bed speaks of rest, health and married life; everything depends on its state and who is in it.
    • Bedbugs ●●●●●Bedbugs foretell illness and worry, often greater than the real harm.
    • Bedbugs ●●●●●Bedbugs foretell strife and quarrels.
    • Bedchamber ●●●●●A newly furnished bedroom foretells a happy change and faraway journeys.
    • Bedfellow ●●●●●Sharing a bed in a dream foretells criticism, discontent or bad luck.
    • Bedwetting ●●●●●Wetting the bed in a dream points to a loss by fire, often just a damaged item.
    • Beech and myrtle trees ●●●●●Beech and myrtle favor romantic adventures, but bring only toil and pain to everyone else.
    • Beef ●●●●●Beef mostly foretells ailments and injuries, unless it is nicely served in pleasant surroundings.
    • Beer ●●●●●Beer mostly foretells disappointments and domestic trouble.
    • Bees ●●●●●Bees foretell activity, friendship and prosperity, but a sting signals betrayal.
    • Beetles ●●●●●Beetles on you foretell hardship and small ills; killing them is good.
    • Beets ●●●●●Beets foretell plenty, peace and business moving forward.
    • Beggar ●●●●●A beggar warns against poor management; giving is better than refusing.
    • Beggar ●●●●●A beggar foretells annoying interference with your plans for betterment and enjoyment.
    • Beheading ●●●●●Being beheaded foretells failure, but seeing someone else beheaded is oddly an excellent sign.
    • Being hanged ●●●●●This dream reads in reverse: being hanged points to wealth and distinction, but escaping brings bad luck.
    • Being hungry ●●●●●Being hungry in a dream foretells a successful new venture and, in love, plenty of energy.
    • Being kissed ●●●●●Being kissed in a dream works curiously: sometimes praise, sometimes gossip or hurtful words.
    • Belladonna ●●●●●Belladonna mixes strategic success and rivalry; taking it means failure.
    • Bellman ●●●●●The bellman announces good fortune and disputes settled amicably, unless he looks sad.
    • Bellows ●●●●●Bellows foretell victory over poverty through energy, and friends who miss you.
    • Bells ●●●●●Joyful bells announce weddings and good news; tolling bells, bad news.
    • Belly ●●●●●The belly speaks of health and family fortune: full, it enriches; swollen yet empty, it impoverishes.
    • Belt ●●●●●A belt foretells a risky encounter or deserved criticism.
    • Bench ●●●●●Sitting on a bench calls for caution; seeing others there means reconciliation.
    • Bequest ●●●●●A bequest foretells the satisfaction of duty done and good health for the young.
    • Bereavement ●●●●●Dreaming of bereavement foretells thwarted plans and dashed hopes.
    • Bet ●●●●●Betting in a dream warns against recklessness and people who want to exploit you.
    • Bhagavad gita ●●●●●The Bhagavad Gita foretells a time of retreat and rest, and a trip arranged by friends, with little financial gain.
    • Bible ●●●●●The Bible foretells simple, innocent joys, but mocking it signals temptation.
    • Bicycle ●●●●●Riding uphill foretells bright prospects; riding downhill calls for caution.
    • Bier ●●●●●A bier foretells heavy losses and the pain of parting.
    • Bigamy ●●●●●Bigamy foretells a loss of vigor and risks to your reputation.
    • Bill poster ●●●●●A bill poster foretells thankless work and bad news.
    • Billiards ●●●●●Billiards foretell trouble, lawsuits and slander.
    • Bird's Nest ●●●●●A bird's nest speaks of the future: full, it brings luck; empty or deserted, sorrow.
    • Finding a Bird's Nest ●●●●●Finding a nest is a good sign, unless it is empty.
    • Birding ●●●●●Catching birds foretells profit and pleasure.
    • Birds ●●●●●Birds are mostly a good sign, especially flying or singing, but wounded or fighting birds bring sorrow.
    • Birth ●●●●●A birth foretells joy and inheritance for some, but reversals for others.
    • Birthday ●●●●●A birthday dream oddly foretells hardship and trials.
    • Birthday presents ●●●●●Receiving birthday presents foretells achievement and advancement.
    • Biscuits ●●●●●Eating or baking biscuits foretells poor health and silly family squabbles.
    • Bishop ●●●●●A bishop mostly foretells work and worry, unless you win his approval.
    • Bite ●●●●●A bite is a bad omen: regrets, losses and jealousy.
    • Black person ●●●●●The old readings of this dream rested on prejudice and are not repeated here.
    • Blackberries ●●●●●Blackberries foretell ills and losses.
    • Blackboard ●●●●●A blackboard covered in writing foretells bad news about health or money.
    • Blacksmith ●●●●●The blacksmith foretells that hard work will soon pay off for you.
    • Bladder ●●●●●The bladder warns you to look after your health and energy to avoid trouble.
    • Blanket ●●●●●A soiled blanket means treachery; a new white one, unexpected success.
    • Blasphemy ●●●●●Cursing in a dream brings bad luck or a false friend, but being cursed by others is a good sign.
    • Bleating ●●●●●Hearing young animals bleat foretells new duties, not necessarily unpleasant ones.
    • Bleeding ●●●●●Bleeding foretells losses and disappointments, but drawing another's blood can mean victory.
    • Blind ●●●●●Blindness in a dream foretells misplaced trust, lost money and unfaithful love.
    • Blind man's buff ●●●●●Playing blind man's buff foretells a shaky venture that could embarrass you.
    • Blindfold ●●●●●A blindfold foretells trouble gathering around you and disappointments.
    • Blindman's buff ●●●●●In this tradition, playing blindman's buff foretells prosperity, joy and pleasure.
    • Blood ●●●●●Blood mostly foretells enemies, illness and bad luck, with one happy exception.
    • Bloodstone ●●●●●A bloodstone foretells unlucky dealings, but a lost friendship may bring a better one.
    • Blossoming of trees ●●●●●Blossoming trees foretell joy, comfort and recreation.
    • Blossoms ●●●●●Trees in blossom herald a time of prosperity and pleasant surprises.
    • Blotting paper ●●●●●Blotting paper warns of betrayed secrets and repeated disputes.
    • Blowing the fire ●●●●●Blowing on a fire means your sweetheart is very angry with you.
    • Blows ●●●●●Blows foretell harm to yourself, unless you defend yourself.
    • Blushing ●●●●●Blushing foretells false accusations; seeing others blush, ill-judged teasing.
    • Boa constrictor ●●●●●A boa constrictor foretells stormy times and much bad luck, unless you kill it.
    • Boarding house ●●●●●A boarding house foretells disorder in your affairs and likely a move.
    • Boasting ●●●●●Boasting foretells regret or a temptation to cheat against rivals.
    • Boat ●●●●●A boat on calm water foretells success; on rough water, worries.
    • Bobbin ●●●●●A bobbin foretells important work that must not be neglected.
    • Bog ●●●●●A bog suggests crushing burdens and health worries.
    • Boiler ●●●●●A broken boiler foretells mismanagement, disappointment, illness or loss.
    • Boils ●●●●●Boils foretell unpleasantness and insincere friends.
    • Bolts ●●●●●Bolts foretell formidable obstacles in your way.
    • Bombshell ●●●●●Bombshells foretell anger, disputes and lawsuits.
    • Bones ●●●●●Bones foretell treachery and an unhealthy environment.
    • Bonnet ●●●●●A bonnet speaks of gossip and flirtation: its color and condition decide.
    • Bookcase ●●●●●A full bookcase combines knowledge and pleasure; an empty one means a lack of means.
    • Books ●●●●●Books promise honor and pleasant pursuits, except for old or lewd ones.
    • Bookshop ●●●●●A bookshop foretells literary ambitions that may get in the way of your other work.
    • Boots ●●●●●New boots bring luck; old ones, or yours on someone else, bring loss and worry.
    • Borrowing ●●●●●Borrowing foretells loss and meagre support; lending, on the contrary, true friends.
    • Bosom ●●●●●The bosom speaks of love and vulnerability: wounded, it worries; full and healthy, it enriches.
    • Bottles ●●●●●Full bottles foretell success in love and prosperity; empty or broken ones, trouble.
    • Bouquet ●●●●●A colorful bouquet foretells joy, inheritance and faithful love, unless it is withered.
    • Bow and arrow ●●●●●A bow and arrow foretell gain from others' failures; a missed shot, dashed hopes.
    • Box ●●●●●Opening a full box foretells wealth and travel; an empty one, disappointment.
    • Boy ●●●●●Giving birth to a boy foretells a pleasant life.
    • Bracelet ●●●●●A bracelet given to you foretells a happy union; losing one, vexations.
    • Brain ●●●●●The brain speaks of your mind: bad surroundings stunt it, but feeding it pays off.
    • Brambles ●●●●●Getting caught in brambles foretells lost lawsuits and illness.
    • Branch ●●●●●A branch full of fruit foretells wealth and friendship; a dry one, sad news.
    • Brandy ●●●●●Brandy foretells wealth and distinction, but without the grace that wins true friendship.
    • Brass ●●●●●Brass foretells a fast but fragile rise, faithlessness, or a legacy.
    • Bray ●●●●●Hearing a donkey bray foretells unwelcome news or intrusions.
    • Bread ●●●●●Bread is an excellent sign of comfort and harmony, unless it is moldy.
    • Break ●●●●●Breaking things in a dream foretells mismanagement, quarrels and loss.
    • Breakfast ●●●●●A shared breakfast is favorable; eaten alone, it hides a trap.
    • Breast ●●●●●Breasts speak of fertility and gain, but also of losses and health to watch.
    • Breath ●●●●●Sweet breath foretells good conduct and good deals; foul or lost breath, illness and failure.
    • Brewing ●●●●●Brewing foretells worry at first that ends in profit, but also calls for action.
    • Brewing and baking ●●●●●This dream points to idleness: dreaming instead of getting things done.
    • Briars ●●●●●Being caught in briars foretells slander and quarrels, but getting free brings loyal friends.
    • Briars and brambles ●●●●●Passing through brambles foretells trouble and hidden enemies, but coming out unscathed promises triumph.
    • Brick ●●●●●Bricks foretell unsettled business and disagreements in love.
    • Bride ●●●●●A bride mostly foretells inheritance, reconciliation and friendship, unless she looks sad or indifferent.
    • Bridge ●●●●●Crossing a bridge foretells success; going under it or seeing it give way, trouble and danger.
    • Bridle ●●●●●A bridle foretells a worrying but rewarding venture, unless it is worn or blinkered.
    • Bridle bits ●●●●●Bridle bits foretell that you will overcome obstacles, unless they break.
    • Brimstone ●●●●●Brimstone warns against shady dealings and a risk of contagion.
    • Bronchitis ●●●●●Bronchitis foretells plans delayed by illness at home and discouraging prospects.
    • Bronze ●●●●●Bronze foretells love with no future, envy and an uncertain fortune.
    • Brood ●●●●●A brood foretells heavy family duties for some and growing wealth for others.
    • Broom ●●●●●A new broom foretells thrift and progress; used or lost, losses and disorder.
    • Broth ●●●●●Broth foretells sincere friends, lasting love and profit.
    • Brothel ●●●●●A brothel warns of disgrace brought on by your own indulgence.
    • Brother ●●●●●A brother foretells joy if he is thriving, but loss or grief if he is in distress.
    • Brush ●●●●●A brush foretells, depending on its use, mismanagement, heavy tasks or well- paid work.
    • Buckle ●●●●●Buckles foretell many invitations, at the risk of throwing your affairs into chaos.
    • Buffalo ●●●●●A buffalo foretells powerful but dull-witted opponents, whom diplomacy can outwit.
    • Bugle ●●●●●A bugle heralds unusual happiness and lucky dealings.
    • Bugs ●●●●●Bugs foretell repulsive complications and health worries.
    • Building ●●●●●A building foretells new acquaintances, a move or a prosperous life, unless it is run-down.
    • Bull ●●●●●A bull mostly foretells rivalry, rumors and threats from the powerful, but a white bull is favorable.
    • Bulldog ●●●●●A hostile bulldog warns against the temptation to cheat; a friendly one, a rise in life.
    • Bullock ●●●●●A bullock foretells kind friends and good health.
    • Bundle of firewood ●●●●●A bundle of firewood in a dream is about threats and danger: thick smoke means enemies, a bright flame means escape.
    • Burden ●●●●●Carrying a burden foretells worry and injustice, but breaking free leads to the top.
    • Burglars ●●●●●Burglars foretell dangerous enemies and attacks on your standing, which courage can repel.
    • Burial ●●●●●A burial in sunshine foretells health and a wedding; in rain, illness and bad news.
    • Buried alive ●●●●●Being buried alive foretells either a serious mistake or, in another tradition, wealth and power.
    • Burned ●●●●●Being burned foretells wealth and honor, unless the fire only half consumes you.
    • Burning ●●●●●A burning dream is about upheaval: depending on how fierce the fire is, it points to gain or loss, and warns of a danger that can still be dodged.
    • Burns ●●●●●Surprisingly, being burned in a dream mostly signals good news, honest intentions and the strength to do what others cannot.
    • Burr ●●●●●Clinging burrs point to a tiresome burden you want to shake off, and a longing for new surroundings.
    • Business ●●●●●Being swamped with business in a dream promises unexpected luck, and even business going badly is a good sign.
    • Butcher ●●●●●The butcher is a dark omen of illness, grief, criticism and hardship, with one favorable exception for people who raise livestock.
    • Butter ●●●●●Butter is about health and comfort: fresh butter promises prosperity and plans that work out, rancid butter a living earned by hard work.
    • Butterfly ●●●●●The butterfly is a bright omen of prosperity, news from absent friends, happiness and love that lasts.
    • Buttermilk ●●●●●Drinking buttermilk mostly signals regret after pleasure, rash behavior and quarrels, with some hope of making peace and getting well.
    • Buttons ●●●●●Buttons mostly point to losses and letdowns, except bright buttons sewn onto a uniform, which promise love or a fine career.
    • Buying ●●●●●Buying things in a dream is mostly a good sign, but for the well-off it mainly points to expenses.
    • Buzzard ●●●●●The buzzard mostly signals gossip and scandal, which you can sometimes smooth over.

    C

    • Cab ●●●●●A cab points to a busy life and modest prosperity, but also to secrets and the risk of gossip.
    • Cabbage ●●●●●Cabbage is a bad omen: disorder, infidelity, overspending and bad news from far away.
    • Cabin ●●●●●Being in a ship's cabin warns of trouble brewing, most notably a lawsuit you could lose.
    • Cable ●●●●●A cable points to a risky but promising venture, and an important message that will stir up talk.
    • Cackle ●●●●●Hearing hens cackle signals a shock: bad news nearby, and hardship brought on by illness.
    • Cage ●●●●●A cage is about what you hold and what holds you: full of birds it promises wealth and a happy family; empty, it signals a loss.
    • Cain ●●●●●Cain is a very unfavorable omen, a nudge to move on and make new connections.
    • Cakes ●●●●●Cakes are an omen of happiness, well-placed affection and prosperity, with one exception: the wedding cake.
    • Calendar ●●●●●A calendar is about order: keeping one promises a well-organized year, looking at one a miscalculation.
    • Calf ●●●●●A calf is a sign of good luck.
    • California ●●●●●California cuts both ways: setting out for it signals misfortune, while being there and liking it promises a gift or inheritance.
    • Hearing your name ●●●●●Hearing your name called is a warning: shaky business, worry for a loved one, or a misunderstanding in love.
    • Calm ●●●●●Calm promises a happy end to an uncertain venture, and a long, serene life.
    • Calomel ●●●●●This old-fashioned remedy signals deceit: someone is trying to harm you, using your friends without their knowing it.
    • Calumny ●●●●●Being slandered in a dream warns that ill-natured gossips will damage your interests, so tread carefully.
    • Calves ●●●●●Peaceful calves promise festivities, enjoyment and growing wealth.
    • Camels ●●●●●The camel is about endurance: it signals heavy trials, but also the patience to get through them and unexpected help.
    • Cameo brooch ●●●●●A cameo brooch signals that something sad will soon need your attention.
    • Camera ●●●●●A camera signals changes that will land you in surroundings you don't deserve, and disappointment from a friend.
    • Camp ●●●●●Camping in a dream points to change and a long journey, with mixed prospects in love.
    • Campaign ●●●●●Campaigning in a dream is about independence: you will go your own way despite opposition.
    • Canal ●●●●●A canal depends on its water: clear water promises a peaceful life and loyal friends, murky water illness and confusion.
    • Canary ●●●●●The canary signals unexpected pleasures, honors and happy friendships, with a warning against illusions.
    • Cancer ●●●●●Cancer is an omen of grief, illness and quarrels, with one exception: being cured of it promises a sudden rise in fortune.
    • Candles ●●●●●A clear, steady candle flame promises loyalty, happiness and good news; a flickering or dying flame signals sadness and disappointment.
    • Candlestick ●●●●●A candlestick holding a candle promises a bright future; an empty one signals the opposite.
    • Candy ●●●●●Candy mostly signals pleasure, romance, a peaceful home and prosperity, unless it is sour.
    • Cane ●●●●●A cane is mostly a bad omen, except growing cane, which shows fortune on the way.
    • Canker ●●●●●Canker is an omen of evil, betrayal and loneliness, with one odd exception: growths in the flesh are said to foretell distinction.
    • Cannon ●●●●●A cannon signals threat, struggle and betrayal, though a hard-fought business may still come good.
    • Cannon-ball ●●●●●A cannon-ball warns of secret enemies joining forces against you, and of a call to duty.
    • Cannonball ●●●●●A cannonball is an omen of misfortune.
    • Canoe ●●●●●A canoe is about steering and love: on calm water it promises success and fidelity; on rough or muddy water, trouble.
    • Canopy ●●●●●A canopy warns of false friends nudging you toward dubious ways of making money.
    • Cap ●●●●●A cap can mean a party, shyness, marriage or an inheritance, but also secrets coming out.
    • Capon ●●●●●A crowing capon signals sadness and trouble.
    • Captain ●●●●●A captain promises that your highest aims will be met, though in love it can stir up jealousy.
    • Captive ●●●●●Captivity signals betrayal and misfortune if you can't escape, and questionable company if you are the one taking a captive.
    • Cardinal ●●●●●Seeing a cardinal in robes signals setbacks that will force you to start over far away, and warns of a moral danger.
    • Cards ●●●●●Playing cards in a dream is mostly about love and marriage and hopes coming true, as long as you aren't playing for money.
    • Carnival ●●●●●A carnival promises unusual fun, but masks and grotesque figures signal discord and disappointment.
    • Carpenter ●●●●●Seeing carpenters at work signals honest effort to improve your lot.
    • Carpet ●●●●●A carpet is an omen of profit, comfort and well-off friends.
    • Carriage ●●●●●A carriage promises success, visits and good health, unless it breaks down.
    • Carriage and retinue ●●●●●Owning a fine carriage with attendants in a dream promises complete happiness and every wish fulfilled.
    • Carrion ●●●●●Carrion signals sadness.
    • Carrot ●●●●●Carrots promise prosperity, health and strength, especially in a dispute over an inheritance.
    • Carrying ●●●●●Carrying someone is better than being carried; beyond that, it depends on who carries you.
    • Railway or street ●●●●●Cars point to travel and quick changes, with successes but also rivalry and risk.
    • Cart ●●●●●A cart is about labor and servitude, but driving it or being carried in it is far luckier.
    • Cartridge ●●●●●Cartridges signal quarrels and discord, and a threat to you or someone close.
    • Carving ●●●●●Carving a bird or a roast points to lean times and bad investments, with hope if you change course.
    • Cash ●●●●●Having plenty of borrowed cash warns of a generous front and a deception that will eventually show.
    • Cash box ●●●●●A full cash box opens good prospects; an empty one signals slim returns.
    • Cashier ●●●●●A cashier signals that others will lay claim to what's yours, and warns against the temptation to deceive.
    • Cask ●●●●●A full cask means prosperous times and feasting; an empty one a life without joy or comfort.
    • Castle ●●●●●A castle promises wealth and travel, but an old castle calls for caution in love, and leaving one signals a loss.
    • Castor oil ●●●●●Castor oil is a warning: you may turn against a friend who is quietly helping you.
    • Castoria ●●●●●This old children's remedy signals an important duty left undone and a fortune seemingly in decline.
    • Catechism ●●●●●The catechism signals a well-paid offer, but with strings that will make you hesitate.
    • Caterpillar ●●●●●The caterpillar signals hypocrites, hidden enemies and embarrassing situations.
    • Cathedral ●●●●●Gazing at a cathedral betrays longing for the unattainable, but entering one promises a rise in life among wise and learned people.
    • Cats ●●●●●The cat mostly signals bad luck, hidden hostility and betrayal, unless you manage to drive it off or kill it.
    • Cattle ●●●●●Fat, contented cattle promise prosperity, a happy marriage and success; lean cattle, toil and scarcity.
    • Cauliflower ●●●●●Cauliflower signals criticism for neglected duties, but also brighter days after a run of losses.
    • Cavalry ●●●●●Cavalry signals advancement and distinction, with a little stir along the way.
    • Cave ●●●●●A cave signals perplexity, change and drifting apart from people you love.
    • Cavern ●●●●●A cavern is read the same way as a grotto.
    • Cedars ●●●●●Green, shapely cedars signal success; dead or blighted ones, despair.
    • Celery ●●●●●Fresh celery promises prosperity, influence and love; rotting celery signals a death in the family.
    • Celery ●●●●●Celery is a good omen, for success in business and in love.
    • Celestial signs ●●●●●Signs in the sky point to unhappy events, ill-timed journeys and strain in love and business.
    • Cellar ●●●●●A cold, damp cellar signals doubt, low spirits and loss; a well-stocked one offers profits of doubtful origin.
    • Cemetery ●●●●●A cemetery doesn't necessarily mean death: well kept and in bloom, it promises recovery, health and happy changes; neglected, it speaks of loneliness.
    • Chaff ●●●●●Chaff signals a fruitless undertaking, health worries and time wasted on gossip.
    • Chain ●●●●●A chain is about ties: gold or as jewelry it signals a marriage; as fetters, unfair burdens you can break free of.
    • Chair ●●●●●A chair signals a missed obligation and a risk of losing your place, but sitting in one promises a growing family or better times.
    • Chair maker ●●●●●A chair maker signals worry arising from work that seems pleasant.
    • Chairperson ●●●●●The chair of an assembly signals advancement and a position of trust, unless they look out of sorts.
    • Chalice ●●●●●A chalice signals pleasure gained at someone else's expense; breaking one, failing to gain sway over a friend.
    • Chalk ●●●●●Chalk brings public honors when you write on a board, but bad luck on a blackboard and disappointment when your hands are full of it.
    • Challenge ●●●●●Being challenged signals a social difficulty that calls for apologies; accepting a challenge, sacrifices made to protect others.
    • Chamber ●●●●●A beautiful, richly furnished bedroom signals sudden fortune; a plain one, modest comfort.
    • Chambermaid ●●●●●A chambermaid signals bad luck and decided changes, and an indiscreet flirtation would make you a laughingstock.
    • Chameleon ●●●●●The chameleon stands for deceit and self-serving ambition, including in love.
    • Champion ●●●●●A champion promises a warm friendship won through your dignity and integrity.
    • Chandelier ●●●●●A chandelier promises unhoped-for success and luxury, unless it's broken or goes dark.
    • Chapel ●●●●●A chapel signals discord, unsettled business and, for the young, deceptive romances.
    • Charcoal ●●●●●Unlit charcoal signals misery and bleakness; glowing charcoal, rising fortune and pure joy.
    • Chariot ●●●●●Riding a chariot signals good opportunities, if you use them well; falling from one, a loss of standing.
    • Charity ●●●●●Giving charity in a dream mostly signals demands, losses and worry; receiving it, by contrast, promises success after hard times.
    • Chastise ●●●●●Being punished signals carelessness; punishing someone points to an ill- tempered partner, though children turn out well regardless.
    • Cheated ●●●●●Being cheated warns of schemers trying to block your path, and of misunderstandings in love.
    • Checkers ●●●●●Playing checkers signals serious difficulties and ill-meaning strangers, though winning promises success in a doubtful venture.
    • Checks ●●●●●Receiving checks signals bills paid and an inheritance; paying them out, losses; passing bad checks, subterfuge.
    • Cheeks ●●●●●Full, rosy cheeks are a good sign; thin, pale, wrinkled ones signal grief and heaviness.
    • Cheese ●●●●●Traditions disagree on cheese: disappointment and sorrow in one, profit in trade in another, with a risk of deceit in love.
    • Chemise ●●●●●A chemise signals unflattering gossip about you.
    • Cherries ●●●●●Cherries mostly signal popularity, good news and wishes fulfilled, though one tradition sees disappointment in love.
    • Cherubs ●●●●●Cherubs signal a deep, lasting joy, unless they look sad or reproachful.
    • Chess ●●●●●Playing chess signals stagnation and quarrels, but winning promises you'll overcome hostile influences.
    • Chestnuts ●●●●●Chestnuts signal some losses or passing sorrow, but a pleasant companion, luck in love and happiness in the end.
    • Chicken ●●●●●Chickens mostly signal worries, losses and deceit, though young chicks promise ventures that pay off with hard work.
    • Chiffonier ●●●●●Rummaging through a chiffonier signals letdowns; seeing one tidy, pleasant friends and entertainment.
    • Chilblain ●●●●●Chilblains signal a bad deal pushed on you by a worried friend or partner, and illness or an accident.
    • Child ●●●●●Dreaming of children is a good sign, and being about to have a child promises a rich inheritance or other luck.
    • Childbirth ●●●●●Giving birth in a dream signals happy circumstances and a safe delivery, except when you're single.
    • Children ●●●●●Beautiful children signal prosperity and blessings; sick, sad or neglected children, worries and betrayal.
    • Chimes ●●●●●Chimes signal good prospects and welcome news from distant friends.
    • Chimney ●●●●●Chimneys mostly signal unpleasant incidents and news of illness, but a good fire in the hearth promises much good.
    • China ●●●●●Painting or arranging your china signals a pleasant home and thrifty household management.
    • China shop ●●●●●An empty china shop signals business setbacks and a gloomy stretch.
    • Chocolate ●●●●●Chocolate mostly speaks of generosity and prosperity, with a warning about gossip.
    • Choir ●●●●●A choir promises cheerfulness returning after a gloomy stretch.
    • Cholera ●●●●●Cholera in a dream warns of illness and disappointment.
    • Christ ●●●●●Seeing Christ in a dream mostly promises peace and the triumph of good, except at Gethsemane.
    • Christening ●●●●●Attending a christening is a good omen: what you hope for will come.
    • Christmas tree ●●●●●A Christmas tree promises joyful times and good luck, as long as it stays up.
    • Chrysanthemum ●●●●●White chrysanthemums speak of loss and sadness; coloured ones of pleasant meetings.
    • Church ●●●●●A church is usually an ill omen, unless you're praying in it.
    • Churchyard ●●●●●A churchyard foretells either hardship and distance or a long, happy life, depending on the season.
    • Churning ●●●●●Churning foretells hard tasks that your perseverance will turn into prosperity.
    • Cider ●●●●●Cider promises fortune, provided you don't waste your time on pleasure.
    • Cigar ●●●●●Smoking a cigar warns of business trouble and losses, and is a bad sign in love.
    • Cipher ●●●●●Reading a code foretells a love of study and learning.
    • Circle ●●●●●A circle warns of deceptive gains and rash attachments.
    • Cistern ●●●●●A cistern warns against overstepping on others, and, when empty, of happiness turning to sorrow.
    • City ●●●●●Finding yourself in a strange city foretells an unwanted change in your life.
    • City council ●●●●●A city council foretells clashes with institutions and a discouraging outlook.
    • City hall ●●●●●A city hall foretells disputes and threatened lawsuits.
    • Clairvoyance ●●●●●Clairvoyance foretells upheaval and unhappy relationships.
    • Clams ●●●●●Clams speak of solid relationships and sharing, in business and in love.
    • Claret ●●●●●Drinking claret foretells uplifting company; broken bottles, bad influences.
    • Claret cup and punch ●●●●●Claret cup or punch foretells pleasant attention from new acquaintances.
    • Clarinet ●●●●●A clarinet foretells a moment of frivolity, and a falling-out if it's broken.
    • Clay ●●●●●Clay foretells isolation, money trouble and misdirected effort.
    • Clergyman ●●●●●A clergyman foretells trials you'll struggle against in vain.
    • Climb ●●●●●Climbing foretells a rise: honours or better circumstances.
    • Climbing ●●●●●Climbing is about obstacles: everything depends on whether you reach the top.
    • Clock ●●●●●A clock splits the old readings: danger and bad news for some, a coming wedding for others.
    • Cloister ●●●●●A cloister points to a wish for new surroundings, and to a sorrow that makes you less self-centred.
    • Clothes ●●●●●Clothes mirror your fortunes: clean and new means prosperity, dirty or torn means deceit.
    • Clothing ●●●●●Clothing follows the readings given for apparel.
    • Clouds ●●●●●Clouds change meaning with their colour: bright ones foretell prosperity, dark ones trouble.
    • Cloven foot ●●●●●A cloven foot warns of unusual bad luck and of trusting strangers.
    • Clover ●●●●●Clover is a favourable dream of prosperity, unless it's withered or hides a snake.
    • Club ●●●●●A club foretells victory over your opponents if you're threatened, but a rough trip if you're the one striking.
    • Coach ●●●●●Riding in a coach is an unlucky omen of losses and setbacks.
    • Coach driver ●●●●●A coach driver foretells an unusual journey in search of fortune and happiness.
    • Coal ●●●●●Coal means different things depending on whether it's burning or dead, and the readings disagree.
    • Coal mine ●●●●●A coal mine foretells a threat to your standing, unless you own a share in it.
    • Coal pit ●●●●●A coal pit foretells marriage to a widowed person whose depths you'll never fully fathom.
    • Coal scuttle ●●●●●A coal scuttle foretells sorrow after reckless spending.
    • Coat ●●●●●A coat speaks of friendship and fortune: new, it brings honour; torn or lost, it means losses.
    • Coat of arms ●●●●●A coat of arms is an unlucky dream: the title you hope for won't come.
    • Coca-cola ●●●●●Drinking Coca-Cola warns against overindulgence at the cost of health and good opportunities.
    • Rooster ●●●●●A rooster in a dream mostly points to prosperity and, for anyone hoping to marry, a promising match.
    • Rooster Crowing ●●●●●A rooster's crow is good news at dawn but a sign of tears when heard at night.
    • Cock-crowing ●●●●●A cockade in a dream warns of opponents who may drag you into damaging lawsuits.
    • Cockade ●●●●●Drinking a cocktail in a dream hints at a double life: a serious front and a hidden taste for partying.
    • Cocoa ●●●●●Cocoa in a dream is about friendships kept up out of self-interest.
    • Coconut ●●●●●Coconuts in a dream warn of false friends undermining your hopes.
    • Coffee ●●●●●Coffee in a dream mostly signals disagreements and threats to your reputation, with a few victories over hardship.
    • Coffee grinder ●●●●●A coffee grinder signals a serious danger that will take all your energy to avert.
    • Coffee house ●●●●●A coffee house in a dream warns against unwise friendliness toward people who are against you.
    • Coffin ●●●●●A coffin is an unlucky dream, tied to bereavement, debt and failure.
    • Coins ●●●●●Coins bring prosperity or hardship depending on whether they are gold, silver or copper.
    • Coke ●●●●●Coke in a dream foretells trouble and discord in the near future.
    • Coke oven ●●●●●A burning coke oven foretells unexpected luck born of a failure.
    • Cold ●●●●●Suffering from cold in a dream warns you to watch your affairs and your health.
    • Collar ●●●●●A collar in a dream speaks of unearned honours and insincere admirers.
    • College ●●●●●College in a dream foretells a long-sought promotion and recognition for your work.
    • Collision ●●●●●A collision in a dream foretells an accident and disappointment, or a hard choice in love.
    • Colonel ●●●●●A colonel in a dream is about standing: being under one holds you back, being one lifts you up.
    • Combat ●●●●●Combat in a dream speaks of struggles to stay on firm ground, especially in complicated love.
    • Combing Your Hair ●●●●●Combing your hair in a dream can signal a loved one's illness, or, on the contrary, a way out of hard times.
    • Comedy ●●●●●A comedy in a dream points to light, sometimes fleeting pleasures, and good news in business and love.
    • Comet ●●●●●A comet foretells sudden trials that courage can turn into fame.
    • Comfort ●●●●●Being comforted in a dream foretells the reverse of your situation: trouble if all is well, help if things are hard.
    • Comic songs ●●●●●Comic songs in a dream speak of pleasures that make you miss serious opportunities.
    • Command ●●●●●Giving or receiving orders in a dream is about honour, humiliation and power.
    • Commandment ●●●●●Commandments in a dream warn against others' influence and mistakes that are hard to undo.
    • Commerce ●●●●●Commerce in a dream mirrors your affairs: well handled if you take part, threatened if all is collapsing.
    • Committee ●●●●●A committee in a dream foretells thankless tasks pressed on you.
    • Companion ●●●●●A companion in a dream points to small worries or distractions that pull you from your duties.
    • Compass ●●●●●A compass in a dream foretells hard but honourable progress and the support of honest people.
    • Completion ●●●●●Finishing a task in a dream foretells comfort and the freedom to live as you please.
    • Complexion ●●●●●Complexion in a dream brings luck when it is clear and lovely, disappointment when it is dull or sickly.
    • Composing stick ●●●●●A printer's composing stick in a dream foretells difficult problems.
    • Concert ●●●●●A fine concert foretells pleasure, success and health; a mediocre one, disappointing company.
    • Mistress ●●●●●A mistress in a dream warns of secrets, scandal and behaviour that backfires.
    • Confectionery ●●●●●Spoiled confectionery in a dream warns of a false friend after your secrets.
    • Confetti ●●●●●Confetti blocking your view warns against putting pleasure ahead of duty.
    • Conflagration ●●●●●A great fire with no lives lost foretells beneficial changes.
    • Conjurer ●●●●●A conjurer in a dream foretells unpleasant experiences in your search for wealth and happiness.
    • Hypnotism ●●●●●Hypnotism in a dream is about control: being under it is dangerous, wielding it shows strong will.
    • Conscience ●●●●●Your conscience in a dream warns of temptation, or promises esteem when it is at peace.
    • Conspiracy ●●●●●Being the target of a conspiracy in a dream foretells a wrong move in managing your affairs.
    • Tuberculosis ●●●●●Having consumption in a dream signals that you are putting yourself in danger.
    • Contempt ●●●●●Contempt in a dream can, surprisingly, foretell esteem, unless it is deserved.
    • Convent ●●●●●Seeking refuge in a convent foretells a peaceful future, unless a priest meets you there.
    • Convention ●●●●●A convention in a dream foretells brisk business and a commitment in love, unless it is discordant.
    • Convicted ●●●●●This dream is read like one of being accused: it speaks of judgement and blame.
    • Convicts ●●●●●Convicts in a dream bring bad news, but being one yourself promises that things will be cleared up.
    • Cook ●●●●●A cook in a dream foretells a wedding and well-being, but also secrets coming out.
    • Cooking ●●●●●Cooking in a dream foretells a pleasant duty and visits from friends, if the mood is good.
    • Cooking stove ●●●●●A cooking stove in a dream foretells that your timely action will ease many troubles.
    • Cooling board ●●●●●A cooling board foretells illness and quarrels, but also troubles that can be overcome.
    • Copper ●●●●●Copper in a dream points to pressure from those above you and deceit in love.
    • Copper plate ●●●●●A copper plate in a dream warns of disagreements disturbing household peace.
    • Copperas ●●●●●Copperas in a dream foretells an unintended wrong that will cost you.
    • Coppersmith ●●●●●A coppersmith in a dream foretells modest pay but genuine contentment.
    • Copying ●●●●●Copying in a dream foretells that well-tried plans will go wrong.
    • Coral ●●●●●Coloured coral foretells loyal friendship; white coral, unfaithfulness.
    • Cords ●●●●●Cords are read like the dream of ropes, which is about ties and entanglements.
    • Cork ●●●●●Corks in a dream mostly point to prosperity and a well-ordered life.
    • Corkscrew ●●●●●A corkscrew in a dream signals restless desires that may lead you onto dangerous ground.
    • Corn ●●●●●Grain foretells abundance and happiness; foot corns, trouble, unless you get rid of them.
    • Corn and cornfield ●●●●●A lush cornfield foretells wealth, harmony and fulfilled wishes.
    • Corner ●●●●●A corner in a dream suggests fear, whispering and betrayal.
    • Cornet ●●●●●A cornet in a dream foretells kindness from strangers.
    • Cornmeal ●●●●●Cornmeal foretells wishes fulfilled, but also the risk of standing in your own way.
    • Coronation ●●●●●A coronation foretells friendships with prominent people and surprising favours.
    • Corpse ●●●●●A corpse in a dream mostly brings sad news and setbacks, though one reading sees long life in it.
    • Corpulence ●●●●●Corpulence in a dream foretells prosperity, unless it becomes grotesque.
    • Corset ●●●●●A corset in a dream suggests puzzlement over attention received and a quarrelsome mood.
    • Cossack ●●●●●A Cossack in a dream foretells personal humiliation brought on by excess and extravagance.
    • Cot ●●●●●A cot in a dream foretells hardship through illness or accident, sometimes shared with friends.
    • Cotton ●●●●●Cotton in a dream foretells prosperity and a general upturn in business.
    • Cotton cap ●●●●●A cotton cap in a dream foretells many sincere friends.
    • Cotton cloth ●●●●●Cotton cloth foretells easy circumstances and a modest but happy home.
    • Cotton gin ●●●●●A cotton gin foretells a step toward fortune, unless it is broken down.
    • Couch ●●●●●Lying on a couch in a dream warns against false hopes.
    • Cough ●●●●●A cough in a dream signals fragile health, from which you will recover with good habits.
    • Counselor ●●●●●A counselor in a dream highlights your own abilities, and your habit of trusting only yourself.
    • Face ●●●●●A face in a dream brings pleasure if it is lovely and open, trouble if it is ugly and scowling.
    • Counter ●●●●●A counter in a dream foretells a busy life, or worries if it is empty and dirty.
    • Counterfeit money ●●●●●Counterfeit money in a dream is always an ill omen, whether you receive it or pass it.
    • Bedspread ●●●●●A clean white bedspread foretells pleasant occupations; a dirty one, harassment and often illness.
    • Counting ●●●●●Counting in a dream is lucky when it's for yourself, unlucky when it's for others.
    • Countryside ●●●●●Fertile countryside foretells prosperous times; barren land, scarcity and hardship.
    • Courtship ●●●●●Courting or being courted in a dream mostly foretells dashed hopes and vexation.
    • Cousin ●●●●●A cousin in a dream foretells disappointments and family sorrow.
    • Cows ●●●●●Cows in a dream foretell prosperity, wealth and fulfilled wishes.
    • Cowslip ●●●●●Cowslips in a dream foretell the end of warm friendships and crises at home.
    • Coxcomb ●●●●●A coxcomb in a dream points to a petty frame of mind worth rising above.
    • Crabs ●●●●●Crabs in a dream foretell complicated affairs that will call for sound judgement.
    • Cradle ●●●●●A cradle mostly foretells family happiness and long life, with a few worries.
    • Crane ●●●●●Cranes in flight foretell gloomy business heading north and joyful reunions heading south.
    • Mourning crepe ●●●●●Mourning crape foretells sad news, sorrow and separation.
    • Crawl ●●●●●Crawling in a dream foretells humiliation and missed chances, unless you crawl on a roof.
    • Crayfish ●●●●●The crayfish, which walks backward, foretells deceit in love.
    • Cream ●●●●●Cream in a dream foretells wealth, good luck and, in love, a coming union.
    • Credit ●●●●●Credit in a dream, asked for or given, calls for caution.
    • Creek ●●●●●A creek foretells new experiences and short trips, with brief trouble if it overflows.
    • Cremation ●●●●●Cremation in a dream foretells loss of influence and failure, especially if you follow others' judgement.
    • Crew ●●●●●A crew in a dream foretells a missed journey or disaster.
    • Cricket ●●●●●A cricket in a dream foretells sad news and hardship.
    • Cries ●●●●●Cries in a dream foretell trouble, or unexpected help, depending on their nature.
    • Criminal ●●●●●A criminal in a dream warns of dubious company and dangerous secrets.
    • Disabled ●●●●●Seeing disabled people in a dream foretells hard times and a call to generosity.
    • Crochet ●●●●●Doing crochet in a dream warns of too much curiosity and careless confidences.
    • Crockery ●●●●●Clean, plentiful crockery foretells a well-kept home and profitable business.
    • Crocodile ●●●●●A crocodile in a dream foretells deceit, even from your closest friends.
    • Cross ●●●●●A cross in a dream foretells trouble and sadness.
    • Cross purposes ●●●●●Playing cross purposes in a dream foretells prosperity, joy and harmony among loved ones.
    • Crossbones ●●●●●Crossbones foretell harmful influence, but also fears that will prove groundless.
    • Crossroads ●●●●●A crossroads in a dream is about an important decision to make, in business or love.
    • Croup ●●●●●A child's croup in a dream brings needless fear and actually signals health and harmony.
    • Crow ●●●●●A crow in a dream mostly signals misfortune and grief, though it can also mean business moving quickly.
    • Crowd ●●●●●A crowd in a dream is usually good, unless the gathering is spoiled or too many wear black.
    • Crowing ●●●●●Crowing is unlucky, especially in love, but the cooing of pigeons promises happiness.
    • Crown ●●●●●A crown foretells change and elevation, but also losses depending on how it appears.
    • Crucifix ●●●●●A crucifix foretells shared trouble, accepted with resignation, and rewards kindness.
    • Crucifixion ●●●●●The Crucifixion in a dream foretells lost opportunities and shattered hopes.
    • Cruelty ●●●●●Cruelty in a dream, suffered or inflicted, foretells setbacks and loss.
    • Crust ●●●●●A crust of bread in a dream warns that carelessness may lead to want.
    • Crutches ●●●●●Crutches in a dream speak of dependence and infirmity, but breaking them signals recovery.
    • Crying ●●●●●Crying in a dream foretells illusory pleasures that will turn to gloom.
    • Crystal ●●●●●Crystal in a dream foretells a downturn in relationships or business, and disappointment in people you admire.
    • Cuckoo ●●●●●A cuckoo in a dream foretells the sudden end of a happy life or a loved one's illness.
    • Cucumber ●●●●●Cucumbers in a dream foretell health, recovery and happy love, with moderate business success.
    • Cunning ●●●●●Cunning in a dream is about pretence: yours to please, or others' to exploit you.
    • Cupboard ●●●●●A cupboard in a dream foretells comfort or want, depending on whether it is clean and full or empty and dirty.
    • Curb ●●●●●Stepping up onto a curb foretells a quick rise; falling off one, a reversal of fortune.
    • Currants ●●●●●Currants in a dream foretell happiness and success, except white ones, which signal trouble for your partner.
    • Currycomb ●●●●●A currycomb in a dream foretells great effort needed to reach wealth and comfort.
    • Curtains ●●●●●Curtains in a dream foretell unwelcome visitors, and quarrels if they are dirty or torn.
    • Cushion ●●●●●Cushions in a dream foretell prosperity and love, unless your comfort comes at others' expense.
    • Custard ●●●●●Custard foretells an unexpected guest or a new friendship, unless it tastes bad.
    • Customs house ●●●●●A customs house in a dream is about rivalry and coveted positions, won or lost.
    • Cut ●●●●●A cut in a dream foretells illness or a friend's betrayal that will spoil your cheer.
    • Cymbal ●●●●●Hearing a cymbal in a dream foretells the death of an elderly acquaintance and a gloomy time.
    • Cypress ●●●●●A cypress in a dream foretells trouble in business.

    D

    • Dagger ●●●●●A dagger in a dream signals threatening enemies, but also the chance to beat them and hopes fulfilled.
    • Dahlia ●●●●●Fresh, bright dahlias foretell good luck and quick prosperity.
    • Dairy ●●●●●A dairy in a dream is an excellent omen, for work, love and harvests.
    • Daisy ●●●●●Daisies in season foretell happiness and health; out of season, trouble.
    • Damask rose ●●●●●The damask rose foretells a wedding in the family and fulfilled hopes, but sometimes deceit.
    • Damson ●●●●●A damson tree laden with fruit foretells wealth, but eating damsons brings grief.
    • Dance ●●●●●A dance in a dream foretells a cheerful home, pleasures and unexpected good luck.
    • Dance teacher ●●●●●A dance teacher in a dream warns against frivolity, but also points to a like- minded friendship.
    • Dancing ●●●●●Dancing in a dream foretells joyful news and happiness in love, unless you dance somewhere high.
    • Dandelion ●●●●●Dandelions in bloom foretell happy unions, but gathering them points to hidden enemies.
    • Danger ●●●●●Being in danger in a dream often foretells success and deliverance, unless you are overcome.
    • Dark ●●●●●Darkness in a dream foretells trials, unless the sun breaks through before the journey ends.
    • Darkness ●●●●●Being in darkness in a dream is unfavourable, but coming out into the light is an excellent omen.
    • Dates ●●●●●Dates on the tree foretell prosperity and a happy union; eaten, want and enemies.
    • Daughter ●●●●●Dreaming of your daughter foretells that annoyances will give way to harmony, unless she disappoints you.
    • Daughter-in-law ●●●●●Dreaming of your daughter-in-law foretells an unusual event, happy or troubling depending on whether she is pleasant.
    • David ●●●●●David of the Bible, in a dream, foretells family divisions and unsettled affairs.
    • Day ●●●●●A clear day foretells better circumstances and a long, happy life; a gloomy one, failure.
    • Daybreak ●●●●●Daybreak in a dream foretells success in everything you undertake.
    • Dead ●●●●●Dreaming of the dead is often a warning, but can also foretell reunions or a clear conscience.
    • Death ●●●●●Death in a dream sometimes brings sadness and bad news, but often a wedding, long life or loved ones in good health.
    • Debt ●●●●●Debt in a dream foretells worries, unless you have enough to pay it off.
    • December ●●●●●A December dream points to growing wealth, but also to a friendship that cools.
    • Deck ●●●●●On a ship's deck, everything hangs on the sea: a storm warns of setbacks, calm water opens the way to success.
    • Decorate ●●●●●Decorating a place for a celebration points to good business and happy times, unless it's a grave you're adorning.
    • Deed ●●●●●Signing a deed in a dream warns of a lawsuit or a commitment that could turn against you.
    • Deer ●●●●●Deer speak of sincere friendships and a peaceful life, but hunting or killing one turns sour.
    • Delay ●●●●●Being held up in a dream warns that someone may be trying to slow your progress.
    • Delight ●●●●●Feeling delight in a dream signals a happy turn in your affairs.
    • Demand ●●●●●A pressing demand in a dream points to an awkward moment that your persistence will see you through.
    • Demand for payment ●●●●●Being dunned for a debt urges you to put your affairs in order, though it may also mean money is on its way.
    • Demons ●●●●●Seeing the devil or another infernal creature was held to be one of the worst dreams of all.
    • Dentist ●●●●●A dentist in a dream raises doubts about someone's sincerity, or warns of a scandal close by.
    • Derrick ●●●●●A derrick in a dream points to conflict and obstacles on the way to success.
    • Desert ●●●●●Wandering through a barren desert warns of scarcity and heavy losses, and calls for caution.
    • Desk ●●●●●Working at a desk warns of a setback, but money lying on it brings unexpected relief.
    • Despair ●●●●●Despair in a dream warns of harsh troubles at work and worries for those close to you.
    • Detective ●●●●●Being trailed by a detective bodes well if you're innocent, but badly if you feel guilty.
    • Devil ●●●●●The devil in a dream warns of dangers and temptations you'll overcome if you stand firm.
    • Devotion ●●●●●Devotion in a dream foretells plenty and peace, and reminds you that nothing is gained by deceit.
    • Dew ●●●●●Dew sparkling in the sun promises honor and wealth, but feeling it fall on you warns of fever.
    • Diadem ●●●●●A diadem in a dream means an honor is about to be offered to you.
    • Diamonds ●●●●●Owning diamonds brings honor and recognition, but losing them is one of the worst omens.
    • Dice ●●●●●Dice give mixed omens: playing yourself brings luck, but merely seeing them warns of bad speculation.
    • Dictionary ●●●●●Looking something up in a dictionary suggests you lean too much on other people's opinions.
    • Difficulty ●●●●●Being in difficulty in a dream points to temporary trouble, which often turns out in your favor.
    • Digging ●●●●●Digging in a dream promises a hard-working life that never lacks; the rest depends on what you find.
    • Dinner ●●●●●Dining alone makes you think about essentials, while dinner among guests points to hospitality and sometimes a move.
    • Dirt ●●●●●Clean soil is a good sign, but dirt that soils you warns of gossip and illness.
    • Disaster ●●●●●A disaster in a dream warns of losses, but being rescued promises you'll come through unharmed.
    • Disease ●●●●●Being ill in a dream points to a minor health or family trouble, though some readings see luck and work instead.
    • Disgrace ●●●●●Disgrace in a dream brings worries about those close to you and warns against letting your principles slip.
    • Ignominy ●●●●●Suffering disgrace in a dream foretells an unfair accusation followed by a sudden rise.
    • Dish ●●●●●Handling dishes brings luck and gain, unless they break or stay dirty.
    • Disinherited ●●●●●Being disinherited in a dream is a warning to watch over your affairs, your standing and your conduct.
    • Dispute ●●●●●Arguing over trifles points to a health worry and a tendency to judge others too harshly.
    • Distaff ●●●●●A distaff points to a thrifty life in pleasant surroundings and a mind turned toward reflection.
    • Distance ●●●●●Distance in a dream mostly points to a journey, with encounters that could change your life for better or worse.
    • Ditch ●●●●●Falling into a ditch warns of loss and humiliation, but leaping over it clears you of suspicion.
    • Dividend ●●●●●Receiving dividends in a dream points to successful investments or a good harvest.
    • Diving ●●●●●Diving into clear water foretells a happy end to an awkward situation; murky water, worry.
    • Divining rod ●●●●●A divining rod in a dream warns of bad luck that will leave you unhappy with your surroundings.
    • Divorce ●●●●●Dreaming of divorce is a warning that your relationship needs more harmony.
    • Docks ●●●●●Standing on the docks points to an ill-fated journey, unless the sun is shining.
    • Doctor ●●●●●Meeting a doctor socially brings health and prosperity; seeing one professionally, health or family trouble.
    • Dogs ●●●●●Dogs are a double omen: friendly ones bring friendship and luck, hostile ones warn of enemies and quarrels.
    • Doing good ●●●●●Doing good, or being done good by others, points to joy and gain.
    • Doll ●●●●●Delighting in a new doll in a dream points, by contrast, to a disappointment.
    • Dolphin ●●●●●A dolphin in a dream is a rather dark omen: a change of authority or the loss of someone dear.
    • Dome ●●●●●Taking in the view from inside a dome promises a happy change; seeing one from afar, an ambition that stays out of reach.
    • Domestic servants ●●●●●Being surrounded by many servants in a dream points to illness.
    • Dominoes ●●●●●Playing dominoes points to slights and dubious company, whether you win or lose.
    • Donkey ●●●●●A donkey can mean travel, inheritance or insult; owning one, especially a white one, is the best omen.
    • Doomsday ●●●●●Waiting for doomsday in a dream reminds you to guard your interests against self-serving friends.
    • Door ●●●●●Walking through a door generally warns of gossip and trouble, unless it's the door of your childhood home.
    • Door knocker ●●●●●Using a door knocker means you will have to ask others for help or advice.
    • Doorbell ●●●●●A doorbell in a dream signals unexpected news or an urgent call.
    • Dove ●●●●●A dove brings peace, faithfulness and good news, except when it mourns or lies dead.
    • Dowry ●●●●●Receiving a dowry in a dream fulfills your hopes; being denied one points to hardship.
    • Dragon ●●●●●A dragon warns against your own outbursts, though an old reading sees treasure in it.
    • Drama ●●●●●Watching a drama promises reunions; writing one, debts you'll escape as if by a miracle.
    • Drawknife ●●●●●Seeing or using a drawknife points to disappointed hopes.
    • Dreams ●●●●●Telling someone your dreams, within a dream, points to something unexpected.
    • Dressing ●●●●●Struggling to get dressed in a dream warns of setbacks caused by others; rely mainly on yourself.
    • Drink ●●●●●What you drink changes everything: cold water and wine in moderation bode well, hot water and oil far less so.
    • Drinking ●●●●●Drinking merrily in a dream warns of pleasures that could hurt your reputation.
    • Drinking shots ●●●●●Knocking back drams points to petty rivalries; giving them up promises a rise in fortune.
    • Driving ●●●●●Driving yourself brings criticism and drudgery; being driven promises you'll always find a way through.
    • Dromedary ●●●●●A dromedary points to unexpected generosity and honors worn with dignity.
    • Dropsy ●●●●●Suffering from dropsy in a dream points to a passing illness you'll recover from with new strength.
    • Drought ●●●●●Watching crops wither points to an accident during a storm or losses among livestock.
    • Vastating Drought ●●●●●A great drought in a dream is a bad omen: conflict, accidents, family rifts and affairs gone wrong.
    • Drowning ●●●●●Drowning warns of loss, but being rescued, or rescuing someone, promises a fine rise in fortune.
    • Drum ●●●●●Seeing a drum points to prosperity and a peaceable nature; hearing a drumroll, to a sudden call.
    • Drunk ●●●●●Being drunk on hard liquor warns of trouble; being drunk on wine, by contrast, brings success in love and business.
    • Drunkenness ●●●●●Drunkenness in a dream hurts business but favors love: someone you don't yet know may soon matter to you.
    • Duck ●●●●●Ducks point to happy journeys, good harvests and visitors, unless they're hunted or shot.
    • Duet ●●●●●An instrumental duet means a peaceful life for lovers; a sung duet, slightly sad news soon forgotten.
    • Dulcimer ●●●●●A dulcimer foretells that your highest wishes will be reached through your finer qualities of mind.
    • Dungeon ●●●●●Being locked in a dungeon points to struggles you'll free yourself from through wisdom.
    • Dunghill ●●●●●A dunghill is a happy omen: profit will come from unexpected sources.
    • Dusk ●●●●●Dusk is a dream of sadness: early decline and unanswered hopes.
    • Dust ●●●●●Being covered in dust points to minor harm from others' failures, which a little good sense can repair.
    • Dwarf ●●●●●A well-formed, pleasant-looking dwarf is a very good sign: health, vigor and success.
    • Dye ●●●●●Watching cloth being dyed brings good or bad luck depending on the color.
    • Dying ●●●●●Dreaming of dying warns of danger from a once-helpful source and urges you to watch over your affairs.
    • Dynamite ●●●●●Dynamite signals change and expanding affairs, but fearing it points to a hidden enemy.
    • Dynamo ●●●●●A working dynamo promises success to those who mind the details; a broken one, trouble.

    E

    • Eagles ●●●●●An eagle is an omen of lofty ambition, wealth and honor, unless others shoot it down.
    • Ears ●●●●●Ears in dreams are about what's said and heard: well-shaped ones bring renown, hurt ones painful news and broken friendships.
    • Earrings ●●●●●Earrings point to good news and interesting work, unless they're broken.
    • Buying Earrings ●●●●●Buying earrings in a dream foretells abundance, in whatever form you lack.
    • Earthquake ●●●●●An earthquake signals a great upheaval: often ruinous, sometimes for the best.
    • Earthworms ●●●●●Earthworms in a dream signal hidden enemies working to undermine you.
    • Earwig ●●●●●An earwig brings unpleasant news about your work or your family.
    • Eating ●●●●●Eating alone brings low spirits, eating with others brings luck: a good meal enjoyed points to success.
    • Ebony ●●●●●Ebony furniture or objects point to painful quarrels at home.
    • Echo ●●●●●An echo in a dream points to hard times: illness, threatened work and absent friends.
    • Eclipse ●●●●●An eclipse in a dream is a bad omen: temporary setbacks, family trouble or bereavement.
    • Ecstasy ●●●●●Ecstasy in a dream heralds a visit from a long-absent friend, unless the dream is troubled.
    • Education ●●●●●Longing for education in a dream points to a thirst for knowledge that will lift you, and influential friends.
    • Eel ●●●●●An eel is an omen of slippery luck: hold on and happiness follows, let it go and you lose.
