    • Eggs ●●●●●Eggs promise wealth, fertility and success, unless they're rotten or break at the wrong moment.
    • Elbows ●●●●●Elbows point to hard, poorly paid work, but also to a good chance of a union.
    • Elderberries ●●●●●Elderberries are a happy dream: contentment, comfort and a flourishing family life.
    • Election ●●●●●An election foretells a controversy that will hurt your standing.
    • Electricity ●●●●●Electricity foretells sudden changes and threats, but also a possible win over your opponents.
    • Elephant ●●●●●An elephant is a very favourable dream of solid wealth, honours and family happiness.
    • Elevator ●●●●●An elevator foretells a swift rise if it goes up, and setbacks if it goes down.
    • Elf ●●●●●An elf foretells the return of someone absent, gifts and a happy marriage.
    • Elixir of life ●●●●●The elixir of life foretells new pleasures and new possibilities.
    • Elopement ●●●●●An elopement is mostly unfavourable: unfaithfulness, a disapproved marriage and risky ventures.
    • Eloquence ●●●●●Eloquence foretells good news if you win people over, and disorder if you fail.
    • Embalming ●●●●●Embalming foretells a social decline and harmful friendships.
    • Embankment ●●●●●Travelling along an embankment foretells threats you'll manage to turn into success.
    • Embarrassment ●●●●●Embarrassment follows the readings given for difficulty.
    • Embrace ●●●●●An embrace mostly foretells tension and disappointment, unless it happens in a happy setting.
    • Embroidery ●●●●●Embroidery foretells admiration, harmony at home and a growing family.
    • Emerald ●●●●●An emerald foretells a disputed inheritance and warns in love and business.
    • Emperor ●●●●●Meeting an emperor foretells a long journey with little to show for it.
    • Employee ●●●●●An employee in a dream foretells annoyances if they're unpleasant, and peace if they're friendly.
    • Employment ●●●●●A dream about employment is mostly about work and financial security, with gloomy omens unless you're the one out of work.
    • Empress ●●●●●An empress in a dream promises honors but warns against the pride that could leave you isolated.
    • Enchantment ●●●●●A dream of enchantment is about temptation: deceptive pleasures on one side, the wisdom of resisting them on the other.
    • Encyclopedia ●●●●●An encyclopedia in a dream promises a gift for writing, but at the expense of material comfort.
    • Enemy ●●●●●A dream about an enemy is about conflict and obstacles: defeating them promises success, losing calls for caution.
    • Engagement ●●●●●A dream of an engagement is about commitments, in love or in business, with mostly disappointing omens.
    • Engine ●●●●●An engine in a dream points to hardship and travel, but also to solid friends who'll hold you up.
    • Engineer ●●●●●A train engineer in a dream points to tiring journeys, but joyful reunions at the end.
    • English people ●●●●●The old readings of this dream rest on a national stereotype and are not reproduced here.
    • Entertainment ●●●●●An entertainment with music and dancing promises good news, health and prosperity.
    • Entrails ●●●●●A dream of entrails is mostly dark and full of despair, except when they belong to a wild beast or the dream concerns love.
    • Envelope ●●●●●An envelope in a dream foretells sad news.
    • Envy ●●●●●A dream of envy works by contraries: envying others promises warm friendships.
    • Epaulets ●●●●●Epaulets in a dream are about rank and prestige: a passing disgrace before honors, or an unwise attraction.
    • Epicure ●●●●●An epicure in a dream is about refinement: distinction or cultivated taste, but surrounded by selfishness.
    • Epidemic ●●●●●An epidemic in a dream is about mental exhaustion and worries that spread around you.
    • Epitaph ●●●●●Surprisingly, an epitaph in a dream is a good sign: a quiet friend, or even a fine marriage.
    • Ermine ●●●●●Ermine in a dream promises elevation, wealth and faithfulness, as long as it stays spotless.
    • Errand ●●●●●An errand in a dream is about your ties with those close to you: harmony at home, success in love, but possible losses too.
    • Escape ●●●●●A dream of escape is usually favorable: success, health and freedom, unless the escape fails.
    • Estate ●●●●●Coming into a vast estate in a dream points to a distant inheritance, quite different from what you expect.
    • Europe ●●●●●Traveling in Europe in a dream foretells a long, enriching journey that also helps your finances.
    • Eve ●●●●●Seeing Eve in a dream is mostly favorable, especially in love, though it also warns you to beware of temptation.
    • Evening ●●●●●Evening in a dream speaks of unfulfilled hopes, though bright stars promise better days.
    • Evergreen ●●●●●An evergreen in a dream promises lasting prosperity, happiness and learning.
    • Evil spirits ●●●●●Evil spirits in a dream warn of a hypocrite getting in the way of your affairs.
    • Exchange ●●●●●An exchange in a dream foretells profitable dealings.
    • Execution ●●●●●An execution in a dream is often read by contraries: being condemned yourself means luck, seeing someone else executed calls for care.
    • Exile ●●●●●Exile in a dream foretells an unplanned trip that will upset your plans or pleasures.
    • Explosion ●●●●●An explosion in a dream foretells annoyance and losses caused by those around you, and trust betrayed.
    • Eye ●●●●●An eye in a dream is about being watched and wary: enemies on the lookout, rivals, and trouble if the eyes are hurt.
    • Eye doctor ●●●●●Consulting an eye doctor signals dissatisfaction and the temptation of shortcuts.
    • Eyebrows ●●●●●Eyebrows in a dream point to obstacles or friendships, depending on how they look.

    F

    • Fables ●●●●●Fables in a dream promise pleasant tasks, a literary bent and romantic attachments.
    • Face ●●●●●A face in a dream is happy if it smiles and troubling if it's disfigured; seeing your own often points to self-dissatisfaction.
    • Faction ●●●●●Taking part in a faction in a dream foretells wealth gained by indirect means.
    • Faction or sedition ●●●●●A dream of faction or sedition mixes health, trouble and shame.
    • Failure ●●●●●A dream of failure is a warning: in love it works by contraries, but in business it tells you to change course.
    • Fainting ●●●●●Fainting in a dream foretells health worries and sad news.
    • Fair ●●●●●A fair in a dream cuts both ways: good business and pleasant company, or the risk of being robbed and cheated.
    • Fairy ●●●●●A fairy in a dream is usually a good sign, though some readings see a deceptive charm in it.
    • Faithlessness ●●●●●A dream of faithlessness works by contraries: your friends value you and your relationship will be happy.
    • Fakir ●●●●●A fakir in a dream foretells unusual activity and dramatic change, sometimes with a gloomy edge.
    • Falcon ●●●●●A falcon in a dream foretells success that will draw envy and gossip.
    • Fall ●●●●●A fall in a dream can mean a struggle followed by a rise, or a loss if you get hurt.
    • Fame ●●●●●Dreams of fame split two ways: being famous yourself means letdown, while meeting famous people points to a rise in the world.
    • Family ●●●●●A family dream mirrors the state of your home: together and happy, it promises health and comfort; torn apart, it brings disappointment.
    • Family tree ●●●●●A family tree is about family burdens and rights you may have to give up.
    • Famine ●●●●●Famine in a dream mostly points to unprofitable business, health worries and quarrels.
    • Fan ●●●●●A fan brings pleasant news and new acquaintances, but also hints at rivals in love.
    • Farewell ●●●●●Saying goodbye in a dream is not a good sign: it is said to bring painful news.
    • Farm ●●●●●A farm is a dream of prosperity: success, good deals and happiness at home.
    • Farm implements ●●●●●Farm tools carry different meanings: the plough is happy, the yoke heavy, the scythe worrying.
    • Farmer ●●●●●Becoming a farmer in a dream foretells hard work followed by wealth, and ploughing foretells success and marriage.
    • Fasting ●●●●●Fasting in a dream foretells a quarrel, but also success in love and business.
    • Fat ●●●●●Gaining weight in a dream points to a fortunate change and prosperity, unless you are cutting or eating fat.
    • Fates ●●●●●Dreaming of the Fates or of destiny foretells needless disagreements and unhappiness.
    • Father ●●●●●Your father in a dream signals a difficulty where wise advice will be needed, though seeing him can also be lucky.
    • Father-in-law ●●●●●A father-in-law in a dream mostly points to friction with those around you, unless he looks well.
    • Fatigue ●●●●●Exhaustion in a dream points to health worries or pressure at work, even if success may follow.
    • Fault ●●●●●Committing a fault in a dream calls for care; seeing one in someone you love, oddly, points to their faithfulness.
    • Favour ●●●●●Asking a favour in a dream points to abundance; granting one, to a loss.
    • Fawn ●●●●●A fawn signals true friendship and faithfulness in love; only someone's flattery should put you on guard.
    • Fear ●●●●●Feeling afraid in a dream can mean courage when awake, but also plans that fall short.
    • Feast ●●●●●A feast promises pleasant surprises and new acquaintances, unless it descends into chaos.
    • Feasting ●●●●●Feasting in a dream points to disappointments, especially in what you care about most.
    • Feather ●●●●●Feathers mean light burdens and fulfilled ambitions, unless they are black.
    • February ●●●●●February in a dream points to a stretch of poor health and gloom, unless the sun comes out.
    • Feebleness ●●●●●Feeling feeble in a dream points to draining work and worry; it is a cue to change something.
    • Feeling jolly ●●●●●Dreamed jollity promises satisfaction, but warns about whoever makes you laugh the most.
    • Feet ●●●●●Feet in a dream mostly point to trouble, humiliation and family quarrels, with a few exceptions.
    • Fence ●●●●●A fence in a dream is about obstacles: getting over it means success, falling from it means failure.
    • Ferns ●●●●●Ferns promise pleasant hours that lift a gloomy mood, unless they are withered.
    • Ferry ●●●●●A ferry is about crossing over: calm water means success, muddy water means setbacks.
    • Festering sore ●●●●●Oddly, a festering sore in a dream points to giving a gift or paying a welcome visit.
    • Festival ●●●●●Being at a festival suggests a taste for pleasure over hard realities: you will not go without, but you will lean on others.
    • Fever ●●●●●Having a fever in a dream means fretting over trifles while the best of life slips by.
    • Fiddle ●●●●●A fiddle means harmony at home and joyful occasions, though playing one may foretell a loss.
    • Field ●●●●●A green or ripe field promises abundance; a ploughed one may bring advancement, but also disputes.
    • Fiend ●●●●●Meeting a fiend in a dream warns of reckless living and of attacks from false friends.
    • Fife ●●●●●A fife is about honour: it calls you to defend it, yet promises your good name will survive.
    • Fight ●●●●●Fighting in a dream foretells confrontations, often legal or professional; coming out on top promises success.
    • Fighting ●●●●●Fighting in a dream foretells opposition, losses and break-ups; your present situation is not serving you.
    • Figs ●●●●●Figs promise prosperity and happiness, unless they are spoiled or you overindulge.
    • Figures ●●●●●Figures in a dream point to inner turmoil and the risk of losing out on a deal, though some numbers count as lucky.
    • File ●●●●●A file in a dream points to unsatisfying business, though trading in files can mean plenty of activity.
    • Fingernails ●●●●●Dirty nails point to embarrassing escapades in the family; well-kept nails, to studious tastes and thrift.
    • Fingers ●●●●●Fingers in a dream speak of love and money: lovely fingers or a cut that bleeds are good omens; losing a finger is not.
    • Fire ●●●●●Fire is a good sign as long as it doesn't burn you: it brings prosperity, success and love, but also flashes of anger.
    • Fire bucket ●●●●●A fire bucket points to disagreements over small matters.
    • Fire engine ●●●●●A fire engine means worry in unusual circumstances that will turn out well, unless it is broken down.
    • Firearms ●●●●●For the meaning of firearms, see gun, pistol and cannon.
    • Firebrand ●●●●●A firebrand brings good fortune, as long as it doesn't burn or upset you.
    • Firefighter ●●●●●A firefighter stands for loyal friends, unless they are hurt.
    • Fireworks ●●●●●Fireworks bring enjoyment, good health, outings and travel.
    • Firmament ●●●●●The firmament foretells great effort before you reach your goals, along with disappointments and sometimes misfortune.
    • Fish ●●●●●Fish are mostly a sign of luck, money and affection, unless they are dead or slip away.
    • Fish market ●●●●●Visiting a fish market brings comfort and pleasure, unless the fish has gone bad.
    • Fisherman ●●●●●A fisherman heralds a more prosperous time than you have ever known.
    • Fishhooks ●●●●●Fishhooks show you have chances to make your fortune and your name, if you use them well.
    • Fishing ●●●●●Fishing in a dream begins with worry, but it all depends on the catch: fish mean success, nothing means failure.
    • Fishing net ●●●●●A fishing net means many small pleasures and gains, unless it is torn.
    • Fishpond ●●●●●A clear, well-stocked fishpond means prosperity; a muddy or empty one is a warning.
    • Fits ●●●●●Having fits in a dream points to ill health and losing your job.
    • Flag ●●●●●A flag mostly means victory, prosperity and recognition, with a few warnings.
    • Flageolet ●●●●●Playing or hearing a flageolet points to quarrels and defeat in court.
    • Flame ●●●●●Fighting flames in a dream means you will need all your energy to build your fortune.
    • Flax ●●●●●Flax foretells prosperous ventures.
    • Flax spinning ●●●●●Spinning flax foretells hard-working, thrifty habits.
    • Fleas ●●●●●Fleas point to irritations and spiteful moves by people close to you or false friends.
    • Fleet ●●●●●A fleet moving fast signals a sudden shift in business and rumours of war.
    • Flesh ●●●●●Putting on flesh in a dream foretells wealth; growing thin, a fall in fortune.
    • Flies ●●●●●Flies point to illness, enemies and an insincere love, unless you kill them.
    • Flight ●●●●●Fleeing in a dream points to disgrace and bad news, unless something is fleeing from you.
    • Floating ●●●●●Floating in a dream means you will overcome obstacles that seem overwhelming.
    • Flood ●●●●●Traditions disagree: calm floodwater means plenty, while a muddy, destructive flood brings illness and losses.
    • Flood ●●●●●A flood foretells disaster when the water is dark, but relief when it's clear.
    • Flour ●●●●●Flour points to a modest but happy life, as long as you don't speculate.
    • Flower ●●●●●Fresh flowers mean pleasure, gain and love; withered ones foretell disappointment and loss.
    • Flute ●●●●●A flute brings either happy reunions and a romance, or quarrels with friends.
    • Flux ●●●●●Suffering from flux in a dream points to serious illness for you or a relative.
    • Flyers ●●●●●Flyers point to disputes and unwelcome news.
    • Flying ●●●●●Flying is often an excellent omen of rising fortune and happiness, but it depends how high you go, what lies below and whether you fall.
    • Flying machine ●●●●●A flying machine signals successful speculation, unless it breaks down.
    • Flypaper ●●●●●Flypaper points to poor health and broken friendships.
    • Flytrap ●●●●●A flytrap warns of plotting against you, but a full one means small troubles will spare you bigger ones.
    • Foal ●●●●●A foal points to new ventures in which you will be fairly lucky.
    • Fog ●●●●●Fog points to worries and murky business, though coming out of it offers hope.
    • Folly ●●●●●Surprisingly, acting foolishly in public in a dream points to a happy birth or a good marriage.
    • Fool ●●●●●Seeing yourself as a fool is a good sign for those who teach or lead.
    • Losing Your Wits ●●●●●Losing your head in a dream mostly foretells disagreements and humiliation, but sometimes an odd kind of popularity.
    • Footstool ●●●●●A footstool points to yielding your power or fortune to someone else.
    • Forehead ●●●●●A smooth forehead means you will be respected for your judgement; an ugly one, private annoyances.
    • Forest ●●●●●A dense forest points to losses and family strife; a stately forest in full leaf, to prosperity.
    • Forge ●●●●●Working at a forge shows a head full of plans, and may point to a lively partnership.
    • Fork ●●●●●A fork warns of enemies and false friends trying to push you out.
    • Form ●●●●●Something misshapen means disappointment; a beautiful figure, good health and business.
    • Forsaking ●●●●●Leaving your home or a friend behind in a dream points to disappointment in love.
    • Fort ●●●●●Defending a fort means your honour will be attacked; taking one means victory over your enemies.
    • Fortress ●●●●●Being shut in a fortress means others will hamper your plans; locking others in means power and gain.
    • Fortune ●●●●●Dreams of fortune often work by contraries: sudden riches mean want, but regaining what you lost is a good sign.
    • Fortune-teller ●●●●●Consulting a fortune-teller mostly warns against hasty decisions and money losses.
    • Fortune-telling ●●●●●Having your fortune told in a dream points to a thorny matter to think over carefully before agreeing to it.
    • Fountain ●●●●●A clear fountain promises wealth, honours and a happy marriage; a cloudy or dry one, disappointment and sorrow.
    • Fowl ●●●●●Fowl point to temporary worry or a short illness.
    • Fox ●●●●●A fox points to cunning, false friends and shady dealings, unless you kill it.
    • Fraud ●●●●●Committing fraud in a dream means disgrace; being defrauded, your enemies' failure; accusing someone, a place of honour.
    • Freckles ●●●●●A freckled face points to small upsets that creep into your happiness.
    • Freemason ●●●●●Becoming a Freemason in a dream points to loyal new friends and a journey; being expelled, to a rise in life.
    • Friend ●●●●●A happy friend in a dream brings good news; a troubled or transformed one warns of worry and distance.
    • Frightened ●●●●●Being frightened of something in a dream points to brief, passing worries.
    • Frog ●●●●●Frogs are mostly a good sign for health, business and love, with a few caveats.
    • Frost ●●●●●Frost is an unfavourable dream for business and love, though it sometimes hints at a peaceful ending.
    • Fruit ●●●●●Ripe fruit promises prosperity and success; green or spoiled fruit, disappointment and trouble.
    • Fruit seller ●●●●●A fruit seller warns against trying to recover a loss too quickly through unlucky speculation.
    • Funeral ●●●●●Traditions split on funerals: family worry and grief for some, a wedding, party or legacy for others.
    • Fur ●●●●●Fur is a very favourable dream: prosperity, honours and faithful love.
    • Furnace ●●●●●A working furnace brings luck; a broken or blazing one points to trouble and quarrels.
    • Furniture ●●●●●New furniture you like means health and prosperity; furniture you dislike or put on display, bad news.
    • Future ●●●●●Dreaming of the future calls for careful budgeting and avoiding wasteful spending.

    G

    • Gag ●●●●●Being gagged in a dream oddly foretells a kiss or a new crush.
    • Gain ●●●●●Gain in a dream promises wealth if fairly won, ruin if not.
    • Gaiters ●●●●●Gaiters point to pleasant amusements and some rivalry.
    • Gale ●●●●●Being caught in a gale points to business losses and trouble at work.
    • Gallows ●●●●●Gallows in a dream are surprisingly often a sign of fortune, though seeing a friend on them calls for decisive action.
    • Gambling ●●●●●Gambling in a dream foretells poverty and disgrace, for you or those close to you.
    • Gambling house ●●●●●A gambling house in a dream points to shady company, whether you win or lose.
    • Game ●●●●●Game in a dream foretells successful ventures, though pursued for selfish reasons.
    • Gangrene ●●●●●Gangrene in a dream foretells a death in the family.
    • Gaol ●●●●●Being locked in a gaol in a dream points to envious people blocking your plans, but escaping it promises good business.
    • Garbage ●●●●●Heaps of garbage in a dream foretell scandal and bad business.
    • Garden ●●●●●A beautiful garden in a dream promises peace, abundance and happiness, especially in love.
    • Garland ●●●●●Wearing a garland in a dream promises honor, good repute and advancement.
    • Garlic ●●●●●Garlic in a dream promises a rise in fortune and a practical outlook, but also secrets uncovered and squabbles at home.
    • Garment ●●●●●Putting on a new garment in a dream foretells a change of circumstances, often through marriage.
    • Garret ●●●●●Climbing to a garret in a dream is about chasing theories while leaving practical realities to others.
    • Garter ●●●●●A garter in a dream is about desire and jealousy: a union soon for those in love, storms for couples.
    • Gas ●●●●●A dream of gas is mostly about hasty judgments and carelessness that come back on you, with a way out once the flame is lit.
    • Gas lamps ●●●●●A gas lamp signals progress and pleasant surroundings, as long as it works properly.
    • Gasoline ●●●●●A gasoline dream points to a comfortable income that comes to you only after a struggle.
    • Gate ●●●●●A gate is mostly about obstacles and difficult passages, except when you are the one locking it.
    • Gauze ●●●●●Gauze points to uncertain fortunes and, in love, to a gentle good influence.
    • Gavel ●●●●●A gavel speaks of pastimes that don't pay and a tendency to take charge too much.
    • Geese ●●●●●Geese are generally a good sign: success, growing wealth and faithful love, unless they are honking in alarm or dead.
    • Gems ●●●●●Gems foretell a happy fate in both love and business.
    • Geography ●●●●●Studying geography in a dream foretells travel and visits to famous places.
    • Ghost ●●●●●A ghost mostly warns of danger, false friends and bereavement, with a few brighter visions.
    • Giant ●●●●●A giant foretells a great struggle, and the outcome depends on who backs down.
    • Gibbet ●●●●●Seeing someone hanging from a gibbet foretells harm and great sorrow.
    • Gift ●●●●●Receiving a gift is a good sign for love and money; giving one is much less so.
    • Gig ●●●●●A gig mostly points to delays and plans being put off.
    • Gin ●●●●●Gin mostly foretells losses and disappointments you partly bring on yourself.
    • Girdle ●●●●●A girdle is about influence and honour: a new one brings honour, an old or tight one holds you back.
    • Girls ●●●●●A healthy, bright girl foretells joys at home; a pale, thin one points to illness in the family.
    • Glass ●●●●●Glass is mostly about fragility: dashed hopes, fickle love and broken plans, with a few bright exceptions.
    • Glass house ●●●●●A glass house warns against flattery and being too exposed.
    • Glassblower ●●●●●Watching glassblowers foretells a career change that looks good but costs you.
    • Gleaning ●●●●●Gleaning foretells prosperity, an inheritance, and sometimes an unexpected marriage.
    • Globe ●●●●●Looking at a globe foretells much good and plenty of travel.
    • Gloom ●●●●●Being surrounded by gloom warns of unpleasantness and loss coming soon.
    • Gloves ●●●●●New or gifted gloves bring caution, friendship and love; worn or lost gloves mean betrayal and disappointment.
    • Goat ●●●●●Goats mostly foretell good harvests, steadily growing wealth and honours, with a warning if a billy goat butts you.
    • Goblet ●●●●●An antique goblet brings favours; drinking from a silver one foretells business setbacks.
    • God ●●●●●Dreaming of God mostly foretells soul-searching, mistakes to put right and, sometimes, unexpected protection.
    • Goggles ●●●●●Goggles warn against bad company and against seeing something unpleasant.
    • Gold ●●●●●Gold is a strong omen of success and new friendships, unless you lose it or drop it.
    • Gold leaf ●●●●●Gold leaf foretells a flattering future.
    • Goldfish ●●●●●Goldfish bring luck in every shape and form.
    • Goldfish ●●●●●Goldfish foretell happy adventures and a good match, unless they are sick or dead.
    • Golf ●●●●●Golf foretells pleasant wishes, unless something goes wrong during the game.
    • Gondola ●●●●●Gliding in a gondola on calm water is excellent, especially for love; on troubled water, it means strife.
    • Gong ●●●●●The sound of a gong mostly signals a false alarm, along with annoyances that weigh on you more than they should.
    • Gooseberries ●●●●●Gooseberries mostly promise happiness after trouble and success in your plans, as long as they are ripe.
    • Gossip ●●●●●Gossip warns against trusting too quickly, with a pleasant surprise if you are the one being talked about.
    • Gout ●●●●●Having gout points to being exasperated by a relative and losing a little money because of them.
    • Governor ●●●●●Seeing a governor points to good news, and possibly honours.
    • Grain ●●●●●Grain is a dream of prosperity and happiness, as long as it is healthy.
    • Grammar ●●●●●Studying grammar points to a wise choice when an important opportunity comes along.
    • Gramophone ●●●●●A gramophone points to a pleasant new companion, unless it is broken.
    • Grandparents ●●●●●Talking with your grandparents points to serious obstacles that good advice will help you overcome.
    • Grapes ●●●●●Grapes mostly promise plenty, happy love and success, though eating them can bring worries.
    • Grass ●●●●●Green grass is a very favourable dream of long life and success; withered or cut grass means the reverse.
    • Grasshopper ●●●●●Grasshoppers point to enemies and business worries, though they promise long life to the healthy.
    • Grave ●●●●●A grave is mostly a dream of loss, illness and disappointment, but climbing out of one points to success.
    • Gravel ●●●●●Gravel points to fruitless schemes, unless it is clean, when it promises a pleasant journey.
    • Gravy ●●●●●Eating gravy points to failing health and disappointing business.
    • Grazing ●●●●●Seeing cattle grazing is a dream of good fortune and prosperity.
    • Grease ●●●●●Grease mostly suggests that your plans will run smoothly.
    • Greek ●●●●●Reading Greek points to your ideas being debated and then adopted.
    • Green ●●●●●The colour green points to long life, unless it has faded.
    • Greyhound ●●●●●A greyhound is a lucky dream.
    • Grief ●●●●●This dream reads in reverse: deep grief points to a happy occasion.
    • Grin ●●●●●Being grinned at points to doing something you'll be ashamed of.
    • Grindstone ●●●●●A grindstone points to a life of well-directed, rewarded effort.
    • Groan ●●●●●Groans carry opposite meanings: fun and good surprises, but also enemies working against you.
    • Groceries ●●●●●Fresh groceries point to ease and comfort.
    • Grog ●●●●●Drinking grog points to poverty or disgrace.
    • Grooming a horse ●●●●●Grooming a horse in a dream foretells much effort, crowned with success if you see it through.
    • Grotto ●●●●●A grotto speaks of fickle friendships, but also of reunions with loved ones.
    • Grove ●●●●●A green grove points to happiness and success; a bare one, the reverse.
    • Growing ●●●●●Seeing something grow too fast warns against haste and accidents.
    • Grub ●●●●●White grubs point to good crops and sometimes a pregnancy; black, dirty ones to the reverse.
    • Gruel ●●●●●Gruel promises recovery to the sick but warns the healthy against a bad bargain.
    • Guardian ●●●●●A guardian points to consideration from friends, unless they treat you harshly.
    • Guitar ●●●●●A guitar points to merry gatherings and romance, with a warning against flattery.
    • Gulls ●●●●●Gulls point to peaceful dealings with ungenerous people; dead gulls, to separation.
    • Gun ●●●●●A gun is a dream of distress, conflict and danger.
    • Guts ●●●●●This dream refers to the meaning of entrails.
    • Gutter ●●●●●A gutter mostly points to degradation, though lying in one oddly promises honour.
    • Gymnast ●●●●●A gymnast points to setbacks in speculation or trade.
    • Gypsy ●●●●●The traditional readings of this dream rest on prejudice.

    H

    • Hackney carriage ●●●●●A line of hired carriages, even at a funeral, points to a wedding or a lively party.
    • Haggard ●●●●●A haggard face points to misfortune and setbacks in love.
    • Hail ●●●●●Hail mostly points to worries and sorrow, though white hail can also signal a good deal.
    • Hair ●●●●●Hair speaks of prosperity, health and love: beautiful, thick hair is a good sign, while thinning, tangled or falling hair points to worry and illness.
    • Hairdresser ●●●●●Visiting a hairdresser points to a stir, criticism and worries about reputation.
    • Hairy hands ●●●●●Hands covered in hair point to scheming and watchful enemies.
    • Halter ●●●●●Putting on a halter points to a thriving business and romance going your way.
    • Ham ●●●●●Ham carries split meanings: prosperity and victory, but also betrayal and loss.
    • Hammer ●●●●●A hammer is a good sign: success, at the cost of a few obstacles.
    • Hand ●●●●●Hands speak of success and mutual help: beautiful, strong hands point to success; injured, dirty or tied hands to difficulties.
    • Handcuffs ●●●●●Handcuffs point to formidable enemies, but seeing others cuffed or breaking free means victory.
    • Handkerchiefs ●●●●●Handkerchiefs speak of flirtations and romance, happy or troubled depending on their state.
    • Good Looks ●●●●●Seeing yourself or others as handsome warns against flattery and fast company.
    • Handwriting ●●●●●Recognising your own handwriting warns that enemies will use your words against you.
    • Hare ●●●●●A hare speaks of things that slip away or that you catch: loss if it escapes, victory if you catch it.
    • Harem ●●●●●A harem warns against wasting your energy on empty pleasures.
    • Harlequin ●●●●●A harlequin points to trouble, trickery and going astray.
    • Harness ●●●●●A bright new harness points to a pleasant journey.
    • Harp ●●●●●A harp is lucky in love and for the sick, but warns against trusting too much and against slander.
    • Harvest ●●●●●A harvest is a dream of prosperity, pleasure and happy love.
    • Hash ●●●●●Eating hash points to vexations, jealousy and arguments over trifles.
    • Haste ●●●●●This dream refers to the meanings of running and walking.
    • Hat ●●●●●A new hat points to progress and success; a lost, damaged or wind-blown one, to setbacks.
    • Hatchet ●●●●●A hatchet warns against waste and envious people.
    • Hatching ●●●●●Hatching chicks points to thrift and money made in a deal.
    • Hating Someone ●●●●●Hating someone warns of harm you might cause; being hated unjustly points to good friends instead.
    • Hatred ●●●●●Hatred, felt or received, is a bad sign, though in love it sometimes reads in reverse.
    • Hawk ●●●●●A hawk points to schemers watching you, but also to victory if you drive it off or shoot it.
    • Hay ●●●●●Hay is a dream of prosperity, influence and success.
    • Hazelnut ●●●●●Hazelnuts promise either a peaceful home and good business, or trouble with friends.
    • Head ●●●●●A head is mostly a good sign, pointing to distinction and powerful support; a severed or aching head points to disappointment and worry.
    • Headgear ●●●●●Rich headgear points to fame; old, worn headgear to giving up your possessions.
    • Healing ●●●●●A sore that heals quickly paradoxically points to a break-up.
    • Hearse ●●●●●A hearse points to friction at home, setbacks and bereavement.
    • Heart ●●●●●A heart is mostly a bad sign, unless you see a human heart or an animal's heart.
    • Heat ●●●●●Oppressive heat is an unfavourable dream: a friend's betrayal or an attack on its way.
    • Heather ●●●●●Heather in bloom points to one happy occasion after another.
    • Heaven ●●●●●Heaven promises grandeur and serenity, but also joys that don't last.
    • Hedges ●●●●●Green hedges point to joy and profit; bare or thorny ones, to trouble.
    • Heir ●●●●●Inheriting warns that you could lose what you have and signals new responsibilities, sometimes with pleasant surprises.
    • Hell ●●●●●Hell points to temptation, worry and traps that are hard to escape.
    • Helmet ●●●●●A helmet points to a threatened misfortune avoided through wise action.
    • Hemp ●●●●●Hemp points to success in all your undertakings, especially large ones.
    • Hemp seed ●●●●●Hemp seed points to a deep friendship and good chances to make money.
    • Hens ●●●●●Hens mostly point to family reunions, joy and gain.
    • Herbs ●●●●●Herbs point to worries mixed with pleasures; useful herbs to warm friendships, poisonous ones to enemies.
    • Hermit ●●●●●A hermit speaks of loneliness caused by unfaithful friends, but also of reflection and generosity.
    • Herring ●●●●●Herring points to a financial squeeze followed by success.
    • Hidden things ●●●●●Hiding something points to embarrassment, but finding hidden things promises unexpected pleasures.
    • Hieroglyphs ●●●●●Hieroglyphs warn against indecision, but being able to read them points to victory.
    • High school ●●●●●High school points to rising in love, society and business.
    • High tide ●●●●●High tide points to favourable progress in your affairs.
    • Hill ●●●●●Climbing a hill points to rising in the world; going down or slipping back, to difficulties.
    • Hips ●●●●●Hips mostly speak of romantic disappointment and reproach.
    • Hissing ●●●●●Hissing points to shame, vexation or the loss of a friend.
    • History ●●●●●Reading history points to a long and pleasant break.
    • Hives ●●●●●Hives on your child paradoxically point to good health.
    • Hoe ●●●●●A hoe points to work, independence and faithfulness.
    • Hogs ●●●●●Fat, well-kept hogs point to good luck; lean, squealing ones to trouble and loss.
    • Hog ●●●●●Having hog bristles points to great and violent dangers.
    • Hole ●●●●●This dream refers to the meaning of an abyss.
    • Holiday ●●●●●A holiday points to interesting guests arriving.
    • Holy communion ●●●●●Communion warns against giving up your convictions for trivial desires.
    • Home ●●●●●Revisiting your childhood home points to good news, unless it is falling apart.
    • Homesickness ●●●●●Feeling homesick points to travel and visiting opportunities you'll let slip.
    • Homicide ●●●●●Committing homicide points to anguish and humiliation, and worry for those close to you.
    • Hominy ●●●●●Hominy points to pleasant romance and unexpected connections.
    • Honey ●●●●●Honey is a dream of wealth, love and a long, happy life.
    • Honeysuckle ●●●●●Honeysuckle points to contented prosperity and an unusually happy marriage.
    • Hood ●●●●●Wearing a hood points to the temptation to lure someone away from their commitments.
    • Hook ●●●●●A hook points to unwelcome obligations you'll take on.
    • Hoop ●●●●●A hoop points to influential friendships and obstacles cleared in style.
    • Hops ●●●●●Hops point to thrift, energy and wealth.
    • Horn ●●●●●The sound of a horn points to joyful news, but broken or threatening horns signal trouble.
    • Hornet ●●●●●Hornets point to broken friendships, money losses and attacks on your reputation.
    • Horoscope ●●●●●Having your horoscope cast points to unexpected changes and a long journey, but also to disappointments.
    • Horse ●●●●●A horse is an excellent sign of prosperity and advancement, especially if you ride it easily; a wounded, dead or bucking horse points to setbacks.
    • Horse dealer ●●●●●A horse dealer points to big profits from risky ventures, with a danger of being cheated.
    • Horseradish ●●●●●Horseradish points to stimulating company and good luck.
    • Horseshoe ●●●●●A horseshoe points to progress and luck, unless it is broken.
    • Hospital ●●●●●A hospital points to illness nearby or distressing news from absent friends.
    • Hotel ●●●●●A hotel mostly points to ease, profit and travel.
    • Hounds ●●●●●Hounds on the hunt point to delights and pleasant changes.
    • House ●●●●●Building or owning a fine house points to a comfortable life; a run-down or collapsing house, to setbacks.
    • Household utensils ●●●●●Household utensils stand for the parts of your life and home.
    • Housekeeper ●●●●●Being or hiring a housekeeper points to useful work and a measure of comfort.
    • Hug ●●●●●This dream reads in reverse: being cuddled by your partner points to them growing tired of you.
    • Hugging ●●●●●Hugging points to disappointment in love and business.
    • Humidity ●●●●●Being overcome by humidity points to a fierce fight against stronger enemies that ends in defeat.
    • Hunchback ●●●●●Seeing a hunchback foretells unexpected setbacks.
    • Hunger ●●●●●Hunger in a dream has two readings: a home without comfort, or the drive that leads to wealth.
    • Hunting ●●●●●Hunting is about hard pursuits: if you find the game, you win.
    • Hurricane ●●●●●A hurricane foretells ordeals, anxiety and upheaval, sometimes narrowly avoided.
    • Hurt ●●●●●Hurting someone or being hurt in a dream is about grudges and opponents.
    • Husband ●●●●●A husband dream is mostly about tension in the relationship, with a possible reconciliation and real happiness when he looks cheerful.
    • Hut ●●●●●A hut foretells modest success, but also a home of your own and warm hospitality.
    • Hyacinth ●●●●●Hyacinths foretell a painful parting that will eventually do you good.
    • Hyena ●●●●●A hyena foretells disappointment, bad luck and poor company.
    • Hymns ●●●●●Hearing hymns foretells a contented home and average business prospects.
    • Hypocrite ●●●●●Hypocrisy in a dream warns against false friends, and against your own double- dealing.
    • Hyssop ●●●●●Hyssop foretells serious accusations and a reputation at risk.

    I

    • Ice ●●●●●Ice mostly foretells distress, jealousy and fragile pleasures, though gliding easily over it means overcoming a difficulty.
    • Ice cream ●●●●●Ice cream foretells success and happiness, unless it has gone sour or melted.
    • Icicles ●●●●●Icicles falling from trees foretell that a misfortune will soon be over.
    • Ideal ●●●●●Meeting your ideal in a dream foretells a stretch of happiness and a turn for the better.
    • Idleness ●●●●●Idleness in a dream foretells unfinished plans and trouble among your friends.
    • Idol ●●●●●Idols have two faces: celebrations and happy changes, or trivial things that hold back your rise.
    • Illness ●●●●●Dreaming that you are ill mostly points to letdowns: a missed pleasure, being cheated, or promises that won't be kept.
    • Illumination ●●●●●An illumination promises success and joy while it shines, but strange lights in the sky tend to warn of trouble and conflict.
    • Image ●●●●●Images and statues speak of your attachments, but mostly foretell only modest success in love and business.
    • Imitation ●●●●●A dream of imitation warns of deceit, and of other people's mistakes landing on your shoulders.
    • Impertinence ●●●●●Oddly enough, a dream of impertinence points to a pleasant new acquaintance, perhaps even the start of a romance.
    • Implements ●●●●●Tools in a dream speak of the means you have to get a job done, and they seem to fall short.
    • Imps ●●●●●Imps warn about small pleasures and bits of folly that end up costing dearly.
    • Inauguration ●●●●●An inauguration mostly heralds a rise: you'll climb higher than you ever have.
    • Incantation ●●●●●Incantations speak of strain between partners and pretence among friends.
    • Incest ●●●●●The old books read it as an omen of falling from respectability and losing money.
    • Incoherence ●●●●●An incoherent dream mostly reflects nervous strain from events piling up too fast.
    • Income ●●●●●Dreams of income are about money, but mostly about how it affects the people close to you.
    • Increase ●●●●●Something growing in a dream brings either a setback or a way out of trouble.
    • Independence ●●●●●Dreamed independence warns of a rival but promises good results in the end.
    • Indifference ●●●●●Indifference in a dream speaks of fragile bonds: good times that don't last, or love poorly expressed.
    • Indigestion ●●●●●Indigestion speaks of a heavy, gloomy atmosphere around you.
    • Indigo ●●●●●Indigo brings together a temptation to deceive, a murky love affair and faraway travel.
    • Indistinct ●●●●●Seeing things blurred in a dream points to shaky friendships and unclear dealings.
    • Indulgence ●●●●●Indulging yourself in a dream foretells unflattering talk about your conduct.
    • Industriousness ●●●●●Working hard in a dream is an excellent omen of success.
    • Infant ●●●●●An infant is generally an excellent omen of joy, luck and fresh starts.
    • Infirmary ●●●●●Leaving an infirmary means you'll escape enemies who have been troubling you.
    • Infirmities ●●●●●Infirmities point to setbacks in love and business, and enemies not to be underestimated.
    • Influence ●●●●●Influence in a dream gets you nowhere if you beg for it, but brings luck when you hold it.
    • Inheritance ●●●●●Receiving an inheritance in a dream promises that you'll easily get what you want.
    • Injury ●●●●●The readings diverge: being wronged may bring grief, or show that you're well surrounded.
    • Ink ●●●●●Ink in a dream is mostly about gossip, envy and a stained reputation.
    • Inkwell ●●●●●An inkwell warns of accusations and slander.
    • Inn ●●●●●An inn is mostly an unfavourable omen, unless it's roomy and well kept.
    • Inquest ●●●●●The readings clash: an inquest foretells either losses and disappointing friendships, or prosperity.
    • Inquisition ●●●●●An inquisition foretells a long run of trouble and helplessness in the face of slander.
    • Insanity ●●●●●Dreamed madness warns of a project off to a bad start and urges you to watch your health.
    • Inscription ●●●●●An inscription heralds unpleasant news, even illness or the loss of a friend.
    • Insolvency ●●●●●Being insolvent in a dream doesn't foretell bankruptcy: your energy will spare you that, though other worries may come.
    • Insult ●●●●●A dreamed insult is read like dreams of abuse and ill treatment.
    • Insurance agent ●●●●●An insurance agent foretells meeting a stranger who will help your business, and a change at home.
    • Intemperance ●●●●●Intemperance warns against every kind of excess, of the mind as of the heart.
    • Interceding ●●●●●Interceding for someone in a dream means you'll find help when you need it most.
    • Intermarriage ●●●●●Marriage between close relatives foretells quarrels that will drag you into trouble.
    • Interpreter ●●●●●An interpreter points to ventures that won't pay off as you'd hoped.
    • Intestines ●●●●●Intestines foretell serious trials: illness, losses and situations hard to untangle.
    • Intoxication ●●●●●Being intoxicated in a dream reveals a growing taste for forbidden pleasures.
    • Intrigue ●●●●●Being caught up in an intrigue is an omen of trouble.
    • Invalid ●●●●●Invalids in a dream point to tiresome company and unpleasant circumstances.
    • Invasion ●●●●●An invasion foretells a threat from outside: a bad influence, competition or a job at risk.
    • Invective ●●●●●Invective warns of anger that drives people away and of enemies closing in.
    • Inventor ●●●●●An inventor promises an original achievement that will bring honour to your name.
    • Invitation ●●●●●Against expectations, invitations point to upsets and sad news.
    • Iron ●●●●●Iron is a harsh omen of distress, loss and hardness, with just one glimmer of hope.
    • Ironing ●●●●●Ironing points to home comforts and orderly affairs, unless something goes wrong with the job.
    • Island ●●●●●A green island promises happiness and good journeys, but a deserted one points to isolation.
    • Itch ●●●●●An itch speaks of irritations and rough treatment, but also of money on its way.
    • Ivory ●●●●●Ivory is a very good omen for fortune, business and love.
    • Ivy ●●●●●Ivy divided the old books: a sign of health and fortune to some, of poverty to others.

    J

    • Jackdaw ●●●●●A jackdaw foretells quarrels and poor health, but catching or killing one turns luck your way.
    • Jail ●●●●●Jail is often read in reverse: being locked up brings honours, seeing others locked up a loss of freedom.
    • Jailer ●●●●●A jailer foretells betrayal, entanglement and pressure to hand over money.
    • Jam ●●●●●Jam promises sweetness, pleasant surprises and a happy home.
    • Janitor ●●●●●A janitor speaks of how the house is run: poor management if present, petty hassles if missing, smooth going if found.
    • January ●●●●●Dreaming of January points to people close to you with whom affection doesn't flow.
    • Jar ●●●●●A full jar promises success; an empty or broken one points to want or disappointment.
    • Jasmine ●●●●●Jasmine promises exquisite though fleeting pleasure, and luck in love.
    • Jasper ●●●●●Jasper is a happy omen of success and love.
    • Jaundice ●●●●●Having jaundice foretells prosperity after brief trouble; seeing it in others points to discouraging company.
    • Javelin ●●●●●A javelin points to attacks on your interests and reputation.
    • Jaw harp ●●●●●A jaw harp points to a slight upturn and perhaps an unexpected crush.
    • Jaws ●●●●●Jaws in a dream foretell disagreements, enemies and health worries.
    • Jay ●●●●●A jay brings friendly visits and chatter, but a dead jay casts a shadow over home life.
    • Jealousy ●●●●●Jealousy in a dream rarely bodes well: rivalry, betrayal and worry.
    • Jelly ●●●●●Jelly promises sweet surprises, reunions and a long life.
    • Jeopardy ●●●●●Against expectations, being in jeopardy is a very favourable omen.
    • Jester ●●●●●A jester warns against trifles that make you neglect what matters.
    • Jewellery ●●●●●Damaged jewellery foretells disappointment and friends who let you down.
    • Jewels ●●●●●Jewels are an omen of pleasure, wealth and advancement, with a few warnings.
    • Jewish person ●●●●●The old books' readings for this dream rested on antisemitic prejudice and are not reproduced.
    • Jig ●●●●●A jig foretells cheerful occupations and mutual affection.
    • Jockey ●●●●●A jockey heralds happy surprises: a gift, a proposal, a turn for the better.
    • Journey ●●●●●A dreamed journey brings profit or disappointment, depending on how it goes.
    • Journeyman ●●●●●A journeyman points to travel, costly and pointless for some, pleasant for others.
    • Joy ●●●●●Joy foretells harmony and an end to fear, unless it tips into ecstasy.
    • Jubilee ●●●●●A jubilee promises shared pleasures, a happy union and perhaps an inheritance.
    • Judge ●●●●●A judge foretells disputes being settled, for you or against you.
    • Judgment day ●●●●●Judgment Day promises success if you face it hopefully, and failure and gossip if not.
    • Jug ●●●●●A jug brings friendship and health when full, loneliness and failure when empty or broken; drinking from one means a journey.
    • July ●●●●●July foretells a gloomy spell followed by a sudden return to joy and luck.
    • Jumping ●●●●●Jumping over an obstacle promises success; falling back or jumping off a wall brings setbacks.
    • Jumping jack ●●●●●A jumping jack warns against idleness and trivial pastimes that crowd out serious plans.
    • June ●●●●●June promises unusual gains, unless nature is withering.
    • Juniper ●●●●●A juniper heralds happiness after sorrow, though its berries, gathered or eaten, are harder to read.
    • Juniper berries ●●●●●Juniper berries promise great honours and, for couples, a birth.
    • Jury ●●●●●A jury speaks of dissatisfaction, favours asked and verdicts that turn for or against you.
    • Justice ●●●●●Demanding justice in a dream foretells trouble from lies and attacks on your reputation.

    K

    • Kaleidoscope ●●●●●A kaleidoscope foretells swift changes that seldom turn out well.
    • Kangaroo ●●●●●A kangaroo foretells victory over a cunning enemy, unless it attacks you.
    • Katydids ●●●●●The song of katydids foretells bad luck, dependence and quarrels.
    • Keg ●●●●●A keg speaks of oppression and departures, and what's inside decides the rest.
    • Kettle ●●●●●A kettle foretells hard work, then an end to struggle if the water boils, or failure if it's broken.
    • Key ●●●●●Keys bring unexpected change: found, they bring luck; lost, they bring vexation.
    • Keyhole ●●●●●A keyhole speaks of betrayed confidences and ill-meant curiosity.
    • Kidneys ●●●●●Kidneys foretell health or relationship troubles, and intrigues that cause a stir.
    • Kill ●●●●●Killing in a dream brings bad luck when it's wanton, but may mean plenty or security depending on the case.
    • Killing ●●●●●Killing someone defenceless brings sorrow and failure; killing in self-defence brings victory.
    • King ●●●●●A king speaks of ambition: it will raise you up or let you down, depending on how you relate to him.
    • Kiss ●●●●●A kiss speaks of harmony and affection, but also of risky passions depending on the setting.
    • Kitchen ●●●●●A kitchen foretells emergencies to deal with, but a tidy one promises good fortune.
    • Kite ●●●●●A kite speaks of dazzling but flimsy appearances, and hopes that drift away.
    • Kitten ●●●●●Kittens foretell petty troubles and deceptions, which you can overcome.
    • Knapsack ●●●●●A knapsack foretells pleasures found away from your usual circle.
    • Knee ●●●●●Knees are mostly a bad omen, with a few romantic exceptions.
    • Knife ●●●●●A knife is a bad omen: separation, quarrels and losses.
    • Knife grinder ●●●●●A knife grinder foretells people taking liberties with your belongings.
    • Knitting ●●●●●Knitting promises a peaceful home, a happy union and solid prosperity.
    • Knives ●●●●●Knives are a bad omen, pointing to conflict, legal trouble, losses and strain in relationships.
    • Knocking ●●●●●Hearing knocking foretells serious news.
    • Knots ●●●●●Knots point to fretting over trifles, though tying one shows an independent streak.
    • Krishna ●●●●●Seeing Krishna points to a life devoted to spiritual inquiry and a calm stance toward hardship.

    L

    • Label ●●●●●A label warns against carelessness that could expose your affairs to someone who means you harm.
    • Laboratory ●●●●●A laboratory suggests energy poured into clever but unprofitable schemes.
    • Labour ●●●●●Seeing work done is mostly a good sign, pointing to health, profit and promising ventures, with a few warnings.
    • Labyrinth ●●●●●A labyrinth foretells tangled situations and tension, though a green labyrinth promises unexpected happiness.
    • Lace ●●●●●Lace is a happy omen of faithfulness, fulfilled ambitions and comfort, so long as you don't reach beyond your means.
    • Ladder ●●●●●A ladder speaks of success and rising status when you climb it, and of disappointment and loss when you go down or it breaks.
    • Ladies ●●●●●Ladies carry varied meanings, from weakness and gossip to good news, depending on how they appear.
    • Ladle ●●●●●A ladle foretells a good choice of partner and family happiness, unless it is broken or dirty.
    • Lagoon ●●●●●A lagoon foretells a spell of doubt and confusion.
    • Lake ●●●●●A lake mirrors your inner state: clear and calm, it promises happiness and success; muddy or rough, hardship and loss.
    • Lamb ●●●●●The lamb stands for innocence and family happiness, turning to misfortune only when it is hurt, lost or threatened.
    • Lame ●●●●●Seeing someone limp foretells disappointed hopes.
    • Lament ●●●●●Lamenting foretells hardship that will eventually bring something good.
    • Lamp ●●●●●A clear, burning lamp foretells prosperity and a happy home; empty, broken or dropped, it warns of disappointment and loss.
    • Lamp-post ●●●●●A lamp-post promises unexpected support, but can also warn of deceit and adversity.
    • Lance ●●●●●A lance warns of formidable opponents, but breaking one promises overcoming the impossible.
    • Land ●●●●●Fertile land, or land you gain, foretells wealth, health and family happiness; barren land or land you sell brings loss and discouragement.
    • Landau ●●●●●Riding in a landau foretells a run of light, pleasant moments, unless the carriage overturns.
    • Lantern ●●●●●A lantern lighting your way foretells luck and success; lost, extinguished or broken, it warns of sadness and setbacks.
    • Lap ●●●●●Sitting on someone's lap brings respite, but what lands in your own lap may signal criticism or threats.
    • Lap blanket ●●●●●A lap blanket warns that questionable commitments will draw unwelcome attention.
    • Lap-dog ●●●●●A lap-dog foretells help from friends, unless it looks thin and unwell.
    • Lard ●●●●●Lard foretells improving fortunes, though putting your hand in it warns of social disappointment.
    • Lark ●●●●●The lark is a joyful omen of high aims, growing fortune and happy love, unless it is wounded or killed.
    • Latch ●●●●●A latch foretells appeals for help you'll answer unkindly and, if broken, a falling-out with a close friend.
    • Latin ●●●●●Studying Latin foretells success in defending your views.
    • Laudanum ●●●●●Laudanum speaks of dependence and weakness, but also of the good you can do by helping others steer clear of it.
    • Laughing ●●●●●Cheerful laughter foretells success and good company, but excessive or mocking laughter tends to mean tears.
    • Laughter ●●●●●Peals of laughter are an unfavourable omen, foretelling tears and trouble.
    • Laundress ●●●●●A laundress signals infidelity or a strange adventure, but prosperity for traders and farmers.
    • Laundry ●●●●●Doing laundry foretells effort that will pay off, provided the wash comes out clean.
    • Laurel ●●●●●Laurel is an omen of victory, success and happiness in love.
    • Law ●●●●●Legal matters foretell expense and secrets revealed, though being sued oddly points to money.
    • Lawn ●●●●●A lawn is a sign of a wedding.
    • Lawns ●●●●●A well-kept lawn foretells joy, prosperity and wishes granted; dead grass or snakes warn of quarrels and betrayal.
    • Lawsuits ●●●●●A lawsuit warns of enemies and slander, though studying law promises a quick rise.
    • Lawyer ●●●●●Meeting a lawyer foretells bad news, losses and criticism.
    • Ziness ●●●●●Laziness foretells mistakes, disappointment and loss.
    • Lead ●●●●●Lead weighs on plans and health, though lead bullets bring good news and luck in love.
    • Leak ●●●●●A leak usually signals loss and irritation.
    • Leap year ●●●●●A leap year is one of the luckiest dreams: whatever you undertake will thrive.
    • Leapfrog ●●●●●Playing leapfrog foretells troubles and a fickle partner.
    • Leaping ●●●●●Leaping over obstacles foretells difficulties that can sometimes be overcome.
    • Learning ●●●●●Learning foretells a thirst for knowledge, a rise in the world and stimulating company.
    • Leather ●●●●●Leather points to sound business, good commitments and a loyal home life.
    • Leaves ●●●●●Leaves track the health of the tree: green ones promise happiness and long life, withered ones bring disappointment and worry.
    • Ledger ●●●●●A ledger is about stewardship: kept carefully it protects your interests, neglected it brings losses and worry.
    • Leeches ●●●●●Leeches warn of people feeding off you and of health worries close to home.
    • Leeward ●●●●●Sailing leeward promises a pleasant journey, unless your vessel is drifting out of control.
    • Legacy ●●●●●Receiving a legacy in a dream works by contraries: it foretells losses and wrangling over what you own.
    • Legislature ●●●●●Sitting in a legislature points to vanity rather than any real advancement.
    • Legs ●●●●●Legs are about your ability to move forward: sound legs promise a happy future, injured or useless ones bring losses and worries.
    • Lemonade ●●●●●Drinking lemonade foretells a social event that mainly serves someone else's interests at your expense.
    • Lemons ●●●●●Lemons are a sour fruit in dreams: they speak of jealousy, family friction and disappointment in love.
    • Lending ●●●●●Lending in a dream foretells money troubles, while refusing to lend, or being offered a loan, is a good sign.
    • Lentils ●●●●●Lentils foretell quarrels and unhealthy surroundings.
    • Leopard ●●●●●The leopard stands for cunning opponents: it warns of difficulties and false friends, though you can overcome them.
    • Leprosy ●●●●●Leprosy in a dream foretells illness, money losses and drifting away from others.
    • Letter ●●●●●Letters bring news and feelings: received with joy they speak of love and success; dark, anonymous or torn ones bring suspicion and grief.
    • Letter file ●●●●●A letter file foretells important news that will send you on a tiresome trip.
    • Lettuce ●●●●●Lettuce is a split omen: fresh and green it promises health and small joys; eaten or gathered it often brings jealousy and setbacks.
    • Liar ●●●●●Meeting liars in a dream foretells disappointment and vexation, unless you are the one being lied about, which promises a kindness.
    • Liberties ●●●●●Liberties taken, by you or by others, call for caution.
    • Library ●●●●●A library reflects a need to withdraw into study, but also a risk of hiding your real intentions.
    • Lice ●●●●●Lice mostly foretell worry, illness and social awkwardness, unless you kill them in great numbers, a sign of wealth.
    • License ●●●●●A license foretells disputes, losses and burdensome commitments.
    • Lie ●●●●●The old readings of this dream rested on prejudice and are not reproduced here.
    • Lifeboat ●●●●●A lifeboat promises escape from danger, unless it sinks or goes astray.
    • Light ●●●●●Light is a happy omen of success, honor and love, as long as it doesn't fade.
    • Lighthouse ●●●●●A lighthouse promises that hardship will pass and give way to prosperity and calm.
    • Lightning ●●●●●Lightning brings sharp but brief happiness: its color, direction and nearness tell whether it means luck or trial.
    • Lightning rod ●●●●●A lightning rod warns of a threat to work you hold dear, unless you have it taken down.
    • Lily ●●●●●For all its beauty, the lily is mostly tied to illness and sorrow, though it can also foretell plenty and a happy match.
    • Lime ●●●●●Lime (the mineral) foretells a setback followed by a stronger recovery, while eating limes (the fruit) foretells illness and hardship.
    • Lime kiln ●●●●●A lime kiln warns that the near future is no time for gambles in love or business.
    • Limekiln ●●●●●A limekiln in full blast promises health and good crops; a broken, empty one foretells the opposite.
    • Limp ●●●●●Limping in a dream foretells small worries and minor failures that dampen your enjoyment.
    • Linen ●●●●●Clean linen brings good news, prosperity and faithful love; soiled linen brings worries and letdowns.
    • Linseed oil ●●●●●Linseed oil foretells that a kind friend will rein in your impulsive spending.
    • Lion ●●●●●The lion stands for great strength: mastering it brings victory, advancement and powerful friends; being overpowered leaves you open to opponents.
    • Lioness ●●●●●The lioness is favorable and often foretells marriage, but she can also threaten children or presage a storm.
    • Lips ●●●●●Full, lovely lips foretell harmony and returned love; sore or unsightly ones speak of friction and hardship.
    • Liquor ●●●●●Liquor in a dream speaks of questionable wealth and easy conviviality, which can sour into trouble or disgrace.
    • Liver ●●●●●Liver foretells friction at home and a rival for your sweetheart's affections.
    • Lizard ●●●●●A lizard warns of hidden enemies trying to harm you, unless you manage to kill it.
    • Load ●●●●●Carrying a load foretells a long life devoted to others, while falling under it reflects a struggle to provide for those who depend on you.
    • Loaves ●●●●●Loaves speak of thrift and, if they multiply, of great success; broken ones foretell squabbles.
    • Lobster ●●●●●Lobster foretells favors, wealth and a prominent position, with a taste for pleasure.
    • Lock ●●●●●A lock speaks of bewilderment: if it opens, you will outwit rivals and travel profitably; if it resists, expect rebuffs.
    • Locket ●●●●●A locket is about love: given to you it foretells marriage and gifts; lost, returned or broken it brings grief and fickleness.
    • Lockjaw ●●●●●Lockjaw foretells betrayal and trouble ahead.
    • Locomotive ●●●●●A locomotive at full speed foretells a quick rise and travel; a broken or wrecked one brings setbacks and losses.
    • Locust ●●●●●Locusts foretell discrepancies in your business and affection given to the wrong people.
    • Lodestone ●●●●●A lodestone foretells that you will draw good opportunities your way.
    • Lodger ●●●●●Taking in lodgers foretells burdensome secrets, though a lodger who pays brings favor and money.
    • Log ●●●●●Logs foretell a move or visitors, though splitting them can spoil your housing plans.
    • Log footbridge ●●●●●Crossing clear water on a log means pleasant work and profit; muddy water means losses.
    • Looking-glass ●●●●●A looking-glass is a bad omen: it foretells deceit, false friends and health worries.
    • Loom ●●●●●A loom speaks of harmony and a thriving home when it runs, of irritation or stubbornness when a stranger works it or it stands idle.
    • Lord's prayer ●●●●●Saying the Lord's Prayer foretells hidden enemies against whom you will need your friends.
    • Losses ●●●●●Losing something in a dream works by contraries, foretelling gain, good news or a gift.
    • Lottery ●●●●●A lottery points to risky ventures and worrying windfalls more than real success.
    • Louse ●●●●●A louse foretells worries about your health and vexation from an enemy.
    • Love ●●●●●Loving and being loved in a dream mostly foretells contentment and a happy home, though some readings turn it around into folly or loneliness.
    • Lovely ●●●●●Dreaming of lovely things brings favor to you and those around you, and promises happiness.
    • Lover ●●●●●Dreaming your lover is absent reads in reverse: if they are actually near, they may neglect you; if truly away, they are faithful.
    • Lozenges ●●●●●Lozenges foretell success in small matters, along with petty spite from envious people.
    • Good ●●●●●Dreaming of good luck reads in reverse: it foretells a setback, or a quarrel that will last longer than you'd like.
    • Lucky ●●●●●Being lucky in a dream is highly favorable: your wishes will come true.
    • Luggage ●●●●●Luggage foretells worries and burdensome people, and losing it brings family or money trouble.
    • Lumber ●●●●●Lumber foretells hard work for little reward, unless it burns, a sign of unexpected profit.
    • Lust ●●●●●Dreaming of lust mainly foretells a spell of illness.
    • Lute ●●●●●A lute foretells joyful news and pleasant pursuits.
    • Luxury ●●●●●Luxury promises wealth but warns that excess and self-indulgence can eat into it.
    • Lying ●●●●●Lying in a dream is not a good sign, unless you lie to protect a friend.
    • Lynx ●●●●●A lynx warns of enemies undermining your business and home, or of a rival in love, unless you kill it.
    • Lyre ●●●●●A lyre foretells simple pleasures, good company, smooth business and sincere love.

    M

    • Macaroni ●●●●●Macaroni foretells small losses, but also savings and sometimes the arrival of a stranger.
    • Machinery ●●●●●Machinery foretells a nerve-racking project that ends well, though old or dangerous machines speak of losses.
    • Mad ●●●●●Being mad in a dream, or among mad people, reads in reverse: long life, wealth and success.
    • Madness ●●●●●Madness foretells trouble, illness and friends who let you down.
    • Madstone ●●●●●A madstone on a bite foretells an exhausting struggle against enemies who may gain the upper hand.
    • Maggots ●●●●●Maggots on something rotten foretell a death, sometimes of a pet.
    • Magic ●●●●●Magic foretells pleasant surprises and profitable changes.
    • Magistrate ●●●●●A magistrate foretells threatened lawsuits and business losses.
    • Magnet ●●●●●A magnet is about attraction: it can draw you off the right path, or instead bring protection and wealth.
    • Magnifying glass ●●●●●A magnifying glass foretells unsatisfying work and attention that doesn't last.
    • Magpie ●●●●●A magpie foretells dissatisfaction, chatter and quarrels.
    • Maid ●●●●●A maiden mostly foretells joy, a good match and a large family, except where force is involved.
    • Mail carrier ●●●●●A mail carrier brings word from someone you love who is far away.
    • Mailbox ●●●●●A mailbox warns of dubious dealings and blame that isn't yours.
    • Malice ●●●●●Harboring malice costs you others' esteem; being its target means either a disguised enemy or a fine promotion.
    • Mallet ●●●●●A mallet foretells harsh treatment from friends and disorder at home.
    • Malt ●●●●●Malt foretells a pleasant life and wealth that will raise your station.
    • Man ●●●●●The man in the dream mirrors your fortunes: handsome and well built, he means prosperity; ugly or menacing, disappointment.
    • Manners ●●●●●People's manners in the dream foretell how your affairs go: rude ones derail your plans, gracious ones carry them through.
    • Mansion ●●●●●A mansion promises wealth and advancement, though a haunted room or living there can foretell a setback.
    • Manslaughter ●●●●●Manslaughter foretells a fear of being tied to a scandal.
    • Mantilla ●●●●●A mantilla foretells an unwise venture that will bring you unwelcome attention.
    • Manufactory ●●●●●A large manufactory foretells unusual activity in business.
    • Manure ●●●●●Manure is an excellent omen of prosperity.
    • Manuscript ●●●●●A manuscript tracks your hopes: unfinished or lost, it disappoints; complete and clean, it foretells their fulfillment.
    • Map ●●●●●A map foretells a change in the works, new energy to move ahead, or the unexpected return of someone dear.
    • Marble ●●●●●Marble promises material success, sometimes at the cost of warmth.
    • March ●●●●●Marching in step reveals an ambition to weigh carefully, while the month of March foretells disappointing returns.
    • Mare ●●●●●Mares at pasture foretell success and good company, though a barren field signals modest means.
    • Marigold ●●●●●Marigolds invite you to find contentment in a simple life.
    • Mariner ●●●●●Being a mariner foretells a long, pleasant voyage, unless your ship sails without you.
    • Market ●●●●●A busy market foretells activity and good trade; an empty or spoiled one brings hardship and losses.
    • Marmalade ●●●●●Marmalade foretells dissatisfaction and an unhappy home life.
    • Marmot ●●●●●A marmot warns of sly enemies with charming faces, and temptations ahead.
    • Marriage ●●●●●Marriage is a split omen: attending a joyful wedding can mean pleasure and success, but marrying yourself often foretells trials and sorrow.
    • Mars ●●●●●Mars foretells hardship from cruel friends and enemies, unless you feel drawn up toward it.
    • Marsh ●●●●●A marsh foretells exhaustion, illness from overwork and worries caused by a relative.
    • Martyr ●●●●●A martyr foretells false friends, family discord and slander, though dying for your faith can promise great honor.
    • Mask ●●●●●A mask is about pretense: misunderstandings, hypocrisy and unfaithfulness, though a passing estrangement may work in your favor.
    • Mason ●●●●●A mason at work foretells better circumstances and a warmer circle.
    • Masquerade ●●●●●A masquerade foretells frivolous pleasures at the expense of your duties, and sometimes deception.
    • Mass ●●●●●Going to Mass reads in reverse, foretelling deceit or a burglary, and an untrustworthy sweetheart.
    • Mast ●●●●●Ship masts foretell pleasant voyages, new friends and new possessions, unless they are wrecked.
    • Master ●●●●●Having a master shows you work better under someone else's lead; being the master foretells sound judgment, high position and wealth.
    • Mat ●●●●●Mats in dreams foretell sorrow and perplexity.
    • Match ●●●●●A match foretells prosperity and unexpected change.
    • Matting ●●●●●Woven matting foretells good prospects and cheerful news, unless it is worn.
    • Mattress ●●●●●A mattress foretells new responsibilities, contentment and thrifty partners.
    • Mausoleum ●●●●●A mausoleum foretells illness or trouble for a prominent friend, or your own illness.
    • May ●●●●●The month of May foretells prosperous times and pleasure, unless nature looks strange.
    • May bugs ●●●●●May bugs foretell a bad-tempered companion where you expected a pleasant one.
    • Meadow ●●●●●A green meadow is an excellent omen of reunions, prosperity and happy love.
    • Meals ●●●●●Meals foretell letting trifles get in the way of important matters.
    • Meanness ●●●●●Being treated meanly in a dream reads in reverse, foretelling unexpected honors.
    • Measles ●●●●●Measles foretell worries that hinder business, and gain that comes only at the cost of honor.
    • Meat ●●●●●Meat foretells discouragement and loss, unless it is fresh and wholesome, a sign of flirtation.
    • Mechanic ●●●●●A mechanic foretells a move, busier business and a rise in pay.
    • Medal ●●●●●A medal foretells honors earned through hard work, unless you lose it.
    • Medicine ●●●●●Medicine foretells a trouble that ends up helping you if it tastes pleasant, a longer ordeal if it is foul.
    • Melancholy ●●●●●Melancholy foretells disappointment and, for lovers, a parting.
    • Melon ●●●●●Melon is a split omen: ripe and fine it promises health and happiness; eaten hastily it brings worry.
    • Memo ●●●●●Making memos foretells worry and requests for help, though finding one brings new, rewarding duties.
    • Memorial ●●●●●A memorial foretells a need to show patient kindness to relatives in trouble.
    • Menagerie ●●●●●Visiting a menagerie foretells assorted troubles.
    • Mending ●●●●●Mending is about repair: soiled clothes mean an ill-timed attempt to right a wrong, clean ones mean gain.
    • Mercury ●●●●●Mercury foretells unhappy changes under constant pressure from enemies.
    • Merry ●●●●●Being merry or in merry company foretells pleasant times and profitable affairs.
    • Merrymaking ●●●●●Feasts and merrymaking make a happy dream that promises advancement.
    • Meshes ●●●●●Being caught in meshes foretells oppression by enemies just when things go well, unless you get free.
    • Message ●●●●●Receiving a message foretells change; sending one, awkward situations.
    • Metals ●●●●●The meaning of a dream about metals depends on which metal it is: see each one.
    • Metamorphosis ●●●●●A metamorphosis foretells sudden change, good or bad depending on whether it is pleasant or frightening.
    • Mice ●●●●●Mice mostly foretell domestic trouble and insincere friends, though one tradition sees prosperity and love in them.
    • Microscope ●●●●●A microscope foretells failure or meager returns in your ventures.
    • Midwife ●●●●●A midwife foretells illness and secrets revealed, but freedom for anyone who feels confined.
    • Milepost ●●●●●A milepost foretells doubts in business or love and, if knocked down, accidents.
    • Milk ●●●●●Milk is a very favourable omen of plenty, health and family happiness, unless it is spilled, sour or impure.
    • Milking ●●●●●Milking foretells opportunities that are held back at first but come good, and a wealthy partner.
    • Mill ●●●●●A mill foretells thrift and success, unless it is falling apart.
    • Mill dam ●●●●●Clear water over a mill dam foretells pleasant ventures; muddy water or a dry dam means losses and slowdown.
    • Miller ●●●●●A miller foretells brighter prospects, with a warning about appearances in love.
    • Mine ●●●●●Being in a mine foretells failure, but owning one promises wealth.
    • Mineral ●●●●●Minerals foretell that a bleak outlook will soon brighten.
    • Mineral water ●●●●●Drinking mineral water foretells luck favouring your efforts and your pleasures.
    • Mining ●●●●●A mining dream is about digging up the past: old mistakes someone may use against you, or effort that may lead nowhere.
    • Minister ●●●●●A dream of a minister mostly warns of unwelcome changes and of influences you should be wary of.
    • Mink ●●●●●A mink points to sly opponents, though ones you can overcome.
    • Minuet ●●●●●A minuet promises a pleasant life spent among people you get along with.
    • Mire ●●●●●Wading through mire means your plans will be held up for a while, but perseverance wins in the end.
    • Mirror ●●●●●A mirror is mostly a warning dream: discouragement, health worries and people who don't play fair.
    • Looking in a ●●●●●Looking in a mirror foretells children if you have a partner, and a new love soon if you are single.
    • Miser ●●●●●A miser mostly signals loss and happiness spoiled by selfishness, with one brighter exception.
    • Misery ●●●●●Being in misery over a loved one's misfortune points, by contrast, to an important event that will matter deeply to you.
    • Misfortune ●●●●●Dreaming of misfortune reads in reverse: it is a sign of luck and success.
    • Mist ●●●●●Mist suggests an uncertain future and trouble at home, often short-lived.
    • Mistake ●●●●●A mistake in a dream mostly warns of damage to your reputation and of spiteful talk.
    • Mistletoe ●●●●●Mistletoe promises happiness and great rejoicing.
    • Mockingbird ●●●●●A mockingbird promises a pleasant visit to friends and affairs that run smoothly.
    • Model ●●●●●A model warns about the cost of social life and about self-serving friends.
    • Molasses ●●●●●Molasses promises warm hospitality, but also some disappointments in love.
    • Moles ●●●●●Moles point to hidden enemies, though ones you can outwit.
    • Money ●●●●●Money in dreams mostly means prosperity when it comes in, and worry when it is lost or spent.
    • Monk ●●●●●A monk mostly points to family tension, gossip and tiresome journeys.
    • Monkey ●●●●●A monkey is a dream of deceit: flatterers, unfaithfulness and secret enemies.
    • Monocle ●●●●●A monocle in a dream points to tiresome friendships that are hard to shake off.
    • Monster ●●●●●A monster brings sorrow when it chases you, and victory when you slay it.
    • Monuments ●●●●●Monuments promise recovery to the sick and good luck to everyone else.
    • Moon ●●●●●A clear moon promises success in love and business, but a strange, dim or red moon signals setbacks.
    • Morgue ●●●●●A morgue warns of sad news and grief around you.
    • Morning ●●●●●A clear morning means good fortune is close; a cloudy one, heavy affairs to carry.
    • Morocco leather ●●●●●Morocco leather promises unexpected help and a faithful love.
    • Morose ●●●●●Feeling morose in a dream points to days when everything seems to go wrong.
    • Mortgage ●●●●●A mortgage is about money: a threat when you take one out, security when you hold one.
    • Mortification ●●●●●Mortification in a dream warns of an awkward position before those whose respect matters most.
    • Moses ●●●●●Moses promises personal gain and a partnership you will be glad of.
    • Mosquito ●●●●●Mosquitoes warn of sly attacks from hidden enemies, which you can beat by swatting them.
    • Moss ●●●●●Moss means a dependent position, unless it grows on rich soil.
    • Moth ●●●●●A moth points to small worries, quarrels at home and friends who aren't loyal.
    • Mother ●●●●●Seeing your mother at peace promises success and good news; seeing her ill or dead brings sadness.
    • Mother-in-law ●●●●●A mother-in-law promises reconciliation, but quarrelsome people if you argue with her.
    • Mountain ●●●●●A mountain is about climbing: green slopes promise success, rugged ones obstacles you must overcome.
    • Mourning ●●●●●Wearing mourning mostly means bad luck and misunderstandings, though one tradition sees a wedding ahead.
    • Mouse ●●●●●A mouse points to sly enemies and petty theft, which you can still uncover.
    • Mousetrap ●●●●●A mousetrap warns of traps others are setting for you, or that you are setting yourself.
    • Mouth ●●●●●A mouth in a dream means kisses or sharp words, depending on its shape.
    • Moving ●●●●●Moving house in a dream is a sign of money trouble, for you or someone close.
    • Mud ●●●●●Mud mostly warns of damage to your name and of losses, unless you manage to scrape it off.
    • Muff ●●●●●Wearing a muff promises shelter from life's ups and downs; seeing it on your sweetheart, a rival.
    • Mulberries ●●●●●Mulberries are a split omen: happy in love and marriage, but also a sign of illness and disappointment.
    • Mule ●●●●●A mule mostly signals hard going and disappointment in love, with a reward if you reach your goal.
    • Murder ●●●●●Murder mostly signals sorrow and threats, though one tradition sees an unexpected reunion.
    • Murderer ●●●●●Seeing yourself as a murderer warns of slander from a friend who once admired you.
    • Muscle ●●●●●Strong muscles promise victory over adversity; wasted ones, failure.
    • Museum ●●●●●A museum promises a varied path towards the place you deserve, full of useful knowledge.
    • Mushroom ●●●●●Mushrooms warn against wealth that comes too fast and goes just as fast.
    • Music ●●●●●Harmonious music promises joy and good news; jarring music, trouble at home.
    • Musical instruments ●●●●●Musical instruments promise pleasures ahead and the power to shape your own life.
    • Musician ●●●●●Being a musician in a dream when you know nothing of music promises peace and comfort at home.
    • Musk ●●●●●Musk promises unexpected joys and lovers making up.
    • Mussels ●●●●●Mussels promise a modest fortune but contentment at home.
    • Mustache ●●●●●A mustache warns against vanity and recklessness, but shaving it off signals a return to the right path.
    • Mustard ●●●●●Mustard mostly signals regrets, quarrels and unfaithfulness, except when it grows green.
    • Being Mute ●●●●●Being unable to speak reflects trouble persuading others and warns of worries or false friends, unless a mute person starts to speak.
    • Mute ●●●●●Talking with a mute promises advancement after trials; being mute yourself, injustice.
    • Myrrh ●●●●●Myrrh promises satisfying investments and a pleasant new acquaintance.
    • Myrtle ●●●●●Myrtle promises love, a declaration and happiness at home, unless it is withered.
    • Mystery ●●●●●Being baffled by a mystery means other people's troubles land on you; studying life's mysteries means growth.

    N

    • Nails ●●●●●Iron nails mean hard work for little pay; long fingernails, prosperity; cut or torn nails, loss.
    • Naked ●●●●●Nakedness in dreams mostly warns of scandal, temptation and rash commitments.
    • Nakedness ●●●●●Seeing someone naked means fear or joy depending on who it is, and for a couple, success and children.
    • Napkin ●●●●●A clean napkin means festive gatherings and an orderly life; a soiled one, disorder and embarrassment.
    • Navel ●●●●●An odd-looking navel signals trouble in love, except for couples, to whom it promises a birth.
    • Navy ●●●●●The navy promises winning struggles and journeys, unless it is run-down.
    • Nearsighted ●●●●●Nearsightedness signals embarrassing failure, unwelcome visitors and rivalry.
    • Neck ●●●●●A neck mostly points to family tension, but also to love and fertility.
    • Necklace ●●●●●Receiving a necklace promises love and a lovely home, but losing one signals bereavement.
