    • Necromancer ●●●●●A necromancer warns against strange new acquaintances with a bad influence.
    • Nectarines ●●●●●Nectarines are a split omen: prosperity for some, discord or unfaithfulness for others.
    • Need ●●●●●Being in need signals unwise speculation and bad news from friends far away.
    • Needle ●●●●●A needle mostly signals sorrow and betrayal, with one happy exception if you find it.
    • Neigh ●●●●●Hearing horses neigh promises powerful new friends who will do you good turns.
    • Neighbor ●●●●●Neighbours in a dream point to time wasted on gossip and pointless squabbles.
    • Nephew ●●●●●A handsome, healthy nephew promises a welcome income; otherwise, disappointment and discomfort.
    • Nest ●●●●●A nest promises a thriving venture and a happy home, unless it is empty or full of bad eggs.
    • Nets ●●●●●Nets warn against underhanded dealings and debts that weigh you down.
    • Nettles ●●●●●Walking through nettles unstung promises prosperity; getting stung, dissatisfaction.
    • New year ●●●●●New Year promises prosperity and thoughts of marriage, unless you meet it with weariness.
    • News ●●●●●Good news in a dream promises success and harmony; bad news, the opposite.
    • Newspaper ●●●●●A newspaper mostly warns of exposed fraud and a damaged name, with some hope of travel.
    • Niagara falls ●●●●●Going to Niagara Falls points to an embarrassing moment in company.
    • Niece ●●●●●A niece signals unexpected trials and needless worry.
    • Night ●●●●●Dark night signals hardship; a clear, starry night, or one that fades, signals success.
    • Night birds ●●●●●Night birds are a bad omen, especially for travellers.
    • Night hag ●●●●●A night hag warns of slander from a false friend or someone trying to harm you.
    • Night walks ●●●●●Walking at night signals trouble and melancholy.
    • Night watchman ●●●●●A night watchman inspires confidence but calls for caution in business.
    • Nightcap ●●●●●Receiving visitors in your nightcap means a kiss or an unexpected conquest, but jealousy within a couple.
    • Nightgown ●●●●●Being in a nightgown points to minor illness, bad news and a setback in business.
    • Nightingale ●●●●●A nightingale's song promises happiness, health and often a wedding.
    • Nightmare ●●●●●Having a nightmare in a dream signals wrangling and failure, and a reminder to look after your health.
    • Ninepins ●●●●●Playing ninepins signals a quarrel, whose outcome depends on the game.
    • Playing ●●●●●Playing ninepins means wasted energy and companions you should choose carefully.
    • Nobility ●●●●●Mixing with nobility warns against a taste for show and points instead to hard times.
    • Noise ●●●●●A strange noise in a dream signals bad news or a sudden change.
    • Noodles ●●●●●Noodles point to outsized appetites; there's little good in this dream.
    • Nose ●●●●●A fine nose means strength of character and prosperity; a small or bleeding one, failure.
    • Nosegays ●●●●●Gathering and making nosegays signals hopes that wither.
    • Notary ●●●●●A notary signals unmet desires and likely lawsuits.
    • November ●●●●●November signals a season of middling success in everything.
    • Nugget ●●●●●Digging up a big gold nugget promises wealth and honours.
    • Numbers ●●●●●Numbers point to unsettled business that causes worry.
    • Numbness ●●●●●Feeling numbness creep over you signals illness and unsettling conditions.
    • Nun ●●●●●A nun mostly signals staying single, separation or discontent.
    • Nuptials ●●●●●Dreaming of your wedding promises new commitments that bring distinction, pleasure and harmony.
    • Nurse ●●●●●A nurse moving in signals illness; one leaving, good health; being one, others' esteem.
    • Nursing ●●●●●Nursing a baby promises pleasant work, positions of trust and harmony.
    • Nut tree ●●●●●A nut tree promises wealth and contentment earned through hard work.
    • Nutmegs ●●●●●Nutmegs promise prosperity, pleasant journeys and plenty of changes.
    • Nuts ●●●●●Nuts promise wealth and success in love, but cracking them is unlucky.
    • Nymph ●●●●●Nymphs promise fulfilled desires and heady pleasures, but also disillusion and lapses.

    O

    • Oak ●●●●●An oak promises prosperity, promotion and sometimes an inheritance, unless it is blasted.
    • Oar ●●●●●An oar signals wasted effort and disappointment, even the loss of a protector.
    • Oath ●●●●●Taking an oath signals disputes and litigation.
    • Oatmeal ●●●●●Eating oatmeal promises the enjoyment of a well-earned fortune.
    • Oats ●●●●●Oats promise all kinds of good things and a journey, unless they have gone bad.
    • Obedience ●●●●●Obeying someone means a pleasant but uneventful life; being obeyed, fortune and esteem.
    • Obelisk ●●●●●A tall, cold obelisk signals sad news and disagreements between lovers.
    • Obituary ●●●●●An obituary signals unpleasant duties or upsetting news.
    • Obligation ●●●●●Binding yourself to someone signals others' complaints; others bound to you, their regard.
    • Observatory ●●●●●Viewing the sky from an observatory promises a swift rise, unless clouds cover it.
    • Occultist ●●●●●Listening to an occultist signals a wish to uplift others and step back from trivial things.
    • Ocean ●●●●●A calm ocean is a good sign; a raging one signals setbacks and storms at home.
    • October ●●●●●October promises success in your undertakings and lasting friendships.
    • Odd fellows ●●●●●This fraternal order promises sincere friends, and distinction if you join.
    • Joining ●●●●●Joining this order signals illness; risking expulsion from it, by contrast, a rise in life.
    • Odor ●●●●●A sweet smell promises a caring presence and success; a foul one, disagreements.
    • Offended ●●●●●Being offended, or offending a loved one, points instead to a journey or a reunion.
    • Offense ●●●●●Taking offense exposes faults in your conduct; giving it means struggles before you reach your goals.
    • Offer ●●●●●Receiving a declaration of love signals sorrow; turning down a proposal, an unexpected inheritance.
    • Offering ●●●●●Making an offering warns against servility and hypocrisy.
    • Office ●●●●●Holding office rewards boldness; being turned out of it signals loss.
    • Officer ●●●●●A military officer's company signals hardship and disgrace, and a disappointing suitor.
    • Offspring ●●●●●Dreaming of your children or of young animals promises cheer and prosperity.
    • Oil ●●●●●Oil means being the driving force, but also excess and indiscreet advances.
    • Oilcloth ●●●●●Oilcloth signals coldness, treachery and uncertain speculation.
    • Ointment ●●●●●Ointment promises helpful friendships and command of your own affairs.
    • Old man ●●●●●An old man promises luck in business and sometimes a sum of money.
    • Old man or woman ●●●●●Seeing an elderly person in a dream is mostly about worries, and it all depends on how calm their face looks.
    • Old woman ●●●●●An old woman in a dream is a good omen, pointing to happiness at home, love and family.
    • Olive trees ●●●●●An olive tree heavy with fruit is a dream of peace, harmony and wishes fulfilled.
    • Olives ●●●●●Olives mostly promise success, good company and loyal friends, with a few possible letdowns.
    • Omelette ●●●●●An omelette in a dream warns of flattery and of someone who may take advantage of your trust.
    • Omnibus ●●●●●Riding in an omnibus points to misunderstandings with friends and rash promises.
    • One-eyed ●●●●●One-eyed creatures in a dream signal secret plotting against your fortune and happiness.
    • Onions ●●●●●Onions mix luck and trouble: success draws envy, but you can win through.
    • Opera ●●●●●Going to the opera promises good times with friends, favourable affairs and often a trip.
    • Opium ●●●●●Opium in a dream is a bad omen: illness, money troubles and sly influences.
    • Opulence ●●●●●Opulence in a dream sets real comfort, which is a good sign, against fairy- tale luxury, which brings disappointment.
    • Orange ●●●●●Oranges divide the old readings: the tree and plenty promise health and fortune, but eating or cutting the fruit mostly brings worry.
    • Orangutan ●●●●●An orangutan warns of someone using your influence for their own ends.
    • Orator ●●●●●An orator in a dream warns against flattery and against being won over by appearances.
    • Orchard ●●●●●An orchard dream is mostly about harvest: fulfilled love, prosperity and a happy family, unless it is barren, blighted or storm-swept.
    • Orchestra ●●●●●An orchestra in a dream promises good times, faithful love and the goodwill of those around you.
    • Organ ●●●●●The organ is a split omen: joy and lasting friendship on one side, mourning and separation on the other.
    • Organist ●●●●●An organist in a dream points to trouble from a hasty friend, or to love made too demanding.
    • Ornament ●●●●●Ornaments promise honours and success, though giving them away or losing them calls for caution.
    • Orphan ●●●●●Orphans in a dream stir compassion and often promise an unexpected kindness from a stranger.
    • Ostrich ●●●●●An ostrich points to wealth gathered in secret but also to shady entanglements; catching one promises travel and learning.
    • Otter ●●●●●Otters at play in clear water promise happiness, good luck and tenderness in love.
    • Ottoman ●●●●●Lounging on an ottoman talking about love warns of jealous rivals trying to undermine you.
    • Ouija board ●●●●●Using a Ouija board mostly points to failed plans and unlucky partnerships, unless it writes smoothly.
    • Oven ●●●●●The oven speaks of home and change: family warmth, small letdowns, or a move.
    • Overalls ●●●●●Seeing someone in overalls warns that you may misjudge the true character of someone you love.
    • Overcoat ●●●●●An overcoat warns of friction with contrary people, unless it is handsome and new: then your wishes come true.
    • Overflow ●●●●●A river overflowing around your house points to wealth, as long as no one drowns in it.
    • Overturned ●●●●●Being overturned on the road points to brief distress or worry for an animal you love.
    • Owl ●●●●●The owl is mostly a bird of ill omen: illness, worrying news, hidden enemies and secrets coming out.
    • Ox ●●●●●A well-fed ox promises success and standing; a lean or dead one warns of loss.
    • Oxen ●●●●●Oxen promise a year of plenty, unless they are lean or going to water.
    • Oyster shells ●●●●●Empty shells warn that an attempt to get hold of someone else's fortune will fail.
    • Oysters ●●●●●Oysters speak of money and pleasure: eating them is a good sign to some, a sign of excess to others.

    P

    • Pacify ●●●●●Calming others in a dream means you'll be loved for your gentleness, except where jealousy is involved.
    • Packet boat ●●●●●An incoming packet boat promises some pleasure; an outgoing one, small losses.
    • Page ●●●●●A page warns against impulsive romance and foolish escapades.
    • Pagoda ●●●●●A pagoda promises a long-awaited journey, but also detours before a union.
    • Pail ●●●●●A full pail promises good prospects; an empty or dirty one, want.
    • Pain ●●●●●Being in pain points to pointless regrets, or, by contrast, good news from someone far away.
    • Paint and painting ●●●●●Fresh paint points to a plan that succeeds, but beautiful paintings warn of illusions.
    • Painting ●●●●●Painting your house mixes illness at home with good business; fine paintings point to hardship.
    • Palace ●●●●●Wandering through a palace points to brighter prospects and new standing, with a risk of illusion.
    • Palisade ●●●●●A palisade warns against changing your plans to please strangers.
    • Pall ●●●●●A pall foretells sorrow and misfortune, and sometimes mourning.
    • Pallbearer ●●●●●The traditions disagree: hostility and conflict in one, an upcoming wedding in another.
    • Pallet ●●●●●A pallet points to passing worries in love and a jealous rival.
    • Palm ●●●●●Seeing or smelling a palm promises prosperity, children, or a sudden wedding.
    • Palm tree ●●●●●Palm trees bring messages of hope and happiness, unless they are withered.
    • Palmistry ●●●●●Palmistry is about how others see you: suspicion and judgment, but also distinction.
    • Palsy ●●●●●Palsy points to shaky agreements, doubts about loyalty, and disagreements in love.
    • Pancake ●●●●●Pancakes promise success, thrift at home and good luck in love.
    • Pane of glass ●●●●●A pane of glass speaks of uncertainty and obstacles between you and others.
    • Panorama ●●●●●A panorama points to a change of work or home, and urges you to temper your restlessness.
    • Panther ●●●●●A panther warns of broken deals, bad news and ingratitude, unless you overpower it.
    • Pantomime ●●●●●A pantomime warns of friends who deceive you and disappointing affairs.
    • Paper ●●●●●Smooth paper is a good sign; crumpled paper brings pain.
    • Paper or parchment ●●●●●Handling papers or parchment points to losses, often through a lawsuit, and tension.
    • Parables ●●●●●Parables point to indecision over a problem and misunderstandings in love.
    • Parade ●●●●●A military parade that delights you mostly warns of deception, in business and in love.
    • Paradise ●●●●●Being in Paradise promises loyal friends, recovery and prosperity, unless you get lost on the way.
    • Paralysis ●●●●●Paralysis is a bad dream: money setbacks, thwarted ambitions and fading love.
    • Parasol ●●●●●A parasol speaks of flirtations and fragile love; a broken one points to a breakup.
    • Parcel ●●●●●Receiving a parcel promises a nice surprise; carrying or dropping one points to chores and setbacks.
    • Pardon ●●●●●Seeking pardon often points to embarrassment or humiliation, but receiving one promises prosperity after hardship.
    • Parents ●●●●●Cheerful, healthy parents promise harmony and success; sad or mournful ones, disappointment.
    • Park ●●●●●A well-kept park promises enjoyable leisure and a happy marriage; a neglected one, setbacks.
    • Parrot ●●●●●A parrot mostly points to chatter, deceitful flattery and petty quarrels.
    • Parsley ●●●●●Parsley promises hard-won success and good health, with a large family to care for.
    • Parsnips ●●●●●Parsnips promise business success but gloomy love.
    • Parting ●●●●●Parting from friends points to small annoyances and disappointment; parting from enemies, success.
    • Partner ●●●●●A careless business partner points to losses; a dance partner carries other, often reversed, messages.
    • Partnership ●●●●●Forming a partnership points to uncertain finances; ending an unpleasant one brings relief.
    • Partridge ●●●●●Partridges promise growing wealth and honors, with a caution about ungrateful people.
    • Party ●●●●●A cheerful party shows that life holds much good, but throwing a lavish one points to losses.
    • Passenger ●●●●●Arriving passengers promise improvement; departing ones, a missed opportunity.
    • Passing bell ●●●●●Hearing a passing bell brings sad news from someone far away; ringing it yourself, illness and setbacks.
    • Rage ●●●●●Flying into a rage at someone points to illness; being the target of someone's anger, oddly, to good luck.
    • Passion ●●●●●A password promises influential help in a small trouble, but giving it away puts your reputation at risk.
    • Pasteboard ●●●●●Pasteboard warns of deceitful friends; cutting it, of obstacles swept aside.
    • Pastry ●●●●●Pastry warns of an artful person, but eating it promises heartfelt friendships.
    • Pasture ●●●●●A rich green pasture promises plenty; a scorched, patchy one, hardship.
    • Patch ●●●●●Patched clothes speak of modesty and want, but patching for your family promises money.
    • Patent ●●●●●Securing a patent shows care in your work; failing to get one, ventures beyond your skills.
    • Patent medicine ●●●●●Turning to a cure-all points to bold measures, but a success that will make others jealous.
    • Patent right ●●●●●Patenting your own invention brings you nothing; doing it for someone else brings luck.
    • Path ●●●●●A straight, clear path promises health and happiness; a crooked or rough one, adversity.
    • Paunch ●●●●●A big paunch points to wealth without refinement; a shriveled one, illness and setbacks.
    • Pauper ●●●●●Being a pauper points to unpleasant events; seeing paupers, a call on your generosity.
    • Paved road ●●●●●A paved road foretells pleasant, worthwhile journeys.
    • Pawnbroker ●●●●●Pawning your goods, if you never have before, means fortune is about to smile on you.
    • Pawnshop ●●●●●A pawnshop mostly points to losses and friction, unless you redeem what you pawned.
    • Peaches ●●●●●Ripe, in-season peaches promise contentment and riches; green or off-season ones, disappointment.
    • Peacock ●●●●●The peacock cuts both ways: prosperity and a good match for some, vanity, deceit and poverty for others.
    • Peanuts ●●●●●An abundance of peanuts promises a modest but healthy, happy life.
    • Pearls ●●●●●Pearls mean good business and faithful love to some, poverty to others; losing them is always sad.
    • Pears ●●●●●Ripe golden pears promise fortune and constant love; green or eaten ones, disappointment.
    • Peas ●●●●●Peas promise health, prosperity and plans that come together.
    • Pebbles ●●●●●Pebbles point to rivalry and invite more tolerance toward others.
    • Pecans ●●●●●Pecans promise a plan coming to fruition and a peaceful life, unless they're rotten.
    • Peddler ●●●●●A peddler warns of being cheated and of overrating your friends.
    • Pedestrian ●●●●●Making a long journey on foot points to hardship, false friends and withdrawal from the world.
    • Pelican ●●●●●A pelican mixes disappointments with successes; much depends on what you do with it.
    • Pen ●●●●●A pen warns about a taste for adventure and gossip, unless it's made of gold.
    • Penalties ●●●●●Being penalized points to irksome duties; escaping the penalty, to a victory.
    • Pencil ●●●●●A pencil promises favorable work and a happy union, unless you rub things out.
    • Penitentiary ●●●●●A penitentiary points to costly commitments and discontent, unless you escape it.
    • Penknife ●●●●●A penknife is a bad omen: losses, theft and unfaithfulness.
    • Penny ●●●●●Pennies point to unsatisfying pursuits and stingy affection, unless you find them.
    • Pension ●●●●●Drawing a pension means friends will help you; being refused one, losses and lost friendships.
    • People ●●●●●The old readings simply refer to dreams of a crowd.
    • Pepper ●●●●●Pepper mostly points to barbs, quarrels and deceit, but also a fighting spirit.
    • Peppermint ●●●●●Peppermint promises pleasant entertainment and a dash of romance, with a hint of temptation.
    • Perfume ●●●●●Breathing in perfume promises happy moments, but spilling it or overdoing it points to letdowns.
    • Perfumery ●●●●●The old readings of this dream rested on prejudice against women and are not reproduced here.
    • Perjury ●●●●●Being harmed by false testimony points to discovering someone close is dishonest.
    • Person of mixed ancestry ●●●●●The old readings of this dream rested on prejudice and are not repeated here.
    • Perspiration ●●●●●Sweating in a dream means you'll come out of a difficulty, even with honors.
    • Pest ●●●●●Being bothered by pests points to an unsettled time and annoyances.
    • Pet ●●●●●In one old tradition, a pampered pet points to staying single, and a pampered child to a large family.
    • Petticoat ●●●●●A petticoat is about reputation: new ones invite teasing, soiled ones endanger it, silken ones promise a devoted partner.
    • Pewter ●●●●●Pewter points to tight finances.
    • Phantom ●●●●●Being chased by a phantom points to strange, unsettling experiences; seeing it flee, to shrinking troubles.
    • Pheasant ●●●●●Pheasants promise good fellowship, threatened by jealousy or selfishness.
    • Phosphorus ●●●●●Phosphorus points to bright but fleeting joys.
    • Photography ●●●●●Photographs point to deception and unwelcome disclosures.
    • Physic ●●●●●Taking a lot of medicine points to poor health and a quarrel with the doctor.
    • Physician ●●●●●A physician mostly brings good: healing, a good impression and true love, unless they look worried.
    • Piano ●●●●●A piano promises joy if the music is sweet and frustration if it's discordant.
    • Pickaxe ●●●●●A pickaxe points to a relentless enemy; a broken one, disaster.
    • Pickles ●●●●●Pickles point to worthless pursuits and love troubles, but final triumph.
    • Pickpocket ●●●●●A pickpocket points to an enemy who will harass you and losses caused by envy.
    • Picnic ●●●●●A picnic promises success and real enjoyment, unless a storm interferes.
    • Pictures ●●●●●Pictures mostly point to illusion and joy without profit, with one happy note in love.
    • Pier ●●●●●Standing on a pier promises courage and honors; failing to reach one, a lost distinction.
    • Pies ●●●●●Eating pies warns of enemies and want; making them promises joy and profit.
    • Pig ●●●●●A fat pig promises reasonable success; one wallowing in mud warns of bad company.
    • Pigeon ●●●●●Pigeons promise peace at home, contentment and success, unless they're being shot.
    • Pile ●●●●●Piling something against a wall promises help in business.
    • Pilgrim ●●●●●A pilgrim points to a misguided long departure, poverty or gullibility, then an awakening.
    • Pill ●●●●●Taking pills points to responsibilities that will bring comfort; giving them, to criticism.
    • Pillow ●●●●●A pillow promises comfort, luxury and a pleasant future.
    • Pimple ●●●●●Pimples point to worrying over trifles and small annoyances.
    • Pincers ●●●●●Pincers point to exasperating cares and unfortunate incidents.
    • Pine tree ●●●●●A pine tree promises steady success, but in another reading, idleness.
    • Pineapple ●●●●●A pineapple is a very favorable dream: success, gold and a good match.
    • Pinks ●●●●●Pinks promise a small treat: a new accessory you'll be delighted with.
    • Pins ●●●●●Pins point to little quarrels and small troubles, but rarely great disasters.
    • Pipe ●●●●●Pipes promise peace and comfort after struggle; broken ones, stagnation.
    • Pirate ●●●●●Pirates point to false friends and deceit, though capture can also mean a fortune far away.
    • Pistol ●●●●●A pistol is generally a bad omen: schemes, envy and revenge.
    • Pit ●●●●●Falling into a pit points to misfortune and sorrow; climbing out, to victory over adversity.
    • Pitch ●●●●●Getting pitch on yourself means someone is spreading lies about you.
    • Pitcher ●●●●●A pitcher promises generosity and success; spilled or broken, losses.
    • Pitchfork ●●●●●A pitchfork points to hard labor to improve your lot, and sometimes ruthless enemies.
    • Plague ●●●●●The plague points to disappointing business, an unhappy home life and troubles that pursue you.
    • Plain ●●●●●A lovely green plain promises health, happiness and comfort; a parched one, loneliness.
    • Plane ●●●●●A carpenter's plane means your effort and generosity will be praised and your plans will go smoothly.
    • Planet ●●●●●A planet points to an uncomfortable journey and depressing work.
    • Plank ●●●●●A sound plank is a good sign; a rotten one over muddy water points to indifference and danger.
    • Plant ●●●●●Healthy plants promise success and a happy marriage; how fast they grow tells when the omen will come.
    • Plaster ●●●●●Plaster points to shaky success, and sometimes to unpleasant exposure or affronts.
    • Plate ●●●●●Plates point to a well-run home, thrift and a solid relationship.
    • Play ●●●●●Playing, or going to see a play, promises luck, happiness with a partner and success, unless the outing goes wrong.
    • Pleasure ●●●●●Pleasure in a dream cuts both ways: gain and enjoyment, or disappointment if the delight is overwhelming.
    • Plenty ●●●●●Plenty reads the same as abundance: a dream of prosperity.
    • Ploughing ●●●●●Ploughing is a good sign, unless the horse seems to sink into the ground.
    • Plow ●●●●●A plow promises unusual success, progress and lasting happiness.
    • Plowing ●●●●●Plowing smooth ground promises good crops and luck; hitting an obstacle brings vexation.
    • Plums ●●●●●Plums promise fleeting pleasures and hopes that often fall short.
    • Pocket ●●●●●A pocket in a dream warns of hostile moves against you.
    • Pocketbook ●●●●●A well-filled pocketbook means luck; empty or lost, it points to disappointment and a falling-out.
    • Poet ●●●●●A poet in a dream warns of money troubles and of being swept away in love.
    • Poison ●●●●●Poison in a dream signals harmful influences, but also the power to shake them off.
    • Poker ●●●●●A red-hot poker means meeting trouble head-on; playing poker warns against bad company.
    • Polar bear ●●●●●A polar bear warns of deceit, with misfortune arriving in a friendly guise, though its skin promises victory.
    • Polecat ●●●●●A polecat points to scandal and gossip, but also to beating big obstacles.
    • Polecat ●●●●●Owning a polecat in a dream points to a relationship with someone bad- tempered.
    • Police ●●●●●The police in a dream often mean the opposite of what you fear: victory, honours or promotion, unless the arrest is deserved.
    • Polishing ●●●●●Polishing something in a dream promises success earned through your own abilities.
    • Polite ●●●●●Polite people in a dream point to a visit or a new acquaintance.
    • Politician ●●●●●A politician in a dream points to unpleasant company, wasted time and misunderstandings.
    • Polka ●●●●●Dancing the polka in a dream mostly points to pleasant ways of spending your time.
    • Pomegranate ●●●●●The pomegranate speaks of inner riches, seduction and sometimes an unexpected fortune.
    • Pond ●●●●●The pond mirrors your emotional and home life: calm when clear, troubled when muddy or dry.
    • Poniard ●●●●●A poniard is a bad omen: hidden enemies and suspicion of those close to you.
    • Pony ●●●●●The pony suggests that modest risks will pay off.
    • Poor ●●●●●Seeing yourself poor in a dream points to worries, but sometimes, by contrast, to good luck.
    • Poorhouse ●●●●●The poorhouse warns of friends who are only after what you have.
    • Pope ●●●●●The Pope stands for authority: submission if you keep your distance, honours if you speak to him.
    • Poplars ●●●●●Poplars are a good sign when in leaf or bloom, a disappointing one when bare.
    • Poppies ●●●●●Poppies promise seductive pleasures and flattering business, all on shaky ground.
    • Porcelain ●●●●●Porcelain brings good opportunities, as long as it stays intact.
    • Porch ●●●●●The porch is a threshold: new undertakings, new duties and an uncertain future.
    • Porcupine ●●●●●The porcupine speaks of defensiveness: you may push away new ventures and new friends.
    • Pork ●●●●●Eating pork points to trouble, but merely seeing it promises victory in a conflict.
    • Porpoise ●●●●●The porpoise warns that others are pushing ahead because you are not holding people's interest.
    • Porter ●●●●●The porter mostly points to bad luck and eventful times, unless you are the one hiring him.
    • Portfolio ●●●●●A portfolio points to work you dislike and a wish to move elsewhere.
    • Portrait ●●●●●A portrait is about appearances: deceptive pleasures, compliments or mockery.
    • Post office ●●●●●A post office points to unwelcome news and general bad luck.
    • Postage stamps ●●●●●Stamps point to order and reward in business, even a quick rise.
    • Postal worker ●●●●●A postal worker bringing mail mostly foretells unwelcome news, sometimes an unexpected visit.
    • Postman ●●●●●The postman brings hasty news, more often distressing than not.
    • Pot ●●●●●The pot speaks of small daily vexations, but also of pleasant social bustle.
    • Pot herbs ●●●●●Pot herbs, especially strong-smelling ones, point to hidden secrets coming out, often family matters.
    • Potatoes ●●●●●Potatoes are usually a good sign: success, gains and wishes fulfilled.
    • Potter ●●●●●The potter points to steady work with satisfying results.
    • Potter's field ●●●●●A potter's field points to poverty and distress.
    • Poultry ●●●●●Poultry warns against overspending and frivolous pleasures.
    • Pound ●●●●●Seeing animals taken to the pound points, by contrast, to your stock or goods increasing.
    • Poverty ●●●●●Being poor in a dream is good for some, but bad for those who live by their tongue.
    • Powder ●●●●●Powder warns of unscrupulous people around you, whom watchfulness can expose.
    • Prairie ●●●●●The prairie promises ease and unobstructed progress, unless it is barren or you get lost.
    • Praise ●●●●●Being praised in a dream points rather to gossip, and warns against flatterers.
    • Prayer ●●●●●Prayer in a dream often points to refused requests or hard effort ahead, but sincere prayer promises happiness.
    • Preacher ●●●●●A preacher points to your own shortcomings and to uneven affairs, unless he walks away.
    • Precipice ●●●●●A precipice points to serious threats, to your possessions as much as to yourself.
    • Pregnancy ●●●●●Pregnancy in a dream has sharply divided readings: tension and sorrow for some, good fortune or a happy delivery for others.
    • Present ●●●●●Receiving a present in a dream means either exceptional luck or disappointment, depending on the reading.
    • Preserves ●●●●●Making or eating preserves promises money, property, health and happiness.
    • Pretty girl ●●●●●Admiring a pretty person in a dream warns against choosing a partner on looks alone.
    • Prick ●●●●●Pricking your finger while sewing is an excellent sign, especially for a wish about love.
    • Priest ●●●●●A priest is a poor omen in dreams: he points to troubles and disappointments, and to your own failings.
    • Primrose ●●●●●Primroses dotting the grass at your feet promise joys full of comfort and peace.
    • Printer ●●●●●The printer warns of possible poverty unless you practise thrift and energy.
    • Printing office ●●●●●A printing office points to slander and hardship.
    • Printing type ●●●●●Printing type foretells unpleasant dealings with friends, but cleaning it brings luck.
    • Prison ●●●●●Prison spells misfortune when it holds you or your friends, but release, or in other readings being locked up, promises a happy outcome.
    • Prisoners ●●●●●Seeing prisoners executed is, surprisingly, a good dream, a sign of courage and a clear conscience.
    • Privacy ●●●●●Having your privacy invaded in a dream points to overbearing people and calls for discretion.
    • Prize ●●●●●Winning a prize in a dream is, by contrast, a bad sign.
    • Prize fight ●●●●●A prize fight points to affairs that are hard to keep under control.
    • Prize fighter ●●●●●A prize fighter points to a fast social life that will worry your friends.
    • Procession ●●●●●A procession points to fears, sorrow or money worries.
    • Profanity ●●●●●Swearing in a dream warns against hardening your heart; hearing it points to being hurt or insulted.
    • Profit ●●●●●Profit in a dream points either to near success or, by contrast, to losses.
    • Promenade ●●●●●Taking a promenade in a dream points to energetic, profitable pursuits.
    • Promise ●●●●●A broken promise in a dream points, by contrast, to a kindness.
    • Property ●●●●●Owning vast property in a dream means success; losing it means, by contrast, gaining as much.
    • Prostitute ●●●●●This dream is mostly about reputation, suspicion and bad luck.
    • Prostitute ●●●●●Associating with a prostitute in a dream signals loss and disgrace, though dreaming of playing that role promises a happy marriage to the chaste.
    • Proud ●●●●●Being put off by proud people in a dream points, by contrast, to rising in the world.
    • Public hanging ●●●●●A crowd gathered at a hanging points to enemies joining forces against you.
    • Publican ●●●●●A publican points to compassion leading you to help someone at your own expense.
    • Publisher ●●●●●A publisher points to travel and literary ambition; how he treats your manuscript decides the rest.
    • Pudding ●●●●●Pudding mostly points to small returns and disappointment, unless it is nice and firm.
    • Puddle ●●●●●Stepping into a puddle points to a vexation, redeemed by some future good if the water is clear.
    • Pulpit ●●●●●A pulpit points to sorrow, vexation and setbacks.
    • Pulse ●●●●●Your pulse urges you to keep a close eye on your health and affairs.
    • Pump ●●●●●A pump is an excellent sign of wealth and health, unless it is broken or the water dirty.
    • Punch ●●●●●Drinking punch points to selfish pleasures; throwing punches points to quarrels.
    • Punishment ●●●●●Punishment in a dream points, by contrast, to honours and rising in the world.
    • Pup ●●●●●Pups point to stronger friendships and growing fortune, as long as they are healthy.
    • Purchases ●●●●●Making purchases in a dream points to profit and advancement, with pleasure.
    • Purse ●●●●●A purse, especially a full or found one, means happiness and prosperity; empty or lost, disappointment.
    • Pursued ●●●●●Being chased by a furious beast means your enemies will get the upper hand.
    • Putty ●●●●●Putty points to risks taken with your fortune, to losses, or to moving somewhere humbler.
    • Puzzle ●●●●●A puzzle points to missteps, but being baffled by an intricate matter promises a great favour.
    • Pyramid ●●●●●Pyramids point to great changes and a growing taste for life's mysteries.

    Q

    • Quack ●●●●●Being treated by quacks is a poor sign: beware of impostors.
    • Quack doctor ●●●●●A quack doctor points to alarm over an illness and its poor treatment.
    • Quack medicine ●●●●●Taking quack medicine shows you are brooding and need to snap out of it through action.
    • Quadrille ●●●●●Dancing a quadrille points to a pleasant engagement that will keep you busy.
    • Quagmire ●●●●●A quagmire points to trouble meeting your obligations and obstacles in business.
    • Quail ●●●●●Live quail are a good omen; dead ones point to bad luck.
    • Quaker ●●●●●A Quaker points to faithful friends and honest business.
    • Quarantine ●●●●●Being in quarantine points to an unpleasant position created by enemies.
    • Quarrel ●●●●●A quarrel points to disagreement or, in other readings, to growing closer.
    • Quarrelling ●●●●●Quarrelling in a dream points to unexpected news, and perhaps a romantic disappointment.
    • Quarry ●●●●●A busy quarry points to success earned by hard work; an idle one, to failure.
    • Quartan fever ●●●●●Suffering from quartan fever in a dream is, surprisingly, a good sign, especially if you are married.
    • Quartet ●●●●●Playing or singing in a quartet points to good business and jolly company.
    • Quay ●●●●●A quay points to plans for a long trip and to wishes coming true.
    • Queen ●●●●●A queen points to successful ventures, though other readings warn of money losses.
    • Question ●●●●●Asking a question in a dream points to a successful search for truth; being questioned, to unfair treatment.
    • Quicksand ●●●●●Quicksand points to loss and deceit, unless someone pulls you out.
    • Quicksilver ●●●●●Quicksilver points to betrayal, losses and discord.
    • Quills ●●●●●Quills point to success for those who write, and to brisk business.
    • Quilting ●●●●●Quilting, or going to a quilting bee, points to prosperity, luck and love.
    • Quilts ●●●●●Quilts point to a pleasant, comfortable life; their condition shapes your prospects in love.
    • Quinces ●●●●●Quinces are an excellent sign: release, recovery, love and fortune.
    • Quinine ●●●●●Quinine points to great happiness and better health, even without great wealth.
    • Quinsy ●●●●●Suffering from quinsy in a dream points to discouraging work and health worries.
    • Quiver ●●●●●A quiver promises success in love to single people, but unease to couples.
    • Quoits ●●●●●Playing quoits points to quarrels, toil and losses.

    R

    • Rabbit ●●●●●Rabbits point to gains, faithfulness in love and a large family; shooting them brings sorrow.
    • Rabid dog ●●●●●A rabid dog foretells attacks and false accusations, which you will overcome if you defeat it.
    • Rabies ●●●●●Rabies foretells enemies, interruptions and betrayal by someone close.
    • Raccoon ●●●●●The raccoon warns of enemies posing as friends, but treeing one points to a gain.
    • Race ●●●●●A race points to competition: winning means beating your rivals, losing means disappointment.
    • Racing ●●●●●Running a footrace in a dream points to success and good news; riding in a horse race, to disappointment.
    • Rack ●●●●●A rack points to an uncertain outcome that weighs on your mind.
    • Racket ●●●●●A racket points to a pleasure you were looking forward to slipping away.
    • Radish ●●●●●Radishes point to prosperity and friendship, but also to secrets coming out and family rows.
    • Raffle ●●●●●A raffle points to unlucky speculation and dashed hopes.
    • Raft ●●●●●A raft points to journeys and new ventures, successful if you reach your destination.
    • Rage ●●●●●Rage in a dream points to quarrels, unless it is sparked by a mishap, which will then turn in your favour.
    • Ragged ●●●●●Wearing rags points to ridicule, but in other readings to rising soon.
    • Railing ●●●●●A railing points to someone blocking your path in love or business, and to a risk taken for what you want.
    • Railroad ●●●●●A railroad calls for vigilance in business and points to journeys, even upheaval at home.
    • Rain ●●●●●Gentle, clear rain points to pleasure, prosperity and love; stormy rain is always unlucky.
    • Rainbow ●●●●●A rainbow is an excellent sign: prosperity, success and a happy union.
    • Raisins ●●●●●Eating raisins points to discouragement just as your hopes are about to come true.
    • Rake ●●●●●A rake urges you to oversee what you've left to others.
    • Raking ●●●●●Raking freshly mown hay points to a wedding soon.
    • Ram ●●●●●A charging ram points to misfortune or, in other readings, to great success in love.
    • Ramble ●●●●●Rambling through the countryside points to sadness and separation, though your material life will be comfortable.
    • Ramrod ●●●●●A ramrod points to misadventure and grief.
    • Ransom ●●●●●A ransom points to being deceived and used for money.
    • Rapids ●●●●●Being swept over rapids points to heavy losses brought on by neglect and pleasure-seeking.
    • Rasp ●●●●●A rasp is a poor sign for couples and calls for caution in love.
    • Raspberry ●●●●●Raspberries point to health, wealth and faithfulness, with some entanglements along the way.
    • Rats ●●●●●Rats point to deceit, enemies and theft, but catching or killing them promises victory.
    • Rat ●●●●●Falling into a rat trap points to being robbed, but an empty, broken or self- set trap is a good sign.
    • Rat trap ●●●●●A rattan cane urges you to rely less on other people's judgment.
    • Rattan cane ●●●●●A baby playing with a rattle points to peace at home and rewarding ventures.
    • Raven ●●●●●The raven is a very poor omen: reverses of fortune, betrayal and misfortune.
    • Razor ●●●●●A razor points to disputes and vexations.
    • Reading ●●●●●Reading in a dream points to success in love and business, sometimes at the cost of effort.
    • Reapers ●●●●●Reapers hard at work point to prosperity and contentment; idle ones or dry stubble, to setbacks.
    • Reaping ●●●●●Reaping a field of ripe grain is an excellent sign of plenty; thin, rusty grain points to want.
    • Reception ●●●●●Attending a reception points to pleasant engagements, unless it turns chaotic.
    • Refrigerator ●●●●●A refrigerator warns that selfishness may hurt someone honest.
    • Register ●●●●●A register points to work others will finish, or to a dubious venture.
    • Reindeer ●●●●●A reindeer points to loyalty and standing by friends in hard times.
    • Relatives ●●●●●Being annoyed by relatives in a dream points to gossip; a pleasant visit, to a good name.
    • Religion ●●●●●Religion in a dream mostly points to your conscience: turmoil if you argue about it, ease if its grip loosens.
    • Religious ●●●●●Becoming devout in a dream points, by contrast, to someone trying to cheat you.
    • Rent ●●●●●Renting or paying rent in a dream points to good business; being unable to pay, to losses.
    • Reporter ●●●●●A reporter means irritating small talk, or, if you are one, varied travel and some credit.
    • Reprieve ●●●●●Receiving a reprieve points to overcoming a difficulty that is worrying you.
    • Reptile ●●●●●Reptiles point to quarrels and rivalry, which you can overcome if you master them.
    • Rescue ●●●●●Being rescued or rescuing someone points to a threat averted, to esteem and to rising in the world.
    • Resign ●●●●●Resigning in a dream points to unlucky new ventures or, in other readings, to advancement.
    • Resurrection ●●●●●Rising from the dead in a dream points to a great vexation, then to your wishes coming true.
    • Resuscitate ●●●●●Being revived points to heavy losses followed by greater gains; reviving someone, to new friendships.
    • Revelation ●●●●●A pleasant revelation points to bright prospects; a gloomy one, to obstacles.
    • Revenge ●●●●●Revenge in a dream points to trouble, lost friendships and disgrace.
    • Revival ●●●●●Attending a religious revival points to family disturbances and unprofitable engagements.
    • Revolver ●●●●●Seeing your partner with a revolver points to a serious falling-out and possibly a separation.
    • Reward ●●●●●Receiving a reward points to honours, good fortune and wealth.
    • Rheumatism ●●●●●Rheumatism points to delays and disappointments or, in other readings, to good health.
    • Rhinestones ●●●●●Rhinestones point to short-lived pleasures and favours, sometimes with a happy surprise.
    • Rhinoceros ●●●●●A rhinoceros points to threats and secret troubles, but killing one promises you'll beat your obstacles.
    • Rhubarb ●●●●●Growing rhubarb points to pleasant entertainment; cooked or eaten, to arguments and dissatisfaction.
    • Ribs ●●●●●Ribs point to hardship and, when broken, to family tension.
    • Ribbon ●●●●●Ribbons point to cheerful company and growing fortune, with some rivalry and flattery.
    • Rice ●●●●●Rice is a very good sign: success, friendship, prosperity and happiness at home.
    • Rich ●●●●●Seeing yourself rich points either to rising through effort or, by contrast, to hardship.
    • Riddles ●●●●●Riddles point to confusion, dissatisfaction and a venture that will test your patience.
    • Ride ●●●●●A ride in a dream mostly warns of setbacks in work and leisure, sometimes followed by a spell of poor health.
    • Riding ●●●●●Riding along in a dream speaks mostly of how your work and love life will go, depending on who is with you.
    • Riding school ●●●●●A riding school warns that a friend will let you down, though you will shake off the trouble it causes.
    • Ring ●●●●●A ring in a dream is mostly about commitment: an upcoming marriage or new success, but fear of a break if it snaps or slips off.
    • Ringworm ●●●●●Ringworm in a dream points to a minor illness and irritating troubles, or to people pressing you for help.
    • Riot ●●●●●A riot in a dream mostly warns of disappointments and slow business, unless the crowd is calmed.
    • Rising ●●●●●Rising in a dream points to advancement and wealth, with a warning against unwelcome attention.
    • Rival ●●●●●A rival in a dream speaks of your standing with others: it may expose neglect, or confirm a strong love.
    • River ●●●●●A river in a dream mirrors the flow of your life: clear, it promises happiness and prosperity; troubled, it warns of strife.
    • Road ●●●●●A road in a dream reflects the path your plans are taking: rough or flowered, shared or lost.
    • Roast ●●●●●A roast in a dream warns of unhappiness at home and hidden betrayal.
    • Robbery ●●●●●This dream points to dreams of thieves and stealing, which speak of loss and distrust.
    • Robin ●●●●●Robins around the house are a good omen of plenty, but hearing them without seeing them is a bad sign.
    • Rocket ●●●●●A rising rocket promises sudden success, weddings and joy; a falling one warns of unhappy unions.
    • Rocking chair ●●●●●A rocking chair speaks of contentment and the comfort of loved ones, but an empty one warns of loss or estrangement.
    • Rocks ●●●●●Rocks in a dream warn of setbacks, discord and hard struggles.
    • Rogue ●●●●●Seeing yourself as a rogue warns of an indiscretion that will worry friends, and sometimes a passing illness.
    • Rogues' gallery ●●●●●This dream warns of company that won't appreciate you, or even a persistent enemy.
    • Roman candle ●●●●●A Roman candle promises quick success in reaching coveted pleasures and positions, unless it turns out empty.
    • Roof ●●●●●Being on a roof promises great success, as long as you keep your footing; a collapsing roof warns of sudden calamity.
    • Roof corner ●●●●●A person in mourning sitting on a roof corner warns of unexpected business failures and trouble in love.
    • Rooks ●●●●●Rooks point to loyal friends who can't quite give you what you long for; a dead rook warns of illness.
    • Rooster ●●●●●A rooster promises success and prominence, but also conceit, quarrels and rivals in love.
    • Roots ●●●●●Roots in a dream warn that both business and health will decline.
    • Ropes ●●●●●Ropes speak of tangled affairs and uncertain love, but also of your ability to overcome obstacles and lead others.
    • Rose ●●●●●Roses speak of love: in bloom and fragrant, they promise joy and faithfulness; withered or white, absence or trouble.
    • Rosebush ●●●●●A leafy rosebush promises prosperity; a dead one warns of illness.
    • Rosemary ●●●●●Rosemary warns of sadness and indifference in a home that looks prosperous, or of sorrow through loved ones.
    • Rosette ●●●●●Rosettes warn of time wasted on frivolities: thrills of pleasure, then disappointment.
    • Rotten ●●●●●Rotten things warn of illness and death; rotten eggs, of disgrace.
    • Rouge ●●●●●Rouge is about deceit: your own, or someone else's at your expense.
    • Roundabout ●●●●●A roundabout warns of struggling in vain to get ahead in fortune or love.
    • Rouse ●●●●●Waking someone from sleep is a good sign.
    • Rowboat ●●●●●A shared rowboat promises merry company, but capsizing or losing a race warns of losses.
    • Rowing ●●●●●Rowing in a dream promises success in love and business, especially in clear water.
    • Rubbing ●●●●●Rubbing something in a dream points to a hardworking partner and success in business.
    • Rubber ●●●●●Rubber points to unwelcome changes and warns against stretching your ambitions too far.
    • Rubber ●●●●●Rubber touches on your reputation and privacy: honors if it's intact, gossip or illness if it tears or stretches.
    • Rubbish ●●●●●Rubbish in a dream warns that you will mismanage your affairs.
    • Ruby ●●●●●A ruby promises luck in business and love, but losing one warns of a partner growing indifferent.
    • Rudder ●●●●●A rudder promises a pleasant trip and new friends; a broken one warns of disappointment, illness or worse.
    • Ruin ●●●●●Ruins warn of broken ties and losses, though ancient ruins promise travel tinged with sadness.
    • Rum ●●●●●Drinking rum points to wealth, but also to a taste for coarse pleasures.
    • Running ●●●●●Running fast promises success, but stumbling or being unable to lift your feet warns of obstacles.
    • Running ●●●●●Running in a dream points to fortune and advancement when you run freely, losses and worry when you flee or fall.
    • Rupture ●●●●●A hernia in a dream warns of physical troubles or unpleasant disputes.
    • Rusk ●●●●●Baking rusks yourself is a good sign; watching others bake them is a bad one.
    • Rust ●●●●●Rust warns of decline: illness, falling fortunes, false friends and poverty.
    • Rye ●●●●●Rye is an excellent omen: prosperity, luck in love and a happy home.
    • Rye bread ●●●●●Rye bread promises a cheerful, comfortable home.

    S

    • Saddle ●●●●●A saddle promises good news, unexpected visitors and a worthwhile trip.
    • Safe ●●●●●A safe promises security in business and love, but an empty or locked one brings worry.
    • Saffron ●●●●●Saffron is ambiguous: it warns of false hopes and quarrels, yet freshly gathered it promises health and wealth.
    • Sage ●●●●●Sage points to thrift and caution at home, and warns against excess.
    • Sailing ●●●●●Sailing calmly promises success; rough water or a risk of shipwreck means danger, except for someone held captive.
    • Sailing ●●●●●Sailing on calm water promises happiness and plenty; strong winds or muddy water mean difficulties you can overcome.
    • Sailor ●●●●●Sailors promise long, exciting journeys, but also a risk of separation in love.
    • Salad ●●●●●Salad warns of illness and disagreeable company, or a fickle partner.
    • Salmon ●●●●●Salmon promises good luck, pleasant work and a happy match.
    • Salt ●●●●●Salt warns of discord: everything goes wrong, family quarrels break out and debts weigh on you.
    • Saltpetre ●●●●●Saltpetre warns that a change in your way of life will add a loss to a deep- seated grief.
    • Salve ●●●●●Salve promises you'll prosper despite hardship and turn enemies into friends.
    • Samples ●●●●●Receiving samples points to improving business; losing them, to embarrassment.
    • Sand ●●●●●Sand warns of scarcity and loss.
    • Sanskrit ●●●●●Sanskrit points to drifting from friends to explore hidden knowledge.
    • Sapphire ●●●●●A sapphire promises a fortunate gain and a wise choice in love.
    • Sardines ●●●●●Sardines warn of distressing surprises, or unwanted attention.
    • Sardonyx ●●●●●Sardonyx promises that your energy will clear away gloom and poverty.
    • Sash ●●●●●Wearing a sash points to clinging to a fickle person; buying one, to faithfulness.
    • Satan ●●●●●Satan warns of dangerous adventures and temptation; defeating him means choosing a better path.
    • Sausage ●●●●●Making sausage promises success; eating it, a modest but happy home, or an unwelcome acquaintance.
    • Saviour ●●●●●Seeing the Saviour suffer on the cross warns of slander, which you will overcome with your honor intact.
    • Saw ●●●●●A saw promises a busy, prosperous time, unless it's rusty, broken or lost.
    • Sawdust ●●●●●Sawdust warns that serious mistakes will cause distress and quarrels at home.
    • Sawing ●●●●●Sawing wood warns of something you'll regret, sometimes toward a partner.
    • Scabbard ●●●●●A scabbard promises a misunderstanding settled amicably, but searching for it warns of serious difficulties.
    • Scabs ●●●●●Being covered in scabs is, against all expectation, a sign of great success and riches.
    • Scaffold ●●●●●Climbing a scaffold may mean rising in the world or being unfairly blamed; falling from it warns of a setback.
    • Scalded ●●●●●Being scalded warns of damage from the elements, or a careless remark that hurts a neighbor.
    • Scaldhead ●●●●●Scaldhead warns of worry over a sick or absent loved one, or a risk to your own health.
    • Scalding ●●●●●Being scalded warns that distressing events will spoil pleasures you were looking forward to.
    • Scales ●●●●●Weighing on scales promises justice, prosperity and a long life; seeing someone else weigh warns of ruinous lawsuits.
    • Scandal ●●●●●Being caught up in scandal warns of poor company and slow business, though being shocked by someone close may bring a legacy.
    • Scarcity ●●●●●Scarcity warns of sorrow and failing affairs, though in a reverse reading it promises plenty of what's lacking.
    • Scared ●●●●●Being frightened by a terrible sight foretells, by contrast, happy news from someone you love.
    • Scarlet fever ●●●●●Scarlet fever warns of illness or falling into an enemy's power.
    • Sceptre ●●●●●Holding a sceptre points to positions of trust; seeing it in others' hands, to a preference for following.
    • School ●●●●●School points to advancement and distinction, but also to nostalgia for simpler days or fear of not measuring up.
    • Schoolteacher ●●●●●A schoolteacher points to a love of learning and quiet pastimes, and success if you're the one teaching.
    • Scissors ●●●●●Scissors are a bad sign of jealousy, quarrels and separation, though some read them as a wedding.
    • Scold ●●●●●Being scolded foretells, by contrast, good luck and steadfast love.
    • Scorpion ●●●●●A scorpion warns of bad luck and false friends trying to undermine your success.
    • Scrapbook ●●●●●A scrapbook warns of disagreeable new acquaintances.
    • Scratch ●●●●●Scratching or being scratched warns of bad temper, enmity and gossip.
    • Scratched ●●●●●Being scratched means clearing your debts if you have any; otherwise, it warns of harm.
    • Scratching your head ●●●●●Scratching your head warns of strangers pestering you with self-serving flattery.
    • Screech owl ●●●●●The screech owl's cry warns of shocking news: a dear friend's grave illness or death.
    • Screw ●●●●●Screws point to tedious tasks needing patience and thrift; a small screw promises success.
    • Sculptor ●●●●●A sculptor points to a move to a less lucrative but more distinguished position.
    • Scum ●●●●●Scum warns of disappointment over social defeats.
    • Scythe ●●●●●A scythe warns of accidents or illness that will keep you from your affairs or travels.
    • Sea ●●●●●The sea speaks of deep longings never quite fulfilled; calm, it promises a peaceful life, stormy, hardship.
    • Sea foam ●●●●●Sea foam warns against shallow pleasures that pull you away from what matters.
    • Seal ●●●●●Seals point to aims that outreach your means, and a restlessness that drives you to struggle.
    • Seamstress ●●●●●A seamstress points to unexpected luck that will keep you from pleasant visits.
    • Seaport ●●●●●Visiting a seaport promises chances to travel and learn, despite some objections.
    • Seat ●●●●●Losing your seat in a dream warns of draining demands or the loss of a position.
    • Secret ●●●●●Hearing or telling a secret warns of falling-outs and gossip.
    • Secret society ●●●●●A secret society points to a sensitive nature and the risk of self-serving friendships; it urges you to stay true to your values.
    • Seducer ●●●●●Seduction in a dream speaks of trust and reputation: it may warn against appearances or, by contrast, promise sincerity and honor.
    • Seed ●●●●●Seeds promise growing prosperity, even if present signs look unpromising.
    • Sentry ●●●●●A sentry promises kind protectors and a smooth life.
    • Separation ●●●●●Dreaming of separation foretells, by contrast, joy: a birth, an unexpected love or pleasure from a surprising source.
    • Sepulchre ●●●●●A sepulchre is, against expectation, a sign of great good for you.
    • Serenade ●●●●●A serenade promises good news from absent friends and a future full of delights.
    • Serpent ●●●●●A serpent warns of danger, hidden enemies and disappointment, but killing it promises victory.
    • Servant ●●●●●A servant points to luck despite appearances, but also quarrels and deceit close to home.
    • Sewing ●●●●●Sewing new clothes promises peace at home.
    • Sex worker ●●●●●This dream warns against ill-chosen pleasures and trouble in your social circle.
    • Sexual assault ●●●●●This dream is mostly about distress, hurt and relationships drifting apart.
    • Shakers ●●●●●Seeing Shakers points to a change in work and cooling affection, even a break with your past.
    • Shakespeare ●●●●●Shakespeare points to melancholy and worry, but reading his work promises a lasting devotion to literature.
    • Shaking hands ●●●●●A handshake promises love, distinction and esteem, unless the hands are dirty.
    • Shampoo ●●●●●A shampoo points to undignified concessions made to please others, or an enjoyable secret trip.
    • Shanty ●●●●●A shanty points to leaving home for your health, and dwindling prosperity.
    • Shark ●●●●●A shark warns of formidable enemies, but a dead or captured one promises reconciliation and money.
    • Shave ●●●●●A shave points to plans that lack the energy to succeed, or debts, but also the return of money you'd written off.
    • Shaving ●●●●●Being shaved warns of deceit and disappointment; shaving yourself, of running your own affairs despite quarrels.
    • Shawl ●●●●●A shawl points to flattery and favors, or an attentive new love; losing it warns of sorrow.
    • Shears ●●●●●Shears warn of meanness and difficult dealings; broken shears, of losing friends.
    • Sheaves ●●●●●Sheaves promise joyful occasions, prosperity and fortunate gains.
    • Sheep ●●●●●Sheep are a sign of plenty and peace, unless they're sickly or scattering.
    • Sheet iron ●●●●●Sheet iron warns that you're wrongly heeding others' advice and that unpleasant commitments await.
    • Shell ●●●●●A full shell promises success; an empty one, losses; gathering shells, regrettable spending.
    • Shelter ●●●●●Building a shelter means you'll escape your enemies; seeking one, that you'll cheat and try to justify it.
    • Shelves ●●●●●Empty shelves warn of losses and gloom; full ones promise the contentment of hopes fulfilled.
    • Shepherd ●●●●●Shepherds watching their flocks promise good harvests and profit; idle ones warn of illness and loss.
    • Sheriff ●●●●●A sheriff warns of anxiety about coming changes, though being arrested may, by contrast, bring luck.
    • Shift ●●●●●This dream points to dreams of linen and smocks, which speak of intimacy and the state of your affairs.
    • Ship ●●●●●A ship promises honor and prosperity, but storms or wrecks warn of setbacks and worry.
    • Shipwreck ●●●●●A shipwreck warns of losing goods and fortune, except for someone held captive: then it means freedom.
    • Shirt ●●●●●A shirt speaks of reputation and faithfulness: torn, dirty or lost, it warns of trouble.
    • Shirt studs ●●●●●Shirt studs mean you'll manage to satisfy your pride, and diamond ones promise ease.
    • Shoemaker ●●●●●A shoemaker warns of obstacles to advancement, but if your partner is one, a comfortable life and wishes fulfilled.
    • Shoes ●●●●●Shoes speak of the path you're on: new or polished, things improve; worn, lost or untied, trouble follows.
    • Shooting ●●●●●Shooting warns of strain between couples and neglected work, but a good day's hunting promises success.
    • Shop ●●●●●A shop warns that jealous, scheming friends will block your every effort to get ahead.
    • Shot ●●●●●Being shot warns of unfair treatment from friends, followed by reconciliation if you wake in time.
    • Shotgun ●●●●●A shotgun warns of domestic troubles; firing both barrels, of justified anger at mistreatment.
    • Shoulder ●●●●●Bare shoulders promise happy changes; thin shoulders of your own, dependence on others.
    • Shovel ●●●●●A shovel points to hard but pleasant work; an old or broken one, to dashed hopes.
    • Shower ●●●●●Being caught in a shower promises deep pleasure in studying the world and putting your pleasures in their place.
    • Shrew ●●●●●A shrew warns of the draining task of keeping a friend's spirits up, at the expense of your own daily life.
    • Shroud ●●●●●A shroud warns of illness and scheming, though an old reading sees it, by contrast, as a wedding.
    • Sibyl ●●●●●A sibyl foretells secret meetings and pleasures that lead you astray.
    • Sickness ●●●●●Sickness warns of trouble and discord at home, though believing you're dying may, by contrast, bring luck.
    • Side ●●●●●Your side warns of indifference or vexation, but a healthy, fleshy side promises success.
    • Siege ●●●●●Being under siege warns of obstacles to your pleasures, which you'll overcome and profit from.
    • Sieve ●●●●●A sieve warns of an annoying deal that will probably cost you, depending on the mesh.
    • Sigh ●●●●●Sighing warns of unexpected sadness with a silver lining; hearing others sigh, of sorrow caused by friends.
    • Silk ●●●●●Silk promises fulfilled ambitions and prosperity, but also rivalry and, in some readings, want if you indulge in it.
    • Silkworm ●●●●●A silkworm promises very profitable work that brings you into view; dead ones or ones breaking their cocoons, setbacks.
    • Silver ●●●●●Silver warns against relying too much on money, but can also point to a wedding or a gain.
    • Singing ●●●●●Singing promises cheer, good news and comfort, but a sad or solemn song warns of sorrow.
    • Single ●●●●●If you're in a relationship, seeing yourself single warns of discord, low spirits or infidelity.
    • Single combat ●●●●●Single combat points to lawsuits and marriages.
    • Sister ●●●●●Seeing your sister warns of a death in the family but promises you a long life, and is a good sign in love.
    • Skate ●●●●●Skates mostly warn of risk: losing something valuable, or having your name dragged into gossip.
    • Skating ●●●●●Skating with ease promises success and luck, as long as the ice stays smooth.
    • Skeleton ●●●●●A skeleton foretells illness, misunderstandings and harm from enemies.
    • Skull ●●●●●A skull speaks of quarrels at home, rivalry and remorse.
    • Sky ●●●●●A clear sky promises honours, travel and a happy marriage; an overcast one brings disappointment.
    • Slander ●●●●●Slander points back to your own lapses in honesty and to friendships lost.
    • Slaughterhouse ●●●●●A slaughterhouse speaks of being feared rather than loved, and of dangers you can still avoid.
    • Slavery ●●●●●The old readings of this dream rested on prejudice and are not reproduced here.
    • Sleep ●●●●●Sleeping in a dream is often a poor sign, except in a clean bed or for someone waiting for danger to pass.
    • Sleepwalker ●●●●●Sleepwalking in a dream warns of agreeing to something without noticing.
    • Sleigh ●●●●●A sleigh warns of setbacks in love and unwise commitments.
    • Sleigh ride ●●●●●A sleigh that glides silently promises success; rough snow brings trouble.
    • Sleight of hand ●●●●●Sleight of hand foretells a tight spot that will take all your energy and cleverness to get out of.
    • Sliding ●●●●●Sliding foretells disappointment and false promises, except on smooth ice.
    • Slighted ●●●●●Slighting or being slighted foretells isolation and unhappiness.
    • Slippers ●●●●●Slippers warn of an affair or flirtation that could end in scandal.
    • Smallpox ●●●●●Seeing people with smallpox foretells sudden illness and failed plans.
    • Having it ●●●●●Oddly, having smallpox in a dream foretells health, good fortune and honest profit.
    • Smock ●●●●●A smock, or underclothing, speaks of courtship and how you protect yourself.
    • Smoke ●●●●●Smoke foretells doubt, dangerous flattery and quarrels.
    • Snail ●●●●●Snails point to unhealthy surroundings and unpleasant people.
    • Snake ●●●●●Snakes chiefly signal an enemy, slander and quarrels, though killing one promises victory.
    • Sneeze ●●●●●Sneezing foretells sudden news, visitors, and sometimes a long life.
    • Snouts ●●●●●Snouts foretell a dangerous time, surrounded by enemies.
    • Snow ●●●●●Snow is double-edged: clean and white, it promises joy and success; dirty or stormy, it brings disappointment and worry.
    • Snuff ●●●●●Snuff foretells enemies winning over your friends' trust.
    • Snuffers ●●●●●Snuffing a candle foretells a death or tears caused to a friend.
    • Soap ●●●●●Soap promises pleasant friendships and solid comfort, with passing worries.
    • Socialist ●●●●●Seeing a socialist foretells an unenviable standing and neglected affairs.
    • Soda fountain ●●●●●A soda fountain promises pleasure and profit after a trying spell.
    • Sold ●●●●●Selling foretells business worries; being sold depends on your situation.
    • Soldiers ●●●●●Soldiers mostly foretell trouble, lawsuits and losses, with a chance of promotion.
    • Son ●●●●●A handsome, dutiful son promises pride; a son ill or in danger signals trouble.
    • Soot ●●●●●Soot foretells failing business and lovers hard to please.
    • Sorcerer ●●●●●A sorcerer foretells ambitions thwarted in strange ways.
    • Sores ●●●●●Sores foretell illness and worry, except blotches on the body, which promise a fortune.
    • Soul ●●●●●The soul speaks of what you give up and what you receive from others.
    • Soup ●●●●●Soup brings good news, comfort and chances in love.
    • Sovereign ●●●●●A sovereign foretells growing prosperity and new friends.
    • Sow ●●●●●A sow with her litter promises plenty on the farm, but poor health elsewhere.
    • Sowing ●●●●●Sowing promises fruitful results and activity that benefits everyone.
    • Spade ●●●●●A garden spade foretells irksome work; spades in cards, costly folly.
    • Sparrow ●●●●●Sparrows promise love, comfort and success in your plans.
    • Spectacles ●●●●●Spectacles foretell changes brought by strangers, and deception.
    • Spectre ●●●●●Surprisingly, a spectre is a very reliable sign of good luck.
    • Spice ●●●●●Spice warns that chasing pleasure could hurt your reputation.
    • Spider ●●●●●A spider mostly signals patient work, money and a secure home, though its bite foretells betrayal and enemies.
    • Spider web ●●●●●A spider web foretells pleasant company and lucky ventures.
    • Spinning ●●●●●Spinning foretells a successful venture and reflects a hard-working nature.
    • Spinning tops ●●●●●A spinning top foretells petty difficulties and money wasted on trifles.
    • Spirit ●●●●●A bright spirit in white brings joy and comfort; a dark, misshapen one warns of deceit and temptation.
    • Spirits and ghosts ●●●●●Spirits foretell unexpected trouble, betrayal and tension at home.
    • Spitting ●●●●●Spitting foretells promising projects ending badly, and estrangement.
    • Spittoon ●●●●●A spittoon in a dream warns of an unworthy attachment and criticism of your conduct.
    • Spleen ●●●●●The spleen foretells a misunderstanding with someone who will harm you.
    • Splendour ●●●●●Splendour promises advancement and a change of life, though one tradition reads it as a sign of illness.
    • Splinter ●●●●●A splinter foretells irritations from family or jealous rivals.
    • Sponges ●●●●●Sponges warn that someone is deceiving you.
    • Spools ●●●●●Spools of thread foretell long work that will meet your hopes.
    • Spoons ●●●●●Spoons foretell advancement and peace at home, unless lost, stolen or damaged.
    • Spring ●●●●●Spring arriving and a spring of water swelling both promise success and wealth.
    • Spur ●●●●●Spurs foretell controversy and enmity.
    • Spy ●●●●●Spies foretell dangerous quarrels and unlucky ventures.
    • Spyglass ●●●●●Looking into the distance promises to enlarge your holdings, but also signals unwelcome change.
    • Squall ●●●●●A squall foretells disappointing business and unhappiness.
    • Squinting ●●●●●A squinting gaze foretells unpleasant people and risks in love.
    • Squirrel ●●●●●A squirrel mostly signals friendly visits and prosperity, though some read enemies and swindlers in it.
    • Stable ●●●●●A stable promises fortune, good surroundings and hospitality.
    • Stag ●●●●●A stag foretells true friends and delightful times.
    • Stagecoach ●●●●●Riding in a stagecoach promises business luck; chasing it or overturning changes the picture.
    • Stain ●●●●●A stain foretells trouble over trifles, betrayal and gossip.
    • Stairs ●●●●●Going up stairs promises happiness and success; going down or falling brings setbacks.
    • Stall ●●●●●A stall warns against unrealistic expectations.
    • Stallion ●●●●●A stallion foretells prosperity and honour, at the risk of losing your sense of proportion.
    • Stammer ●●●●●Stammering foretells worry, illness and needless annoyance.
    • Standard-bearer ●●●●●Carrying the standard promises pleasant work; watching others carry it stirs envy.
    • Starching ●●●●●Starching linen promises a hard-working partner, comfort and good news.
    • Stars ●●●●●Clear stars promise health, prosperity and good news; dim or falling stars bring grief and danger.
    • Starving ●●●●●Starving in a dream warns that a venture you thought promising may fall flat.
    • Starving ●●●●●Starving in a dream foretells fruitless work and a lack of friends.
    • Statue ●●●●●Statues foretell either social advancement or growing distance from a loved one.
    • Stealing ●●●●●Stealing foretells bad luck and a damaged name, but being accused or robbed may turn in your favour.
    • Steam bath ●●●●●A steam bath foretells fretful companions, but only passing cares if you step out.
    • Steel ●●●●●Steel speaks of strength: breaking it promises victory, failing to bend it warns of accidents.
    • Steeple ●●●●●A steeple foretells illness and setbacks, but climbing it promises to overcome difficulty and rise.
    • Steps ●●●●●Climbing steps relieves old worries; going down or falling brings setbacks.
    • Stepsister ●●●●●A stepsister foretells unavoidable worry and annoyance.
    • Stethoscope ●●●●●A stethoscope foretells blows to your hopes and quarrels in love.
    • Stick ●●●●●A stick is mostly a poor omen, with some nuance depending on its use.
    • Stillborn ●●●●●A stillborn child foretells distressing news, though some read it as hope of a bright child.
    • Stilts ●●●●●Walking on stilts shows unstable fortune.
    • Sting ●●●●●An insect sting foretells grief, slander and harm from others.
    • Stockings ●●●●●Stockings speak of company and money: cotton brings modest happiness; holes or loss bring losses.
    • Stone ●●●●●Stones foretell perplexities and a rough road, with a few favourable outcomes.
    • Stonemason ●●●●●A stonemason foretells disappointment and fruitless labour.
    • Storage battery ●●●●●A storage battery promises well-timed investments and handsome gains.
    • Store ●●●●●A well-stocked store promises prosperity; an empty one brings failure and quarrels.
    • Storm ●●●●●A storm foretells illness, losses and separation, but sometimes a reconciliation.
    • Stove ●●●●●A lit stove promises wealth; a cold one, poverty.
    • Strange place ●●●●●Finding yourself somewhere unfamiliar foretells an inheritance, but also fickleness in love.
    • Stranger ●●●●●Being kissed by a stranger foretells a new love.
    • Straw ●●●●●Straw foretells emptiness and failure, except when bundled or burning.
    • Strawberries ●●●●●Strawberries promise returned love, a happy marriage and prosperity.
    • Street ●●●●●Walking down a street foretells bad luck, worry and short-lived pleasures.
    • Struggling ●●●●●Struggling foretells serious difficulties, which you will overcome if you win.
    • Stumble ●●●●●Stumbling foretells disfavour and obstacles, which you'll overcome if you don't fall.
    • Stumps ●●●●●Stumps foretell setbacks, but pulling them out promises a way out of hardship.
    • Success ●●●●●Oddly, succeeding in a dream foretells news of a death.
    • Suckle ●●●●●Seeing young being suckled foretells contentment, success and often a birth.
    • Suffocating ●●●●●Suffocating foretells deep sorrow caused by a loved one, and calls for care with your health.
    • Sugar ●●●●●Sugar foretells jealousy and minor troubles, but also signals purity and sincere affection.
    • Sugar tongs ●●●●●Sugar tongs foretell unpleasant news of wrongdoing.
    • Suicide ●●●●●Traditionally this dream foretells misfortune weighing on you or your interests.
    • Sulphur ●●●●●Sulphur warns of foul play, though eating it promises good health.
    • Sun ●●●●●The sun is a very happy omen of prosperity and success, except when it sets, turns red or is veiled.
    • Sunshade ●●●●●Sunshades promise prosperity and delight; a broken one is a poor sign.
    • Supreme command ●●●●●Holding supreme command in a dream is unlucky, especially for someone ill or helpless.
    • Surgeon ●●●●●A surgeon foretells enemies close to you in business, or a trying illness.
    • Surgical instruments ●●●●●Surgical instruments foretell irritation at a friend's indiscretion.
    • Surprise ●●●●●Surprising someone foretells good luck and great success in business.
    • Swallow ●●●●●Swallows foretell peace at home, success and an early marriage.
    • Swamp ●●●●●A swamp foretells adverse circumstances, except where the water is clear and the growth green.
    • Swan ●●●●●A white swan promises wealth and happiness; a black, dead or singing swan signals sorrow or loss.
    • Swearing ●●●●●Swearing foretells business obstacles, suspicion in love and a fall in standing.
    • Sweeping ●●●●●Sweeping promises harmony at home and love, but neglected floors bring disappointment.
    • Sweet oil ●●●●●Sweet oil foretells being denied consideration at a difficult moment.
    • Sweet taste ●●●●●A sweet taste promises praise for your calm; trying to get rid of it foretells falling out with friends.
    • Sweetheart ●●●●●A sweetheart who looks lovely and kind promises a happy match; one who seems ill or changed brings doubt.
    • Swelling ●●●●●Being swollen promises a fortune spoiled by ego; seeing others swollen foretells envious obstacles.
    • Swimming ●●●●●Swimming with ease is an excellent sign of success; sinking or swimming underwater signals trouble.
    • Swine ●●●●●Swine stand for lazy, greedy people eyeing your goods.
    • Swiss cheese ●●●●●Swiss cheese promises substantial property and healthy enjoyment.
    • Switch ●●●●●Whether a cane switch or a railway switch, it foretells unwelcome change and discouragement.
    • Swoon ●●●●●Seeing someone swoon is unlucky for single or nervous people, but promises wealth to couples.
    • Sword ●●●●●Wearing a sword promises an honourable post, but swords also signal rivalry, loss and hardship.
    • Sycamore ●●●●●A sycamore foretells jealousy for couples, but an early marriage for single people.
    • Symphony ●●●●●A symphony heralds delightful occupations.
    • Synagogue ●●●●●A synagogue foretells obstacles on the road to fortune, which you can overcome.
    • Syringe ●●●●●A syringe foretells a false alarm about a relative's health, and broken, health or business worries.

    T

    • Table ●●●●●A table set for a meal promises unions and prosperity; empty, broken or moving, it signals hardship and disagreement.
    • Tablecloth ●●●●●A dirty tablecloth, oddly, promises you'll never go short of food.
    • Tacks ●●●●●Tacks foretell quarrels, but driving one in promises victory over a rival.
    • Tadpole ●●●●●Tadpoles foretell uncertain speculation and doubtful relationships.
    • Tail ●●●●●A tail foretells annoyance where pleasure seemed certain.
    • Tailor ●●●●●A tailor foretells travel worries and disagreements, but also an easygoing partner.
    • Talisman ●●●●●A talisman promises good company, favours and marriage wishes granted.
    • Talking ●●●●●Talking in a dream mostly foretells worry, though hearing yourself discussed may bring a good offer.
    • Tall ●●●●●Dreaming your sweetheart is very tall foretells, by contrast, a short partner.
    • Tallow ●●●●●Tallow foretells that your love and wealth will quickly melt away.
    • Tamarinds ●●●●●Tamarinds foretell vexation, poor business and disappointment in love.
    • Tambourine ●●●●●A tambourine foretells enjoyment of an unusual event.
    • Tandem ●●●●●Driving a tandem promises prosperity in business and marriage.
    • Tank ●●●●●A tank promises prosperity beyond expectations, unless it leaks.
    • Tannery ●●●●●A tannery foretells illness and losses, or health and wealth, depending on the tradition.
    • Tape ●●●●●Tape foretells tiresome, unprofitable work.
    • Tapestry ●●●●●Rich tapestry promises a comfortable life and, for single people, a good match.
    • Tapeworm ●●●●●A tapeworm foretells poor prospects for health or pleasure.
    • Tar ●●●●●Tar warns of treacherous enemies' traps and foretells difficulties.
    • Tarantula ●●●●●A tarantula foretells enemies about to overwhelm you, but killing it promises success.
    • Target ●●●●●A target foretells a matter pulling you from pleasanter things, or envy aimed at you.
    • Tarts ●●●●●Making tarts foretells joy and delight.
    • Tassels ●●●●●Tassels promise reaching the height of your ambitions.
    • Tattoo ●●●●●A tattoo foretells a long absence, jealousy and distance from friends.
    • Tavern ●●●●●A tavern is read the same way as an inn.
    • Taxes ●●●●●Paying your taxes promises victory over bad influences; being unable to pay foretells failure.
    • Tea ●●●●●Tea dreams are mostly about home and social life: small missteps and surprise guests, but also quiet domestic contentment.
    • Teacups ●●●●●Teacups point to pleasant gatherings, spoiled only if they break.
    • Teakettle ●●●●●A teakettle mostly signals sudden news, often unsettling.
    • Teapots ●●●●●Teapots foretell new friendships.
    • Tears ●●●●●Tears in dreams cut both ways: some readings foresee sorrow, others relief and happiness to come.
    • Teasing ●●●●●Teasing in a dream is a good sign: good humour, affection and success.
    • Teeth ●●●●●Teeth are among the darkest dreams in the tradition: illness, loss and bereavement, with a few bright exceptions.
    • Telegram ●●●●●A telegram foretells unwelcome news and misunderstandings.
    • Telegraph ●●●●●A telegraph foretells news from far away, and soon.
    • Telephone ●●●●●The telephone foretells confusing encounters, rivalry and gossip.
    • Telescope ●●●●●A telescope is about looking far ahead: travel, news from afar and ambition, but also an uncertain season.
    • Tempest ●●●●●A tempest foretells hardship, though some readings see it as the hard road to great happiness.
    • Temptation ●●●●●Temptation foretells jealous rivalry, but resisting it promises success.
    • Ten-pins ●●●●●Ten-pins are a dark omen: disgrace and loss for the players.
    • Tenant ●●●●●A tenant is about business and money: trouble and losses, except when money comes in.
    • Tenpins ●●●●●Tenpins warn against frivolous pleasures that cost you reputation and friendships.
    • Tent ●●●●●A tent signals change and travel, not always in good company.
    • Terror ●●●●●Terror in a dream foretells disappointment and loss, for you or those close to you.
    • Scripture ●●●●●A scripture text in a dream foretells quarrels, setbacks and obstacles.
    • Thatch ●●●●●Thatch is about fragile shelter: sorrow and threats that well-directed effort can ward off.
    • Thaw ●●●●●A thaw means a worry turning into profit, unless you're slogging through slush.
    • Theater ●●●●●The theater is about pleasure and new company, lasting or fleeting depending on your role.
    • With a partner ●●●●●Going to the theatre with a partner warns of a quiet rival.
    • Thermometer ●●●●●A thermometer measures how your affairs stand: it all depends on which way the mercury moves.
    • Thief ●●●●●A thief is about setbacks and enemies, but oddly also gain: being robbed can foretell good fortune.
    • Thigh ●●●●●A thigh foretells luck or illness depending on its condition, with a call for caution.
    • Thimble ●●●●●A thimble is about duty to others and protection: a new one brings contentment, a lost one hardship.
    • Thinness ●●●●●Seeing yourself grown thin foretells worries, disputes or health troubles.
    • Thirst ●●●●●Thirst is about aspiration: quenching it with clear water promises joy and wealth, with murky water, sorrow.
    • Thorn ●●●●●Thorns foretell obstacles and hidden enemies, yet sometimes a romance or your rivals' defeat.
    • Thread ●●●●●Thread is about a tangled path to success, and bonds of friendship that may snap.
    • Threshing ●●●●●Threshing grain promises prosperity and family happiness, unless the straw outweighs the grain.
    • Throat ●●●●●The throat is about standing, broken trust and sometimes a pregnancy.
