    • Throne ●●●●●A throne foretells favour and fortune, as long as you don't step down.
    • Thumb ●●●●●A thumb points to uncertain fortune: large means wealth, hurt or missing means hardship.
    • Thunder ●●●●●Thunder cuts both ways: setbacks and grief for some, good harvests and booming business for others.
    • Thunder and lightning ●●●●●Thunder with lightning is a very good dream: success, harvests, marriage and news from afar.
    • Tickle ●●●●●Tickling foretells worries and illness, or happiness wasted through weakness.
    • Ticks ●●●●●Ticks foretell hardship, illness and enemies trying to strip you of what's yours.
    • Tiger ●●●●●A tiger stands for dangerous adversaries: master it and you succeed, face it unarmed and you fail.
    • Till ●●●●●A till mirrors your hopes: full means success, empty means disappointment.
    • Timber ●●●●●Timber foretells prosperity and peace, unless it's dead.
    • Tin ●●●●●Tin is a good omen of money and a comfortable marriage.
    • Tipsy ●●●●●Being tipsy in a dream foretells a jovial mood that cares can't dent, along with some carelessness.
    • Toad ●●●●●Toads mostly foretell enemies, gossip and betrayal, though killing one or seeing a swarm can turn in your favour.
    • Tobacco ●●●●●Tobacco foretells good business but less luck in love, and warns against waste.
    • Tocsin ●●●●●A tocsin foretells a struggle you'll win, but also a risk of separation.
    • Toddy ●●●●●A toddy foretells interesting events that will change how you live.
    • Tomatoes ●●●●●Tomatoes foretell health, prosperity and family happiness.
    • Tomb ●●●●●A tomb divides the readings: sadness and illness for some, marriage and success for others.
    • Tongue ●●●●●A tongue warns against careless words and slander.
    • Toothache ●●●●●A toothache foretells trouble that ends in a stroke of luck.
    • Toothless ●●●●●Being toothless foretells failure to get ahead, but seeing others toothless means your enemies are powerless.
    • Toothpicks ●●●●●Toothpicks foretell petty worries best left alone.
    • Topaz ●●●●●Topaz foretells fortune's favour and good company, unless it's lost.
    • Torch ●●●●●Torches point to trouble, agitation and deceit.
    • Torch ●●●●●A lit torch foretells success in love and ventures; an extinguished one, sadness and want.
    • Tornado ●●●●●A tornado foretells the collapse of over-ambitious plans.
    • Torrent ●●●●●A torrent foretells unusual trouble and anxiety.
    • Torture ●●●●●Torture foretells grief and betrayal, but relieving others or being falsely accused promises a better future.
    • Tourist ●●●●●Being a tourist foretells a pleasant getaway, while seeing tourists signals bustle and worry in love.
    • Tower ●●●●●A tower is about ambition and rising up: climbing it promises success, seeing it crumble, disappointment.
    • Toys ●●●●●Toys foretell family joys, unless they're broken.
    • Trade ●●●●●Trading foretells fair success, unless you fail.
    • Tradesmen ●●●●●Seeing tradespeople at work is a sign of honesty and a contented life.
    • Tragedy ●●●●●A tragedy foretells misunderstandings, deep disappointment and hardship.
    • Train ●●●●●A train foretells journeys and change, often for the better, sometimes in tiresome company.
    • Traitor ●●●●●A traitor foretells enemies trying to rob you.
    • Transfiguration ●●●●●The Transfiguration foretells inner elevation and the respect of honest people.
    • Trap ●●●●●A trap is about cunning: get caught and you're outwitted, catch game and you prosper.
    • Traveling ●●●●●Traveling blends profit and pleasure; it all depends on the landscape you cross.
    • Tray ●●●●●A tray foretells surprises: good if it's full, unpleasant if it's empty.
    • Treasure ●●●●●Treasure divides the readings: unexpected generosity in one, betrayal and loss in another.
    • Tree ●●●●●A green, thriving tree foretells wealth and rising fortunes; a dead or felled one, loss and sorrow.
    • Trenches ●●●●●Trenches warn of distant treachery and gathering worries.
    • Triangle ●●●●●A triangle foretells separation and quarrels in love.
    • Tripe ●●●●●Tripe foretells illness, disappointment and affairs that lead to disgrace.
    • Triplets ●●●●●Triplets foretell success, wealth and honours where you feared failure.
    • Trophy ●●●●●A trophy foretells pleasure or fortune through mere acquaintances.
    • Trousers ●●●●●New trousers promise prosperity; tight ones, money trouble; their color speaks of health.
    • Trousers ●●●●●Trousers warn of temptation to act dishonourably.
    • Trout ●●●●●Trout are an excellent omen of prosperity and money.
    • Trowel ●●●●●A trowel foretells a turnaround and victory over hardship, unless it's rusty or broken.
    • Trumpet ●●●●●A trumpet heralds something notable; blowing one grants your wishes, but hearing one may spell trouble.
    • Trunk ●●●●●A trunk foretells journeys, happy or disappointing depending on whether it's packed neatly or in a mess.
    • Truss ●●●●●A truss foretells poor health and unlucky business.
    • Trusts ●●●●●Trusts foretell middling success, except in speculation.
    • Tub ●●●●●A tub divides the readings: full means contentment in one, evil to fear in another; empty or broken always spells trouble.
    • Tulips ●●●●●Tulips are a sign of plenty, wealth and a good marriage.
    • Tumble ●●●●●Tumbling warns against carelessness; seeing others tumble works in your favour.
    • Tumbler ●●●●●A tumbler is about health and secrets: a clear one means vigour, a broken one revelations.
    • Tunnel ●●●●●A tunnel bodes ill for business and love: it foretells hardship and a difficult passage.
    • Turf ●●●●●Turf foretells pleasure and wealth, at some risk to your reputation.
    • Turkey ●●●●●Turkeys are a good omen of gain, harvests and joyful occasions.
    • Turkish bath ●●●●●A Turkish bath foretells seeking health far from home, with much enjoyment.
    • Turnip ●●●●●Turnips mostly foretell bright prospects and prosperity, with a few domestic shadows.
    • Turpentine ●●●●●Turpentine foretells discouraging commitments, but tending others wins friendship.
    • Turquoise ●●●●●A turquoise foretells a wish soon granted, to your family's delight.
    • Turtle ●●●●●A turtle foretells long life, unexpected pleasure and a lasting relationship.
    • Tweezers ●●●●●Tweezers foretell uncomfortable situations and unkind companions.
    • Twine ●●●●●Twine foretells complications in your affairs.
    • Twins ●●●●●Twins foretell security, happiness at home and good news, unless they're sickly.
    • Typhoid ●●●●●Typhoid warns of enemies and urges you to watch your health.

    U

    • Ugly ●●●●●Seeing yourself as ugly foretells trouble in love, though another reading promises welcome news from an absent friend.
    • Ulcer ●●●●●An ulcer foretells lost friends, separation and unpopularity.
    • Umbrella ●●●●●An umbrella mostly foretells annoyance and misunderstandings, unless it's new and shelters you in fine weather.
    • Uncle ●●●●●An uncle foretells sad news and family tension.
    • Rground Places ●●●●●Underground places put reputation and fortune at risk, and foretell worrying speculation.
    • Going Underground ●●●●●Going underground is a dark omen, unless you're digging the hole yourself.
    • Undertaker ●●●●●An undertaker is a reversed omen: it foretells a wedding or a birth.
    • Undressing ●●●●●Undressing foretells gossip and scandal, or secrets coming to light.
    • Unfortunate ●●●●●Feeling unfortunate foretells loss for you and trouble for others.
    • Uniform ●●●●●A uniform foretells influential backers, but also rifts if the uniforms are strange or the faces sad.
    • Unknown ●●●●●The unknown signals change, good or bad depending on how the strangers look.
    • Urgent ●●●●●Backing an urgent petition foretells a tricky venture that will need skilful financing.
    • Urinal ●●●●●A urinal foretells disorder at home.
    • Urine ●●●●●Urine foretells fragile health and difficult relationships.
    • Urn ●●●●●An urn foretells patchy prosperity, and in one reading a wedding close to home.
    • Usurer ●●●●●A usurer foretells coldness from others, declining business and betrayal.
    • Usurper ●●●●●A usurper foretells struggles over rights or position, which you'll often win.

    V

    • Vaccinated ●●●●●Being vaccinated foretells good health and a generous gesture that brings you honour.
    • Vaccination ●●●●●Vaccination warns of emotional vulnerability and disappointment.
    • Vagrant ●●●●●A vagrant foretells poverty and contagion, but giving to one wins praise for your generosity.
    • Valentine ●●●●●A valentine foretells missed chances and a passionate but unwise romance.
    • Valley ●●●●●A green, peaceful valley foretells prosperity and happy love; a barren or marshy one, the opposite.
    • Varnishing ●●●●●Varnishing warns of deceptive appearances and foretells losses.
    • Vase ●●●●●A vase foretells sweetness and contentment at home, unless it's broken.
    • Vat ●●●●●A vat foretells anguish and suffering at the hands of cruel people.
    • Vatican ●●●●●The Vatican foretells unexpected favours and distinguished acquaintances.
    • Vault ●●●●●A vault foretells bereavement and betrayal, but in other readings hidden wealth or an unexpected inheritance.
    • Veal ●●●●●Roast veal is a good sign; boiled or raw, it foretells illness or disappointment.
    • Vegetables ●●●●●Vegetables foretell deceptive luck, and withered ones, sorrow.
    • Vehicle ●●●●●A vehicle foretells loss, bad news and setbacks, unless you buy one.
    • Veil ●●●●●A veil is about concealment and deceit, except a bridal veil, which foretells a happy change.
    • Vein ●●●●●Veins foretell protection from slander or a rise, but deep sorrow if they bleed.
    • Velvet ●●●●●Velvet foretells success and honours, but warns against pride and waste.
    • Veneer ●●●●●Veneer foretells deceiving your friends and misleading speculation.
    • Venison ●●●●●Venison foretells travel and change, sometimes profitable, sometimes unlucky.
    • Ventriloquist ●●●●●A ventriloquist foretells betrayal and double-dealing.
    • Veranda ●●●●●A veranda foretells success in a worrying matter and happy love, unless it's run-down.
    • Vermin ●●●●●Vermin foretell illness, trouble and enemies, but getting rid of them promises fair success.
    • Vertigo ●●●●●Vertigo foretells lost happiness at home and gloomy prospects.
    • Ships ●●●●●Ships foretell work and activity.
    • Vexation ●●●●●Being very vexed in a dream foretells the opposite: great pleasure soon.
    • Vexed ●●●●●Being vexed in a dream foretells worries on waking and a misunderstanding hard to clear up.
    • Vicar ●●●●●A vicar warns of jealousy and unrequited love.
    • Vice ●●●●●Vice warns against bad influences and misfortune threatening someone close.
    • Victim ●●●●●Being a victim foretells oppression by enemies; victimising others, ill-gotten wealth.
    • Victory ●●●●●Victory foretells that you'll withstand attacks and be loved.
    • Victuals ●●●●●A spread of victuals foretells a loss.
    • Village ●●●●●A village foretells health, security and good news, unless it's run-down.
    • Villainy ●●●●●Suffering villainy in a dream is a reversed omen: an unexpected inheritance.
    • Vine ●●●●●Vines are a sign of health, prosperity and abundance, unless dead or poisonous.
    • Vinegar ●●●●●Vinegar foretells sourness, illness and worry, except when used for pickling.
    • Vineyard ●●●●●A vineyard foretells good speculation and promising romance, unless it's neglected.
    • Violence ●●●●●Violence foretells defeat by enemies or loss of favour through your own conduct.
    • Violets ●●●●●Violets foretell joyful occasions and love, unless they're withered.
    • Violin ●●●●●A violin foretells family harmony, good news and peace of mind, unless it's broken.
    • Viper ●●●●●A viper foretells calamity and enemies joining forces against you.
    • Virgin ●●●●●Old readings mix modest luck, regret and risk to reputation; seeing the Virgin Mary foretells great honours.
    • Visions ●●●●●Visions foretell upheaval and change, painful at first but good in the end.
    • Visit ●●●●●A visit mostly foretells pleasant times and good news, unless it goes wrong.
    • Vitriol ●●●●●Vitriol mostly points to unfair judgments and spite, whether you are the one dishing it out or on the receiving end.
    • Voice ●●●●●Voices in a dream promise reconciliation when they are gentle, and trouble when they are harsh or alarmed.
    • Volcano ●●●●●A volcano warns of fierce disputes that threaten your good name, though for some it signals release.
    • Vomit ●●●●●Vomiting in a dream mostly warns of health trouble or scandal, though tradition says it brings gain to people of modest means.
    • Vomiting ●●●●●Oddly enough, vomiting in a dream is mostly read as a sign of health and good luck.
    • Voting ●●●●●Voting in a dream mostly signals turmoil and trouble, except for the newly married, to whom it promises a remarkable child.
    • Voucher ●●●●●A voucher speaks of patient work winning out over scheming, and of solid support around you.
    • Vow ●●●●●Making or hearing vows mostly signals accusations of disloyalty, and breaking a vow bodes ill for everyone.
    • Voyage ●●●●●A voyage in a dream promises an unexpected inheritance, unless the trip goes badly.
    • Vulture ●●●●●The vulture marks someone scheming to harm you, but it promises recovery to the sick.

    W

    • Wadding ●●●●●Wadding brings comfort to the grieving and makes you shrug off unkind criticism.
    • Wading ●●●●●Wading in clear water promises bright joys and wishes fulfilled; muddy water warns of illness and sorrow.
    • Wafer ●●●●●A wafer warns of a run-in with enemies and dwindling finances.
    • Wager ●●●●●Betting in a dream warns against shady means and risk, though winning restores your luck.
    • Wages ●●●●●Wages in a dream mostly speak of unexpected gains and profit, though some readings flip the usual meaning.
    • Wagon ●●●●●A wagon mostly signals worries and losses, unless you drive it uphill or across clear water.
    • Wagtail ●●●●●The wagtail warns of unpleasant gossip and clear losses in your affairs.
    • Waif ●●●●●A waif warns of personal difficulties and bad luck in business.
    • Wail ●●●●●Hearing a wail brings frightening news and a fear of being left alone.
    • Waist and blouse ●●●●●A full waist and a pretty blouse promise favor and admiration; a torn blouse brings criticism.
    • Waiter ●●●●●A waiter promises a pleasant time at a friend's, unless he turns surly.
    • Wake ●●●●●A wake warns against dubious choices, in love as in daily life.
    • Walking ●●●●●Walking in a dream depends on the ground: pleasant paths bring luck, while mud, thorns or darkness bring worry and illness.
    • Walking stick ●●●●●A walking stick warns against hasty commitments and leaning too much on others' advice.
    • Wallet ●●●●●A wallet is about money and hope: full means wealth, empty means disappointment, and losing it, oddly, means success.
    • Wallet ●●●●●A wallet signals pleasant new responsibilities, as long as it isn't old or grubby.
    • Walls ●●●●●A wall is an obstacle: getting over it, breaking through or building one means success; being blocked or falling means failure.
    • Walnut ●●●●●Walnuts often promise joy and wealth, though some traditions read them as trouble and infidelity.
    • Waltz ●●●●●A waltz promises cheerful company and admiration, with a warning against getting too swept away.
    • Waltzing ●●●●●Waltzing with a pleasant partner oddly foretells a letdown from someone you thought was kind.
    • Want ●●●●●Being in want in a dream is a warning, but it can also herald a happy reversal.
    • War ●●●●●War signals trouble in business and family quarrels, unless your side wins.
    • Wardrobe ●●●●●A wardrobe warns against trying to look richer than you are.
    • Warehouse ●●●●●A full warehouse promises a successful venture; an empty one, a letdown.
    • Warming pan ●●●●●A warming pan heating your bed promises marriage to those who are single.
    • Warrant ●●●●●A warrant points to anxiety over an important undertaking and the risk of quarrels.
    • Warship ●●●●●A warship foretells long journeys far from home and tensions that may spill into your private affairs.
    • Warts ●●●●●Warts mostly warn of attacks on your honor, though depending on where they appear they can bring money or distinction.
    • Washboard ●●●●●A washboard signals embarrassment and energy drained away by others.
    • Washbowl ●●●●●A washbowl signals pleasant new concerns and, if the water is clear, a passionate bond.
    • Washing ●●●●●Washing in clear water is a good omen and often means a move; dirty water or washing fully clothed means the opposite.
    • Wasp ●●●●●Wasps mostly point to envy and spite from enemies, though one tradition reads them as abundance.
    • Waste ●●●●●Waste signals doubt, failure and household worries, especially if you are the one causing it.
    • Watch ●●●●●A watch promises success in well-managed ventures, but rivalry or loss depending on what happens to it.
    • Water ●●●●●Clear water promises prosperity and pleasure; muddy or troubled water warns of danger, illness and grief.
    • Water carrier ●●●●●A water carrier promises good prospects, in fortune and in love.
    • Water lily ●●●●●A water lily foretells prosperity closely mixed with sorrow.
    • Waterfall ●●●●●A waterfall promises your wildest wish and exceptional luck.
    • Watermelons ●●●●●Watermelons are read the same way as melons.
    • Watermill ●●●●●Being in a watermill is a very good omen for business, harvests and love.
    • Waves ●●●●●Clear waves point to a fruitful decision; muddy or stormy ones to a mistake or ordeal.
    • Wax taper ●●●●●Lighting a wax taper promises happy reunions; blowing it out, disappointment.
    • Way ●●●●●Losing your way in a dream warns against chancy speculation.
    • Wealth ●●●●●Wealth in a dream promises the drive to succeed and friends who will come through for you.
    • Weasel ●●●●●A weasel warns against false friends, especially former enemies who have turned friendly.
    • Weather ●●●●●Weather in a dream signals shifting fortunes, swinging between progress and doubt.
    • Weaving ●●●●●Weaving promises an honorable fortune built through perseverance.
    • Web ●●●●●A web warns of false friends, though a firm one shows you'll stand up to the envious.
    • Wedding ●●●●●Traditionally, a wedding in a dream is a paradox: it points to bitterness or bereavement more often than joy.
    • Wedding clothes ●●●●●Wedding clothes promise pleasant activities and new friends, unless they are soiled.
    • Wedding ring ●●●●●A shining wedding ring shields you from worry and infidelity; a lost or broken one brings sadness.
    • Wedge ●●●●●A wedge warns of business trouble that will drive you apart from loved ones.
    • Wedlock ●●●●●Unwanted wedlock signals trouble; a happy, secure marriage is a good sign.
    • Weeding ●●●●●Weeding signals hard going in work that will bring you distinction.
    • Weeping ●●●●●Weeping in a dream signals family trouble, but seeing others weep means reunion, and one tradition reads it as joy.
    • Weevil ●●●●●Weevils signal losses in business and falseness in love.
    • Weighing ●●●●●Weighing points to a prosperous period, if you set your sights firmly on success.
    • Welcome ●●●●●A warm welcome promises respect and doors opening for you.
    • Well ●●●●●Drawing clear water from a well grants your wishes; falling in or finding it empty signals despair or loss.
    • Welsh rarebit ●●●●●Making or eating Welsh rarebit warns that your affairs will get tangled while your attention wanders.
    • Wet ●●●●●Being wet in a dream warns that a tempting pleasure could cost you dearly.
    • Wet nurse ●●●●●Being a wet nurse in a dream foretells caring for the old or the very young, and earning your own keep.
    • Suckling ●●●●●Seeing a wet nurse suckle a child warns of temptation and infidelity.
    • Whale ●●●●●A whale signals great danger to your property, but vast fortune if you master it.
    • Whalebone ●●●●●Whalebone promises a solid, profitable alliance.
    • Wheat ●●●●●Wheat is a very favorable omen: prosperity, happy love and success in your ventures.
    • Wheels ●●●●●Fast-turning wheels promise energy and success; idle or broken ones, an absence at home.
    • Whetstone ●●●●●A whetstone warns of sharp worries and an uncomfortable journey.
    • Whip ●●●●●A whip signals bitter disagreements and friendships to be wary of.
    • Whirlpool ●●●●●A whirlpool signals grave danger in business and a threat to your reputation.
    • Whirlwind ●●●●●A whirlwind signals a sudden change that threatens to sweep everything away.
    • Whiskers ●●●●●Long whiskers or a long beard warn of a romantic folly that will make you look foolish.
    • Whisky ●●●●●Whisky mostly signals disappointment, though it can reward persistence.
    • Whispering ●●●●●Whispering signals spiteful gossip, or a need for advice.
    • Whist ●●●●●Whist is read the same way as playing cards.
    • Whistle ●●●●●Hearing a whistle brings sad news; whistling yourself, a merry occasion.
    • White lead ●●●●●White lead warns that carelessness could put your loved ones at risk.
    • White moth ●●●●●A white moth foretells illness, unfulfilled wishes or the loss of someone close.
    • Whitewash ●●●●●Whitewashing promises a restored reputation and good health.
    • Whortleberries ●●●●●Picking or eating whortleberries promises an early, happy marriage, and good health.
    • Widow ●●●●●Widowhood in a dream mostly signals troubles and dashed plans, with a few happy readings.
    • Wife ●●●●●Dreaming of your wife mostly signals tension at home, unless she is unusually warm.
    • Wig ●●●●●A wig signals an unlucky change, mockery or betrayal.
    • Wild ●●●●●Running about wildly warns of a fall or accident.
    • Wild boar ●●●●●A wild boar stands for a formidable enemy; hunting or catching it means you'll get the better of them.
    • Wild man ●●●●●A wild man warns of open opposition to your plans.
    • Will ●●●●●Making your will traditionally promises a long, happy life, but a disputed or lost will brings quarrels and loss.
    • Willow ●●●●●A willow signals a sad journey eased by loyal friends, or illness.
    • Wind ●●●●●Wind is favorable when you face it or it pushes you where you want to go, and unfavorable when it carries you off against your will.
    • Windmill ●●●●●A turning windmill promises fortune and contentment; a broken or idle one, adversity.
    • Window ●●●●●A window is a gloomy omen: dashed hopes, desertion and suspicion.
    • Wine ●●●●●Wine mostly brings joy, friendship and luxury, though one tradition reads it as hardship.
    • Wine cellar ●●●●●A wine cellar promises fine pleasures, yours to enjoy as you choose.
    • Wine glass ●●●●●A wine glass warns of a serious disappointment that will catch you off guard.
    • Wings ●●●●●Having wings brings worry for someone far away; seeing birds' wings promises wealth and honor.
    • Winter ●●●●●Winter signals poor health and bleak prospects.
    • Wire ●●●●●Wire signals unprofitable trips, bad temper and being cheated.
    • Wisdom ●●●●●Feeling wise in a dream promises courage in hard times and a prosperous life.
    • Witch ●●●●●A witch signals fun adventures that end in embarrassment, or a stay among strangers.
    • Witchcraft ●●●●●Visiting a fortune-teller in a dream foretells misfortune, betrayal and deceit.
    • Witness ●●●●●Bearing witness in a dream signals trouble over trifles and the risk of being compromised.
    • Wizard ●●●●●A wizard signals a large family and its hassles, and for the young, broken engagements.
    • Wolf ●●●●●A wolf marks a thief or traitor close to you; killing it means victory.
    • Women ●●●●●Dreaming of women mostly signals intrigue, and sometimes pleasant commitments.
    • Wood ●●●●●Wood and woods signal change, lucky if all is green, and a prosperous family life.
    • Woodchuck ●●●●●Catching a woodchuck foretells a theft, though the thief will be found out.
    • Wooden shoe ●●●●●A wooden shoe signals lonely wandering, empty pockets and unfaithfulness in love.
    • Woodpile ●●●●●A woodpile signals disappointing business and misunderstandings in love.
    • Wool ●●●●●Wool promises prosperity and, in love, a tender, faithful partner.
    • Work ●●●●●Working in a dream promises well-earned success, unless exhaustion creeps in.
    • Workhouse ●●●●●Being in a workhouse foretells an event that will bring harm and loss.
    • Workshop ●●●●●A workshop means you'll use ingenious schemes against your opponents.
    • Worms ●●●●●Worms mostly signal petty intrigue and illness, but garden earthworms promise health and luck.
    • Wound ●●●●●Being wounded mostly signals distress and loss, though one tradition reads it as an excellent omen.
    • Wreath ●●●●●A fresh wreath promises fine opportunities; a withered one, illness and wounded love.
    • Wreck ●●●●●A wreck signals fear of ruin and betrayal by someone you trusted.
    • Wren ●●●●●A wren is a good omen: joy, prosperity and a noble friend; killing one is bad luck.
    • Wrinkles ●●●●●Seeing yourself wrinkled oddly means someone admires you.
    • Wrist ●●●●●A misshapen wrist warns of hardship, but a broken wrist promises a happy marriage.
    • Writing ●●●●●Writing in a dream warns of a costly mistake, though writing a letter means a reunion.

    Y

    • Yacht ●●●●●A yacht promises happy leisure away from cares, and success when the wind is fair.
    • Yankee ●●●●●A Yankee signals loyalty to your commitments, but also the risk of being outwitted.
    • Yardstick ●●●●●A yardstick signals busy affairs, but plenty of anxiety too.
    • Yarn ●●●●●Yarn promises business success and a hardworking, close-knit home.
    • Yawning ●●●●●Yawning in a dream signals a fruitless search for health and contentment.
    • Yearning ●●●●●Yearning for someone in a dream brings comforting news from absent friends.
    • Yeast ●●●●●Kneading bread with yeast foretells a large family.
    • Yellow ●●●●●Being given something yellow means gold; yellow flowers, a comfortable marriage.
    • Yellow bird ●●●●●A yellow bird signals dread about the future, or trouble from someone else's folly.
    • Yew tree ●●●●●A yew tree signals illness, disappointment and bereavement, sometimes with an unexpected benefit.
    • Yield ●●●●●Yielding in a dream costs you a fine opportunity; others yielding to you brings privileges.
    • Yoke ●●●●●A yoke signals bowing to others' ways, though well-matched oxen promise a happy marriage.
    • Youth ●●●●●Youth in a dream sets seeing young people, a good sign, against becoming young again, which mostly points to regret and decline.
    • Young ●●●●●A kid foretells a birth for couples, but also warns against loose morals.
    • Yule log ●●●●●A Yule log promises joyful festivities and hopes fulfilled.

    Z

    • Zebra ●●●●●A zebra points to shifting ventures, chasing fancies and quarrels.
    • Zenith ●●●●●The zenith promises great prosperity and success in love.
    • Zephyr ●●●●●A zephyr is a dream of love returned, at the cost of some sacrifice or a short separation.
    • Zinc ●●●●●Zinc points to solid progress and brisk business.
    • Zink ●●●●●This metal is an omen of happiness, prosperity and success in love.
    • Zodiac ●●●●●The zodiac promises a spectacular rise in fortune, travel and new contacts, with happiness not always unmixed.
    • Zoo ●●●●●A zoo points to ups and downs in fortune and to knowledge gained through travel.
    • Zouave ●●●●●Zouaves, like other soldiers, point to family quarrels and disappointments in love.
